VLA-MOPD: On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Task VLA Policy Consolidation VLA

on-policy distillation flow-matching VLA multi-task consolidation robotic manipulation reference policy retention

简要说明：VLA-MOPD 通过在访问的观测和中间 ODE 状态进行在线蒸馏，将多个任务专用的 VLA 专家整合为一个学生策略，在 LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0 和真实 Piper 机器人上提升多任务成功率并缓解灾难性遗忘。

TLDR: VLA-MOPD consolidates multiple task-specific VLA specialists into one student policy via on-policy distillation at visited observations and intermediate ODE states, improving multi-task success across LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and a real Piper robot while mitigating catastrophic forgetting.

Abstract: Physical intelligence requires embodied agents to ground language in observations and execute actions while retaining useful skills. Vision-language-action (VLA) policies offer a shared interface, but task-specific post-training often produces separate specialists. Consolidation is difficult: mixed-task reinforcement learning provides sparse trajectory-level credit, while offline distillation may miss student-visited observations and endpoint distillation does not supervise intermediate action-generation states. We introduce VLA Multi-teacher On-Policy Distillation (VLA-MOPD), a protocol for consolidating flow-matching VLA specialists. After acquiring task or suite experts, a shared student collects robot rollouts and queries the instruction-routed frozen teacher at each visited observation and intermediate ordinary differential equation (ODE) state. Detached per-flow-step transition targets supervise valid action chunks through a masked local matching loss; an optional reference-policy term supports retention on other tasks. Starting from one trajectory per LIBERO task, VLA-MOPD raises mean success-once from 75.4% to 98.9%, compared with 98.15% for endpoint action distillation. It improves mean RoboTwin 2.0 success from 73.0% to 89.3%; on a Piper robot, two consolidation rounds improve average success from 70.0% to 90.0%. In a near-matched Spatial-adaptation study, reference matching limits the Object suite decrease to 3.0 points, versus 13.2 without the reference term.

摘要（中文）：物理智能要求具身智能体将语言锚定在观测中，并在保留有用技能的同时执行动作。视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略提供了一种共享接口，但针对特定任务的后训练通常会产生各自独立的专用模型。整合面临困难：混合任务强化学习提供的轨迹级奖励过于稀疏，而离线蒸馏可能遗漏学生模型访问过的观测状态，端点蒸馏则无法监督中间动作生成状态。我们提出了VLA多教师在线策略蒸馏（VLA-MOPD），一种用于整合流匹配VLA专用模型的协议。在获得任务或任务组专家模型后，一个共享的学生模型收集机器人轨迹数据，并在每个访问到的观测状态和中间常微分方程（ODE）状态下查询按指令路由的冻结教师模型。分离的每流步迁移目标通过掩蔽局部匹配损失监督有效动作块；可选的参考策略项支持在其他任务上的保留性能。在LIBERO任务中，从每个任务一条轨迹开始，VLA-MOPD将平均一次成功率从75.4%提升至98.9%，而端点动作蒸馏为98.15%。在RoboTwin 2.0上，平均成功率从73.0%提升至89.3%；在Piper机器人上，两轮整合将平均成功率从70.0%提升至90.0%。在近乎匹配的空间适应研究中，参考匹配将对象任务组的下降限制在3.0个百分点，而无参考项时下降为13.2个百分点。

Authors: Yongxuan Lv, Zhen Fang, Lichen Man, Hao Li, Pu Li, Hengyi Wang, Langfeng Cao, Lin Chen, Jie Huang, Xiu Su, Shan You, Fei Wang, Feng Zhao

LHNav: Long-Horizon Humanoid Navigation via Multirate Coordination and Physics-Grounded Action Data VLA

humanoid navigation vision-language-action model long-horizon task whole-body control physics-grounded data engine

简要说明：LHNav 提出了一种异步的三层人形导航系统（大脑、小脑、脑干），结合物理接地数据引擎，使 VLA 能够在仿真和真实 Unitree G1 机器人上实现自然运动的长时程多目标导航。

TLDR: LHNav introduces an asynchronous three-tier humanoid navigation system (Brain, Cerebellum, Brainstem) with a physics-grounded data engine, enabling VLA-based long-horizon multi-goal navigation with natural motion in simulation and on a real Unitree G1 robot.

Abstract: We study humanoid navigation across multiple destinations under long-horizon language instructions. This task is challenging because robots must maintain progress across successive goals while continuously producing natural, stable whole-body motion through confined spaces. However, task decomposition in existing methods does not by itself ensure progress throughout execution, while waypoint-based navigation does not guarantee natural, route-faithful whole-body motion. Our key idea is to organize navigation into three complementary roles operating at different time scales: a Brain for task reasoning, a Cerebellum for local motion generation, and a Brainstem for whole-body execution. We realize this idea in LHNav, an asynchronous system that uses progress and arrival feedback to coordinate navigation goals, VLA motion-token prediction, and whole-body control. To train the Cerebellum for natural, route-faithful motion, we develop a physics-grounded data engine that improves physical tracking of motion references along collision-aware routes and pairs the resulting demonstrations with rendered visual observations. Together, these designs allow task planning to proceed alongside continuous movement and extend single-goal navigation to successive destinations with natural, route-faithful whole-body motion. In simulation, our navigation VLA outperforms OmniNav and DualVLN in single-goal success and motion smoothness, with fewer collisions and falls. Using a VLA trained only on single-goal demonstrations, LHNav achieves a 75.56% success rate on long-horizon navigation tasks. Deployment on the Unitree G1 further demonstrates single-goal navigation and zero-shot long-horizon task execution in real-world environments, including layouts with repositioned objects. Project website: https://robbyant-research.github.io/LHNav/.

摘要（中文）：我们研究了在长时间跨度的语言指令下，人形机器人在多个目的地之间的导航问题。该任务具有挑战性，因为机器人必须在连续目标之间保持进度，同时持续在狭窄空间中产生自然且稳定的全身运动。然而，现有方法中的任务分解本身并不能确保整个执行过程中的进度，而基于路径点的导航也无法保证自然、符合路径的全身运动。我们的关键思路是将导航组织为三个在不同时间尺度上运作的互补角色：负责任务推理的“大脑”、负责局部运动生成的“小脑”，以及负责全身执行的“脑干”。我们通过LHNav系统实现了这一思路，该系统是一个异步系统，利用进度和到达反馈来协调导航目标、VLA运动令牌预测和全身控制。为了训练“小脑”以产生自然、符合路径的运动，我们开发了一个基于物理的数据引擎，该引擎改进了沿碰撞感知路径的运动参考的物理跟踪，并将生成的演示与渲染的视觉观察配对。这些设计共同使得任务规划能够在持续运动的同时进行，并将单目标导航扩展到连续目的地，同时保持自然、符合路径的全身运动。在仿真中，我们的导航VLA在单目标成功率和运动平滑度上优于OmniNav和DualVLN，且碰撞和摔倒次数更少。使用仅在单目标演示上训练的VLA，LHNav在长时间跨度导航任务上实现了75.56%的成功率。在Unitree G1上的部署进一步展示了在真实环境中的单目标导航和零样本长时间跨度任务执行，包括物体位置被重新布置的场景。项目网站：https://robbyant-research.github.io/LHNav/。

Authors: Xueyang Wang, Zehong Shen, Dingkun Wei, Huaijin Pi, Changpeng Wang, Xing Zhu, Hujun Bao, Yujun Shen, Xiaowei Zhou

Compass 1: Towards Open-World and Persistent Embodied Navigation from Monocular RGB Videos VLA

embodied navigation video generation language understanding history representation open-world

简要说明：Compass 1是一个统一的具身导航基础模型，结合语言理解与视频生成，并支持近2分钟视觉历史回溯，在开放世界评估中实现了79.4%的主导成功率。

TLDR: Compass 1 is an embodied navigation foundation model that unifies language understanding and video generation while enabling memory backtracking through nearly 2 minutes of visual history, achieving a dominant success rate of 79.4% across open-world evaluations.

Abstract: Embodied navigation requires agents to achieve persistent spatial awareness and long-horizon execution stability in open-world environments. However, existing navigation architectures struggle to sustain both capabilities, remaining effective only over a handful of recent frames. We present Compass 1, the first embodied navigation foundation model to unify language understanding and video generation while enabling memory backtracking through nearly 2mins of visual history. Without altering the underlying architecture, we introduce History Representation, which integrates sparse visual keyframes with an explicit History Representation Map to preserve long-term spatiotemporal context. To effectively leverage this history, we further introduce History Utilization, a structured VQA supervision protocol comprising three categories: task-stage grounding, exploration consistency, and spatiotemporal target retrieval, enabling map-grounded reasoning and stable persistent long-horizon navigation. To fuel this system, we establish a complete annotation pipeline for monocular RGB videos and open-source a massive dataset featuring over 500 hours of high-quality real-world interactions and over 2,000 hours of annotated web videos. Trained mainly on the distribution of 1m height camera, Compass 1 generalizes seamlessly across diverse embodiments and scenarios, ranging from indoor environments to pedestrian-dense streets, spanning wheeled robot at 0.35m, quadruped dog at 0.5m, humanoid at 0.85m, and aerial drone at 1.5m. Compass 1achieves a dominant overall success rate of 79.4% across open-world evaluations, compared to 17.8% for the strongest baseline. It demonstrates exceptional zero-shot execution exceeding 90% on foundational tasks, a 250% boost in exploration, and an unparalleled leap from 0% to 58% in challenging persistent history backtracking.

摘要（中文）：具身导航要求智能体在开放世界环境中实现持久的空间感知和长时程执行稳定性。然而，现有导航架构难以同时维持这两种能力，仅在有限的近期帧范围内有效。我们提出了Compass 1，这是首个将语言理解与视频生成相统一，并支持通过近2分钟视觉历史进行记忆回溯的具身导航基础模型。在不改变底层架构的前提下，我们引入了历史表征（History Representation），将稀疏视觉关键帧与显式历史表征图（History Representation Map）相结合，以保留长期时空上下文。为进一步有效利用这一历史信息，我们提出了历史利用（History Utilization），一种结构化VQA监督协议，包含三类任务：任务阶段定位、探索一致性和时空目标检索，从而实现基于地图的推理和稳定的持久长时程导航。为支撑该系统，我们建立了完整的单目RGB视频标注流水线，并开源了一个大规模数据集，包含超过500小时的高质量真实世界交互数据和超过2000小时的标注网络视频。Compass 1主要在1米高度相机分布上进行训练，却能无缝泛化到多种具身形态和场景，涵盖室内环境到行人密集街道，跨越0.35米轮式机器人、0.5米四足机器狗、0.85米人形机器人和1.5米空中无人机。在开放世界评估中，Compass 1实现了79.4%的显著整体成功率，而最强基线仅为17.8%。在基础任务上，它展现出超过90%的卓越零样本执行能力，探索能力提升250%，并在具有挑战性的持久历史回溯任务中实现了从0%到58%的突破性跃升。

Authors: Hai Zhang, Siqi Liang, Yanjun Guo, Shoufeng Zhang, Yunhao Wang, Hangyu Du, Haoguang Mai, Hongchen Li, Jiazhi Yang, Jialong Zeng, Yu Hu, Chen Chen, Gangcheng Jiang, Zishun Zhuo, Lirui Zhao, Zhigang Li, Yu Qiao, Zhenjie Yang, Fu Zhang, Hongyang Li

DeltaForge: A Post-hoc Mixture-of-Experts VLA for Multi-Domain Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

post-hoc mixture-of-experts driving VLA weight merging domain generalization SVD decomposition

简要说明：DeltaForge 提出了一种事后混合专家方法，通过将权重更新分解为共享和领域特定部分并训练轻量路由器，将多个领域特定的驾驶 VLA 模型整合为单一高效的多领域模型，在多种驾驶领域中以低成本接近专家精度。

TLDR: DeltaForge introduces a post-hoc mixture-of-experts approach to consolidate multiple domain-specific driving VLA models into a single efficient multi-domain model by decomposing weight updates into shared and domain-specific components and training lightweight routers, achieving near-expert accuracy across diverse driving domains at low cost.

Abstract: Fleets of driving vision-language-action (VLA) models are developed one domain at a time: each operator finetunes a shared base model on private data, producing specialized experts that are costly to consolidate into a single model. Weight merging loses accuracy as heterogeneous domains accumulate, and dense mixture-of-experts routing is prohibitively expensive to combine them. We present DeltaForge, to our knowledge the first post-hoc mixture-of-experts VLA for driving, which consolidates N independently finetuned per-domain models into a single multi-domain model from their weights and a small proxy set alone. When different operators finetune the same base model, their weight updates end up sharing a lot of structure. We exploit this by decomposing all the updates together using singular value decomposition (SVD), splitting each one into a shared part (the same across all domains) and a tiny domain-specific part. The router then only needs to work with those tiny domain-specific pieces, not the full expert weights, which is what keeps the approach efficient. Then two cooperating clip-level blind routers, one over the VLM reasoning experts and one over the flow-matching dynamics experts, are trained from soft labels on the proxy dataset. Across six diverse domains spanning urban, off-road, and highway driving on cars, trucks, and all-terrain vehicles (ATVs), DeltaForge approaches the accuracy of the per-domain experts and surpasses every merging, routing, centralized, and federated baseline at close to single-model parameter and compute cost. Adding a new domain requires only projecting its weight update onto the shared basis with no end-to-end retraining needed. The resulting model also generalizes to domain combinations it was never explicitly trained on.

摘要（中文）：摘要：驾驶视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的车队通常是逐领域开发的：每位运营者在其私有数据上微调共享的基础模型，产生各自领域的专家模型，而将这些模型整合为单一模型往往成本高昂。权重合并会因异构领域的累积而损失精度，而稠密混合专家路由在组合这些模型时计算开销过大。我们提出DeltaForge，据我们所知，这是首个用于驾驶的事后混合专家VLA模型，它仅凭各领域独立微调模型的权重和一个小型代理数据集，即可将N个领域专属模型整合为单一多领域模型。当不同运营者对同一基础模型进行微调时，其权重更新往往共享大量结构。我们利用这一特性，通过奇异值分解（SVD）将所有更新联合分解，将其拆分为共享部分（各领域一致）和极小的领域特定部分。路由网络因此只需处理这些微小的领域特定片段而非完整专家权重，这正是该方法保持高效的关键。随后，两个协同工作的片段级盲路由——一个负责VLM推理专家，另一个负责流匹配动力学专家——借助代理数据集上的软标签进行训练。在涵盖城市、越野和高速公路驾驶，以及轿车、卡车和全地形车（ATV）的六个多样化领域上，DeltaForge接近各领域专家模型的精度，同时在几乎等同于单一模型的参数量和计算成本下，超越了所有合并、路由、集中式及联邦式基线方法。新增领域时，仅需将其权重更新投影至共享基空间，无需端到端重训练。所得模型还能泛化到从未显式训练过的领域组合。

Authors: Bingzhang Wang, Mo Poorsartep, Yasaman Esfandiari

APS-VLA: Action-Guided and Future-Aware Token Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

vision-language-action models token pruning efficient robotic control action-guided selection future-aware objective

简要说明：APS-VLA 提出了一种即插即用的视觉 token 剪枝框架，通过从演示中学习动作引导和未来感知的 token 选择，在保持任务成功率的同时降低 VLA 模型的推理延迟。

TLDR: APS-VLA introduces a plug-in visual token pruning framework for Vision-Language-Action models, learning action-guided and future-aware token selection from demonstrations to reduce inference latency while maintaining task success in robotic manipulation.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies have demonstrated strong generalization in robotic manipulation, yet processing dense visual tokens often incurs high inference latency. Visual token pruning offers a practical way to reduce this cost, but identifying a compact set of tokens that preserves reliable action generation remains challenging. Existing methods largely rely on static or immediate heuristic cues to estimate token importance. We introduce APS-VLA, a framework that learns visual token selection from robot demonstrations while keeping the pretrained VLA backbone frozen. A lightweight Decision Influence Estimator scores tokens conditioned on current visual observations, language instructions, and robot proprioception. Its training combines two complementary signals: action supervision matches both the full-input policy predictions and demonstrated actions, while an auxiliary visual transition objective uses demonstrated actions to predict subsequent visual features from the selected representation. At deployment, the estimator performs a single hard selection and packing step before the policy's native action-generation procedure; the auxiliary predictor is removed. Experiments with OpenVLA-OFT on LIBERO and with $π_{0.5}$ and XR-1 on RoboCasa365 demonstrate inference acceleration with modest changes in task success. Across five real-world tasks on two dual-arm platforms, APS-VLA reduces mean policy inference latency from 137.25 to 93.25 ms, achieving a $1.47\times$ speedup with an average success rate of 61%, compared with 60% for the unpruned baseline. Together, these results support APS-VLA as a modular, plug-in framework for efficient robotic control across VLA architectures, preserving the underlying policy parameters and native action-generation procedure.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略已在机器人操作中展现出强大的泛化能力，然而处理密集的视觉令牌往往带来较高的推理延迟。视觉令牌剪枝提供了一种降低该成本的实际途径，但如何识别出一组紧凑且能保持可靠动作生成的令牌仍具挑战。现有方法大多依赖静态或即时启发式线索来估计令牌的重要性。我们提出APS-VLA，一种从机器人演示中学习视觉令牌选择、同时保持预训练VLA骨干网络冻结的框架。轻量级的决策影响估计器根据当前视觉观测、语言指令和机器人本体感知对令牌进行评分。其训练结合了两类互补信号：动作监督既匹配全输入策略预测，也匹配演示动作；辅助的视觉转移目标则利用演示动作从所选表示中预测后续视觉特征。在部署阶段，估计器在策略原生动作生成流程之前执行一次硬选择与打包步骤；辅助预测器被移除。在LIBERO上使用OpenVLA-OFT，以及在RoboCasa365上使用π₀.₅和XR-1进行的实验表明，在任务成功率变化不大的情况下实现了推理加速。在两个双臂平台上的五项真实世界任务中，APS-VLA将平均策略推理延迟从137.25毫秒降至93.25毫秒，实现1.47倍加速，平均成功率为61%，而未剪枝基线为60%。综合这些结果，APS-VLA可作为一种模块化、即插即用的高效机器人控制框架，适用于多种VLA架构，同时保留底层策略参数和原生动作生成流程。

Authors: Xiaoyang Xing, Chun-Mei Feng, Anthony Cohn, Xiaoliang Gong, Asoke Nandi

DriveFoundry: Co-Evolving Data and Model for Efficient Closed-Loop Iteration in Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

closed-loop data engine adaptive inference VLA latent refill

简要说明：DriveFoundry 提出了一个闭环自动驾驶框架，将结构化因果数据改进与自适应推理相结合，并采用统一的视觉语言动作模型（Xiaomi-Drive-o1），通过块级潜在回填和学习计算价值头，在仿真和实车测试中表现出色。

TLDR: DriveFoundry introduces a closed-loop autonomous driving framework that co-evolves structured causal data refinement with adaptive inference, featuring a unified VLA-based model (Xiaomi-Drive-o1) with block-wise latent refill and a learned value-of-computation head, demonstrating strong performance in simulation and real-vehicle tests.

Abstract: A driving foundation model must learn reusable decision knowledge from rare critical events and apply it under strict runtime constraints. We introduce DriveFoundry, a closed-loop framework improving iteration efficiency under data and computation budgets by coupling structured causal data refinement with adaptive inference. The Data Engine builds traceable scene-candidate records linking scene evidence and factor-decision relations to candidate trajectories and outcome assessments. Candidate comparisons and counterfactual annotations clarify how scene factors affect behavioral feasibility and preference. Verified model failures guide VLM-assisted annotation and expert correction, refining training data and annotation systems. The model engine, Xiaomi-Drive-o1, unifies Perception, Causation, Action, World, and Value within a shared vision-language backbone to enable cross-task knowledge transfer. Block-wise latent refill passes candidate-specific evidence and predicted visual consequences between task blocks, connecting scene understanding, planning, and evaluation. A learned value-of-computation head selects tasks and allocates latent tokens based on expected benefit and cost, adapting inference to each decision. On PhysicalAI, the 9B model achieves the lowest ADE@1 across evaluated splits and horizons among tested models. In AlpaSim, it outperforms Alpamayo 1.5 across all metrics and achieves lower close-encounter and off-road rates than the 34B Alpamayo 2 Super, while trailing in progress and AlpaSim scores. For the 0.8B variant, joint training reduces 5 s minADE@6 by about 54% without altering the inference path or token budget. Adaptive inference matches full reasoning performance using only 28% of tokens. Real-vehicle tests confirm runtime feasibility, supporting a unified paradigm for learning from critical experience and dynamically allocating computation.

摘要（中文）：驾驶基础模型必须从罕见的关键事件中学习可复用的决策知识，并在严格的运行时约束下加以应用。我们提出DriveFoundry，一种闭环框架，通过将结构化的因果数据精炼与自适应推理相结合，在数据和计算预算受限的条件下提升迭代效率。数据引擎构建可追溯的场景-候选记录，将场景证据及因素-决策关系与候选轨迹和结果评估相连接。候选比较与反事实标注阐明了场景因素如何影响行为可行性与偏好。经验证的模型失败案例引导基于视觉语言模型的辅助标注和专家修正，从而优化训练数据与标注体系。模型引擎Xiaomi-Drive-o1在统一的视觉-语言骨干网络内融合感知、因果、行动、世界与价值五大模块，实现跨任务知识迁移。分块潜变量回填机制在任务块之间传递候选特异的证据及预测视觉结果，衔接场景理解、规划与评估。学习得到的计算价值头根据预期收益与成本选择任务并分配潜变量token，使推理过程自适应于每个决策。在PhysicalAI上，9B模型在评测的分割片段与预测时域中取得了最低的ADE@1。在AlpaSim中，该模型在所有指标上优于Alpamayo 1.5，并在近距离接近率和偏离道路率上低于34B的Alpamayo 2 Super，但在进度和AlpaSim得分上仍有所不及。对于0.8B变体，联合训练在不改变推理路径或token预算的情况下，将5秒minADE@6降低了约54%。自适应推理仅使用28%的token即可达到完整推理性能。实车测试验证了运行时可行性，支持从关键经验中学习并动态分配计算资源的统一范式。

Authors: Ziyang Yao, Yuncheng Jiang, Fang Li, Haochen Liu, Shaoqing Xu, Wen Zhang, Xiangyang Chu, Zibin Guo, Jiale Hou, Chuang Wan, Jia Hua, Gengzhao Xiang, Xiaoran Luo, Chong He, Yuechen Luo, Junzhe Wang, Zhiyu Sun, Jun Zhang, Wei Li, Lei Li, Hongwei Xie, Bing Wang, Yuannan Shen, Jianwei Cui, Guang Chen, Hangjun Ye, Jingwei Zhao

VLA Adaptation with Real and Simulated Data: A Case Study on Robotic Chess VLA

VLA fine-tuning sim-to-real data scaling model selection robotic chess

简要说明：本文以机器人国际象棋任务为例，研究了VLA模型（π0.5）微调中数据量、更新预算、学习率冷却和模拟预训练的影响，并报告了多种自我改进方法未获提升的负面结果。

TLDR: This paper studies the fine-tuning of a VLA model (π0.5) for a robotic chess manipulation task, examining the effects of data scale, update budgets, learning-rate cool-down, and simulated pretraining, while also reporting a null result for several self-improvement methods.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are trained as general-purpose foundation models for robot learning, and require fine-tuning for each downstream task and robot. This raises practical questions such as how much data and training updates are needed, how checkpoints should be selected, and whether simulation can be leveraged to alleviate the cost of real data collection. We study these questions on a task that requires both precise manipulation and spatial understanding of the scene. In this task, an SO-101 arm moves a chess king between two squares that are given only by their names, such as e4 and a5. We fine-tune $π_{0.5}$ with various dataset sizes and update budgets, using teleoperated demonstrations as well as simulated demonstrations from a randomized scripted expert that imitates the variability of human demonstrations. In simulation, the success rate scales with both data and updates. Importantly, we find that a short learning-rate cool-down adds up to 31 points and is necessary for comparing checkpoints, and that validation loss and action error are unreliable for model selection. On the real arm, we fine-tune on up to 256 teleoperated demonstrations and evaluate ten policies in 25 trials each. Partial results indicate that pretraining on the simulated demonstrations helps substantially, most clearly when real data is scarce. We also present a negative result, in which training on the policy's own rollouts with filtered behavior cloning, RECAP-style advantage conditioning, corrections from an automatic coach, or residual reinforcement learning did not yield a measurable improvement over plain behavior cloning in our setting. We release the simulator, the expert and the real demonstrations.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型作为机器人学习的通用基础模型进行训练，需要针对每个下游任务和机器人进行微调。这带来了一些实际问题，例如需要多少数据和训练更新次数、如何选择检查点，以及能否利用仿真来降低真实数据采集的成本。我们在一个既需要精细操作又需要对场景进行空间理解的任务中研究了这些问题。在该任务中，SO-101机械臂需要在仅给出名称（如e4和a5）的两个棋盘格之间移动一枚国际象棋王。我们使用遥操作示范以及来自随机化脚本专家的仿真示范（该专家模仿人类示范的变异性），以多种数据集规模和更新预算对$π_{0.5}$进行微调。在仿真中，成功率随数据和更新次数的增加而提升。重要的是，我们发现短暂的学习率冷却阶段可带来高达31个百分点的提升，并且是对检查点进行比较所必需的；同时，验证损失和动作误差在模型选择方面并不可靠。在真实机械臂上，我们使用多达256次遥操作示范进行微调，并对十种策略各进行25次试验评估。部分结果表明，在仿真示范上进行预训练有显著帮助，尤其是在真实数据稀缺时效果最为明显。我们还报告了一个负面结果：在我们的设定中，使用策略自身轨迹进行训练，无论采用过滤行为克隆、RECAP风格优势条件、自动教练的修正，还是残差强化学习，均未比普通行为克隆产生可测量的改进。我们公开了仿真器、专家策略和真实示范数据。

Authors: Matěj Kripner, Milan Straka

Bridging Task Planning and Execution for Language-Conditioned Bimanual Manipulation Manipulation

vision-language manipulation bimanual manipulation task planning execution-aware humanoid robot

简要说明：本文提出一个零样本视觉语言框架，用于双机械臂操作，联合推理任务目标和物理可行性，通过结构化场景表示和分层验证提高任务成功率并支持恢复。

TLDR: This paper presents a zero-shot vision-language framework that jointly reasons about task objectives and physical feasibility for bimanual manipulation on a humanoid robot, using structured scene representations and hierarchical validation to improve task success and recovery.

Abstract: Robots are increasingly expected to execute natural-language manipulation tasks in real-world environments. This is particularly relevant in household assistance and logistics, where clutter requires reasoning about both task objectives and execution feasibility. This challenge becomes even more pronounced for bimanual humanoid platforms, where coordinating two manipulators introduces additional interaction and kinematic constraints. We present a zero-shot vision-language framework for execution-aware bimanual manipulation that jointly reasons about task objectives and physical feasibility. Planning is grounded in a structured scene representation that combines semantic object relations with execution constraints, enabling the selection of obstacle relocations and execution choices while preserving task semantics. Compatible actions are organised into parallel bimanual stages with explicit pre- and post-conditions. A hierarchical validator evaluates these conditions under perceptual uncertainty and uses stage-level execution history to support local recovery or targeted replanning. Experiments on the CENTAURO hybrid wheeled-legged humanoid robot across nine language-conditioned manipulation scenarios show higher task success than a non-execution-aware baseline. In dedicated failure scenarios, hierarchical validation recovers from execution failures with fewer model queries than always replanning. These results demonstrate the benefits of combining execution reasoning directly into task planning. Videos and additional material are available on the Project Webpage: https://advrhumanoids.github.io/bridging-planning-execution/.

摘要（中文）：机器人正越来越多地被期望在真实环境中执行自然语言操控任务，这在家庭辅助和物流领域尤为突出。在这些场景中，杂乱的环境要求系统同时推理任务目标与执行的可行性。对于双臂人形平台而言，这一挑战更为显著，因为双臂协调引入了额外的交互与运动学约束。我们提出了一种零样本视觉-语言框架，用于实现具备执行感知的双臂操控，该框架联合推理任务目标与物理可行性。规划过程基于一种结构化场景表示，将语义物体关系与执行约束相结合，从而在保持任务语义的同时，支持障碍物重新放置和执行选择的决策。兼容的动作被组织为并行的双臂阶段，并带有明确的前置和后置条件。一个分层验证器在感知不确定性条件下评估这些条件，并利用阶段级执行历史来支持局部恢复或定向重新规划。在CENTAURO混合轮腿式人形机器人上开展的九项语言条件化操控场景实验中，该方法展示了比不具备执行感知的基线更高的任务成功率。在专门设计的失败场景中，分层验证在恢复执行失败时比始终重新规划所需的模型查询次数更少。这些结果证明了将执行推理直接整合进任务规划的优越性。视频及更多材料可在项目网页获取：https://advrhumanoids.github.io/bridging-planning-execution/。

Authors: Emanuele Cuzzocrea, Giuseppina Iannotti, Luca Rossini, Arturo Laurenzi, Nikos Tsagarakis

PCTac: Mechanochromic Photonic-Crystal Tactile Sensor for Dexterous Manipulation Manipulation

tactile sensor photonic crystal diffusion policy dexterous manipulation closed-loop control

简要说明：PCTac 提出了一种基于力致变色光子晶体的触觉传感器，将法向载荷编码为色调场，并直接集成到扩散策略中用于真实机器人灵巧操作，优于 RGB 和纯视觉基线。

TLDR: PCTac introduces a mechanochromic photonic-crystal tactile sensor that encodes normal load as a hue field and integrates the representation into a Diffusion Policy for closed-loop dexterous manipulation, outperforming RGB and vision-only baselines on real-robot tasks.

Abstract: Modern visuotactile sensors primarily sense contact by imaging the deformation of a compliant interface. Using techniques such as photometric stereo, they can recover detailed contact geometry, often represented as surface normals or depth. However, force-related information typically still needs to be inferred indirectly through calibration, geometric reconstruction, or learned mappings. Mechanochromic photonic-crystal (PC) materials offer an alternative physical encoding mechanism: contact loading changes their periodic microstructure and spectral response, directly transforming local stress into a spatially resolved structural-color field. Despite this potential, PC materials have rarely been explored as visuotactile sensors for closed-loop robot learning. We present PCTac, an open-source mechanochromic PC fingertip that uses a dense hue field as its tactile observation. Loading characterization demonstrates a repeatable relationship between the applied normal load and the observed hue response. We further integrate this representation directly into a Diffusion Policy and evaluate it on three real-robot manipulation tasks. Across 90 physical rollouts, PCTac Hue achieves 68 successes (75.6\%), compared with 60 (66.7\%) for PCTac RGB, 57 (63.3\%) for Wedge RGB, and 29 (32.2\%) for vision-only. PCTac Hue also achieves the highest observed success rate on each evaluated task, including Perturbed Test-Tube Insertion, where it achieves 16/30 successes versus 13/30 for tactile RGB baselines and 1/30 for vision-only. These results demonstrate the potential of mechanochromic structural color as a compact, load-sensitive tactile representation for robot learning and closed-loop manipulation. Project page: https://bey0ndt1me.github.io/PCTac-page/.

摘要（中文）：现代视触觉传感器主要通过成像软性界面的形变来感知接触。借助光度立体视觉等技术，它们能够恢复详细的接触几何信息，通常以表面法线或深度表示。然而，与力相关的信息通常仍需通过标定、几何重建或学习映射来间接推断。机械变色光子晶体材料提供了一种替代性的物理编码机制：接触载荷改变其周期性微结构和光谱响应，直接将局部应力转化为空间分辨的结构色场。尽管具有这一潜力，光子晶体材料在闭环机器人学习中的应用却鲜有探索。我们提出PCTac，一种开源的机械变色光子晶体指尖传感器，使用密集色调场作为其触觉观测。载荷特性测试表明，施加的法向载荷与观测到的色调响应之间存在可重复的关系。我们进一步将该表示直接集成到扩散策略中，并在三项真实机器人操作任务上进行了评估。在90次实际 rollout 中，PCTac Hue 取得了68次成功（75.6%），而 PCTac RGB 为60次（66.7%），Wedge RGB 为57次（63.3%），纯视觉为29次（32.2%）。PCTac Hue 还在每项评估任务上取得了最高成功率，包括扰动试管插入任务，其中取得16/30次成功，而触觉RGB基线为13/30次，纯视觉仅为1/30次。这些结果表明，机械变色结构色作为一种紧凑、对载荷敏感的触觉表示，在机器人学习和闭环操作中具有巨大潜力。项目页面：https://bey0ndt1me.github.io/PCTac-page/。

Authors: Ruilin Zhang, Xuanshuo Liu, Junzhe Dai, Kefei Wu, Xuhao Qin, Ziyuan Jiao, Wanlin Li, Yurui Qu, Chenxi Xiao

AutoVLA-D: Learn a Trajectory-Geometric Condition from Reasoning for Autonomous Driving VLA AutonomousDriving

Trajectory-Geometric Condition Autoregressive VLA Planning Two-Stage Training Discrete Trajectory Closed-Loop Driving

简要说明：AutoVLA-D 提出了 TrajCond，一种离散轨迹几何条件，通过两阶段轨迹条件生成来改进自动驾驶中的自回归 VLA 规划，在多个驾驶基准上持续提升连续轨迹预测性能。

TLDR: AutoVLA-D introduces TrajCond, a discrete trajectory-geometric condition, to improve autoregressive VLA planning for autonomous driving by learning a two-stage trajectory-conditioned generation before continuous trajectory prediction, demonstrating consistent improvements across driving benchmarks.

Abstract: Autoregressive VLA planning usually predicts continuous trajectories as the final output, but driving instructions often describe actions rather than ego states, which weakens direct conditioning on the final continuous trajectory. We address this gap with TrajCond, which introduces a discrete trajectory-geometric condition for VLA planning. Specifically, we represent TrajCond as a 1D-Brohan differential action trajectory and learn it with a two-stage training framework before final continuous trajectory prediction. With the simultaneous autoregressive generation of discrete and numeric trajectories, we name our method AutoVLA-D (Double). Experiments on NAVSIM navtest, nuScenes, and NeuroNCAP show that discrete trajectories are weaker as direct outputs but more effective as TrajCond, consistently improving final continuous trajectory prediction across closed-loop and open-loop driving benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/ShivaTeam/AutoVLA-D.

摘要（中文）：自回归视觉语言模型（VLA）规划通常将连续轨迹预测作为最终输出，但驾驶指令往往描述的是行为而非自车状态，这削弱了对最终连续轨迹的直接条件约束。针对这一问题，我们提出了TrajCond方法，在VLA规划中引入离散轨迹几何条件。具体而言，我们将TrajCond表示为1D-Brohan微分作用轨迹，并采用两阶段训练框架进行学习，随后再进行最终连续轨迹预测。通过离散与数值轨迹的同步自回归生成，我们将该方法命名为AutoVLA-D（双重）。在NAVSIM navtest、nuScenes和NeuroNCAP上的实验表明，离散轨迹作为直接输出时性能较弱，但作为TrajCond条件时更为有效，能够在闭环与开环驾驶基准上持续提升最终连续轨迹预测的精度。代码已公开于https://github.com/ShivaTeam/AutoVLA-D。

Authors: Yuguang Yang, Zhewen Tan, Canyu Chen, Linlin Yang, Cheng Chi, Chunyang Liu, Kehua Sheng, Jinyu Yang, Baochang Zhan, Bo Zhang, Yan Wang, Xianbin Cao

Be My Eye: Learning to See Beyond a Robot's Own Perspective VLA

multi-robot collaboration active context sharing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) task-oriented compression communication-constrained

简要说明：本文提出一种面向任务的多机器人主动上下文共享框架，将观测压缩为紧凑表征并集成到预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略中，在受限通信预算下通过仿真和真实双机器人实验验证了性能提升。

TLDR: This paper proposes a task-oriented active context sharing framework that compresses robot observations for multi-robot collaboration and integrates them into a pretrained VLA policy, demonstrating performance gains in simulated and real dual-robot tasks under constrained communication budgets.

Abstract: Robots operating in the real world are inherently subject to partial observability, particularly in multi-robot collaboration, where individual observations may be insufficient for effective task execution. A key challenge is leveraging complementary observations from partner robots to support collaborative decision-making. We argue that information sharing should go beyond passively transmitting raw observations or generic visual features. Instead, robots should selectively encode task-relevant information according to task objectives and execution progress. To this end, we propose a task-oriented active context sharing framework that transforms robot observations into compact representations, preserving critical information under constrained communication budgets. The framework adopts a two-stage training paradigm. In the first stage, onboard observations and task instructions are jointly encoded into compact context representations. Task-oriented future prediction and soft task-progress correspondence learning guide this collaboration-agnostic compression, preserving information about task objectives and execution progress. In the second stage, the learned representations are integrated into a pretrained Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policy, enabling bidirectional context exchange. Each robot combines complementary partner information with local observations to guide action generation. Action supervision jointly refines the context representations and policy, aligning information sharing with collaborative decision-making. Controlled experiments demonstrate substantial performance gains under constrained communication budgets, while three real-world experiments validate the framework in complex dual-robot tasks. These results highlight a shift from passive visual transmission toward active, task-oriented context sharing that directly supports collaborative decision-making.

摘要（中文）：在真实世界中运行的机器人本质上受到部分可观测性的限制，尤其是在多机器人协作场景下，单一个体的观测信息往往不足以支撑高效的任务执行。一个关键挑战在于如何利用伙伴机器人的互补观测信息来支持协作决策。我们认为，信息共享不应仅限于被动传输原始观测数据或通用视觉特征，而应依据任务目标与执行进度，有选择性地编码与任务相关的信息。为此，我们提出了一种面向任务驱动的主动上下文共享框架，该框架将机器人观测信息转化为紧凑表示，在有限通信带宽约束下保留关键信息。该框架采用两阶段训练范式：第一阶段，将机载观测与任务指令联合编码为紧凑的上下文表示，通过面向任务的未来预测与软任务进度对应学习，引导这种与协作无关的压缩过程，从而保留关于任务目标与执行进度的关键信息；第二阶段，将学习到的表示集成到预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略中，实现双向上下文交互。每个机器人将伙伴提供的互补信息与自身局部观测相结合，以指导动作生成。动作监督信号联合优化上下文表示与策略，使信息共享与协作决策紧密对齐。受控实验表明，在有限通信带宽条件下，该方法取得了显著的性能提升；同时，三项真实世界实验在复杂双机器人任务中验证了该框架的有效性。上述结果凸显了从被动的视觉传输向主动、面向任务的上下文共享转变，从而直接支撑协作决策的研究方向。

Authors: Baifu Huang, Shilin Fang, Jianan Wang

Robo-MLT: Dual-System Robotic Manipulation for Long-Horizon Medical Laboratory Tasks VLA

vision-language-action model long-horizon manipulation workflow monitoring medical laboratory automation replanning

简要说明：Robo-MLT 是一个用于长期医疗实验室操作任务的双系统框架，它将显式的视觉语言工作流监控与技能条件下的视觉语言动作策略生成相结合，在血气分析和试管分类任务中实现了更高的成功率和恢复能力。

TLDR: Robo-MLT is a dual-system framework for long-horizon medical laboratory manipulation tasks that couples explicit vision-language workflow monitoring with skill-conditioned vision-language-action policy generation, achieving higher success and recovery rates on blood gas analysis and tube sorting tasks.

Abstract: Reliable medical laboratory automation requires robots to complete entire workflows in protocol order while handling changes during execution. A robot may execute each motion correctly yet fail the workflow by confusing visually similar stages or stalling after human intervention. We present Robo-MLT, a dual-system framework that couples explicit workflow monitoring with learned action generation. A vision--language planner composes an ordered atomic-skill sequence from the protocol and the initial workspace observation. A multiframe execution monitor detects when the active skill has completed or become infeasible, then advances the workflow or triggers replanning. A skill-conditioned vision--language--action policy generates the manipulation trajectories, and an asynchronous runtime coordinates it with the monitor. We evaluate Robo-MLT against four policy baselines and a VLM-based monitor baseline on blood gas analysis and blood sample tube sorting, with 50 nominal configurations per method and 20 sample-removal configurations. Robo-MLT achieves task success rates of 82\% and 70\%, exceeding $π_{0.5}$ by 30 and 22 percentage points, respectively. After an operator removes the sample being handled, the system revises the remaining plan and continues processing the other samples. These results indicate that, under the evaluated conditions, explicit workflow monitoring makes long-horizon laboratory manipulation more reliable and recoverable.

摘要（中文）：可靠的医学实验室自动化要求机器人在按协议顺序完成整个工作流程的同时，处理执行过程中出现的变化。机器人可能正确执行每一个动作，却因混淆视觉上相似的阶段或在人工干预后停滞而导致整个流程失败。我们提出了Robo-MLT，一种将显式工作流监控与学习型动作生成相结合的双系统框架。视觉-语言规划器根据协议和初始工作区观测结果编排有序的原子技能序列。多帧执行监控器检测当前技能是否已完成或变得不可行，然后推进工作流或触发重新规划。技能条件下的视觉-语言-动作策略生成操作轨迹，异步运行时负责协调其与监控器之间的配合。我们在血气分析和血液样本试管分拣任务上，将Robo-MLT与四种策略基线及一种基于VLM的监控基线进行了评估，每种方法包含50个标称配置和20个样本移除配置。Robo-MLT的任务成功率分别达到82%和70%，较π₀.₅高出30和22个百分点。当操作员移除正在处理的样本后，系统会修正剩余计划并继续处理其他样本。这些结果表明，在评估条件下，显式工作流监控使长时程实验室操作更加可靠且更易恢复。

Authors: Zequan Zeng, Kai Wang, Delvin Ce Zhang, Huaping Liu, Zhipeng Yuan, Junqin Yang, YunLong Zhang

RoboACE: Adversarial Co-Evolution for Robot Self-Improvement VLA

adversarial co-evolution curriculum learning execution harness VLA controller LIBERO

简要说明：RoboACE 提出了一种框架，通过对抗性协同进化，在冻结基础模型周围共同演化课程和执行工具，以提升机器人自我改进能力和 LIBERO 基准性能。

TLDR: RoboACE introduces a framework that jointly evolves a curriculum and execution harness around frozen foundation models, using adversarial co-evolution to improve robot self-improvement and performance on LIBERO benchmarks.

Abstract: Robot agents can improve reusable skills, planning procedures, and recovery strategies from execution feedback, yet a fixed practice source leaves the search for new weaknesses unchanged. Useful practice depends on the agent's current capabilities, so the procedure that chooses practice must also be revisable. We present RoboACE (Robot Adversarial Co-Evolution), a framework that jointly evolves curriculum and execution harnesses around frozen foundation models. The curriculum harness uses accumulated capability evidence to propose informative challenges, while the execution harness responds with reusable revisions that expand execution capabilities. Alternating updates hold one side fixed as the other changes, and admitted challenges form fixed snapshots for comparing execution revisions. Starting from a compact set of LIBERO practice conditions, the resulting frozen deployment outperforms the evaluated controllers and agent systems across four LIBERO-family panels. On LIBERO-PRO, it reaches 74.0% success, exceeding the initial deployment by 15.0 percentage points and direct execution by its VLA controller by 13.5 points. Case studies document changes to evidence-guided practice selection, drawer-skill grounding, and controller intervention.

摘要（中文）：机器人智能体能够从执行反馈中改进可复用技能、规划流程与恢复策略，但固定的练习来源使得对新弱点的搜索保持不变。有效的练习取决于智能体当前的能力，因此选择练习的程序也必须是可修订的。我们提出RoboACE（机器人对抗性协同演化）框架，该框架围绕冻结的基础模型联合演化课程与执行框架。课程框架利用累积的能力证据提出具有信息量的挑战，而执行框架则以可复用的修订进行回应，从而扩展执行能力。交替更新使一方固定而另一方变化，已通过的挑战形成固定快照，用于比较执行修订的效果。从一组精简的LIBERO练习条件出发，所得到的冻结部署在四个LIBERO系列测试面板上均优于所评估的控制器和智能体系统。在LIBERO-PRO上，其成功率达到了74.0%，比初始部署高出15.0个百分点，比其VLA控制器的直接执行高出13.5个百分点。案例研究记录了证据引导的练习选择、抽屉技能基础化以及控制器干预方面的变化。

Authors: Delin Zhao, Zhengrong Yue, Junlin He, Yali Wang

Embodied First Exam VLA

coding agents robotics benchmark multi-robot dexterous manipulation evaluation framework

简要说明：本文提出了“具身首次考试”，一个全面的基准，用于评估编码代理在多种机器人控制任务上的表现，发现最强代理的成功率仅为34%，表明仍有很大的改进空间。

TLDR: The paper introduces the Embodied First Exam, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating coding agents on diverse robot control tasks, finding that even the strongest agent achieves only 34% success, highlighting significant room for improvement.

Abstract: Early successes on agentic robotics point to a potential paradigm shift toward using coding agents to control robots. Existing robotics benchmarks are built around visuomotor policy learning, leaving it open whether coding agents can reliably control diverse robots under physical-world constraints. We therefore introduce the Embodied First Exam, a unified, comprehensive, and agent-native evaluation framework where coding agents can choose their own control approach: direct control, code to control, or train a policy to control. We hope it serves as a first exam for coding agents before they enter the physical world, with 1,156 tasks in 35 suites on 47 robots, including 9 new suites that go beyond pick-and-place to spatial puzzles, dexterous manipulation, multi-robot interaction, dynamic whole-body control, and sim-to-sim engineering. Each task can be run in up to three evaluation settings. The Standard Setting mimics the real world: the agent receives only sensor observations and, by default, cannot reset the environment. Its Realtime variant keeps the environment running while the agent reasons. The Privileged Setting gives the agent access to the full simulator state and unlimited resets, allowing it to search for an oracle solution for training purposes. Success rates in this setting serve as an approximate upper bound. On the 456 core tasks, the strongest of eight agents, GPT-6 Astra in Codex, achieves a success rate of 34% in the Standard Setting, leaving much room for improvement. To see where agents fail, we label the stage at which failed attempts go wrong and compare failures across agents, settings, and stage categories.

摘要（中文）：早期在智能体机器人领域的成功进展，预示着一种潜在的范式转变——即利用编程智能体来控制机器人。现有的机器人基准测试主要围绕视觉运动策略学习构建，对于编程智能体能否在物理世界约束下可靠地控制多种机器人，这一问题仍悬而未决。为此，我们提出了“具身第一考”，一个统一、全面且面向智能体原生的评估框架，允许编程智能体自行选择控制方式：直接控制、代码控制或训练策略进行控制。我们希望这能成为编程智能体进入物理世界前的首次考核，涵盖47种机器人上的35个任务套件、共1156项任务，其中包括9个超越抓取放置任务的新套件，涉及空间拼图、灵巧操作、多机器人交互、动态全身控制以及仿真到仿真工程。每项任务最多可在三种评估设置下运行。标准设置模拟真实世界：智能体仅接收传感器观测，且默认无法重置环境。其实时变体在智能体推理期间保持环境持续运行。特权设置则允许智能体访问完整的模拟器状态并无限制重置，使其能够搜索用于训练的神谕式解决方案，该设置下的成功率可视为近似上限。在456项核心任务中，八种智能体中表现最强的Codex环境中的GPT-6 Astra在标准设置下仅达到34%的成功率，仍有很大提升空间。为探究智能体的失败原因，我们标记了失败尝试出错的阶段，并跨智能体、设置和阶段类别对失败情况进行比较。

Authors: Kangrui Wang, Qineng Wang, Changhe Chen, Pingyue Zhang, Chi Gui, Feishi Wang, Canyu Chen, Wenli Xiao, Xiaoyu Huang, Tonghe Zhang, Linjie Li, Zihan Wang, Minyeong Kim, Yiyou Sun, Mingkai Deng, Jinyu Hou, Qi Zhu, Han Liu, Eric P. Xing, Huaxiu Yao, Zhiwen Fan, Yuejiang Liu, Dawn Song, Pieter Abbeel, Li Fei-Fei, Jiajun Wu, Yuke Zhu, Guanya Shi, Ruohan Zhang, Manling Li

GeoMind: A Benchmark for Spatial Understanding in Robotic Manipulation Manipulation

spatial understanding robotic manipulation benchmark spatial reasoning spatial memory

简要说明：GeoMind 是一个用于评估机器人操作中空间理解的基准，包含54个任务变体，测试空间推理和空间记忆，并提供自动生成和标注任务实例的流程。评估显示现有具身代理在空间跟踪和将几何约束转化为动作方面存在不足。

TLDR: GeoMind is a benchmark for evaluating spatial understanding in robotic manipulation, comprising 54 task variants that test spatial reasoning and memory, with a scalable pipeline for generating annotated task instances. Evaluations show that current embodied agents struggle with spatial tracking and converting geometric constraints to actions.

Abstract: Robotic manipulation has advanced rapidly in mapping visual observations and language instructions to actions. However, reliable manipulation in open-world environments requires robust spatial understanding: the ability to identify targets in complex layouts (spatial reasoning) and adapt to scenes that continuously evolve through interaction (spatial memory). Yet existing embodied benchmarks fall short in evaluating spatial understanding: they often introduce strong visual cues that bypass spatial reasoning, and focus on static scenes that offer little insight into an agent's capacity for spatial memory. To address this gap, we introduce GeoMind, a systematic benchmark for structured spatial understanding through tabletop manipulation. GeoMind comprises 54 evaluated task variants organized around spatial reasoning and spatial memory. It also incorporates a scalable pipeline that automates the generation and annotation of task instances with verified targets and executable interactions. Extensive evaluations across diverse embodied agents reveal their consistent weaknesses in spatial understanding. Our findings highlight that these agents struggle to track identities after spatial changes and convert relational or geometric constraints into executable actions. We release the GeoMind benchmark at https://github.com/Notfound-JH/GEOMIND-benchmark.git.

摘要（中文）：机器人操作技术在将视觉观察和语言指令映射到行动方面取得了快速进展。然而，在开放世界环境中实现可靠操作需要强大的空间理解能力：即在复杂布局中识别目标的能力（空间推理），以及适应通过交互持续演变场景的能力（空间记忆）。然而，现有的具身基准在评估空间理解方面存在不足：它们往往引入强视觉线索以绕过空间推理，并且侧重于静态场景，无法深入洞察智能体的空间记忆能力。为弥补这一空白，我们提出了GeoMind，一个通过桌面操作进行结构化空间理解的系统性基准。GeoMind包含54个评估任务变体，围绕空间推理和空间记忆组织，并引入了一个可扩展的流水线，能够自动生成和标注具有验证目标及可执行交互的任务实例。对多种具身智能体的大规模评估揭示了它们在空间理解方面的一致弱点。研究结果表明，这些智能体在空间变化后追踪物体身份、以及将关系性或几何约束转化为可执行动作方面存在困难。我们在https://github.com/Notfound-JH/GEOMIND-benchmark.git发布了GeoMind基准。

Authors: Jinghe Wang, Xinrui Cao, Duo Wu, Chenghao Gu, Yong Zhong, Linjia Kang, Tianyi Xiong, Zhi Wang

GAP: Generalized Adaptation Prior for Dexterous Piano Playing Manipulation

dexterous manipulation sim-to-real transfer adaptation prior piano playing gradient guidance

简要说明：GAP提出了一种在仿真中预训练的适应先验，通过反馈调整弹奏动作，以样本高效的方式迁移到真实灵巧手，每首曲目仅需约7分钟硬件适应即可提升F1分数。

TLDR: GAP proposes a simulation-pretrained adaptation prior that learns to adjust piano-playing actions from feedback, enabling sample-efficient transfer to a real dexterous hand and improving F1 scores with only ~7 minutes of hardware adaptation per piece.

Abstract: Dexterous hands enable versatile manipulation, but policies trained in simulation often degrade on hardware owing to non-idealities, and the high-dimensional action space makes real-world adaptation costly. Piano playing, which requires precise and coordinated multifinger motion, offers a representative testbed. We propose GAP (Generalized Adaptation Prior for Dexterous Piano Playing), a sample-efficient adaptation framework that learns how to adapt, rather than how to act, during simulation pretraining and transfers this adaptation prior to hardware. Between repeated executions, GAP uses feedback to adjust the actions of the next one: a gradient guidance network learns from paired executions how adjusting actions affects playing performance, and its gradients guide these adjustments. In simulation, GAP yields approximately 2.4 times the F1 scores improvement of the existing fast-adaptation baseline for dexterous piano playing under the same interaction budget. The learned prior also generalizes to musical pieces held out from pretraining. On a physical dexterous hand, the same simulation-pretrained prior improves F1 scores by 3.6%-23% across three pieces of varying difficulty after approximately 7 min of adaptation each. These results suggest a practical route to reduce the real-world interaction needed to deploy dexterous hands.

摘要（中文）：灵巧手能够实现多种操作任务，但在仿真中训练的策略因非理想因素往往在硬件上表现下降，且高维动作空间使得真实世界中的适应成本高昂。钢琴演奏需要精确且协调的多指运动，为此提供了一个代表性测试平台。我们提出了GAP（面向灵巧钢琴演奏的泛化适应先验），一种样本高效的适应框架，在仿真预训练阶段学习“如何适应”而非“如何行动”，并将这一适应先验迁移至硬件。在重复执行之间，GAP利用反馈调整下一次执行的动作：梯度引导网络从成对执行中学习动作调整对演奏表现的影响，并以其梯度指导这些调整。在仿真中，GAP在相同交互预算下，灵巧钢琴演奏的F1分数提升约为现有快速适应基线的2.4倍。所学先验还能泛化至预训练中未涉及的乐曲。在物理灵巧手上，同一仿真预训练先验在三首难度不同的曲目上，经过每次约7分钟的适应，F1分数提升了3.6%至23%。这些结果表明，一种减少灵巧手部署所需真实世界交互的实用路径是可行的。

Authors: Jinyi Chen, Hongyi Li, Lei Jiang, Xianwei Liu, Yanhong Liang, Yulin Chen, Yucheng Tao, Yongbin Jin, Hongtao Wang

SPARK: Simple Post-training for Adapting pRetrained Knowledge to Robot Control VLA

post-training temporal abstraction knowledge preservation foundation models robot control

简要说明：SPARK 是一种后训练方法，通过时间抽象与知识保持相结合，将预训练的视觉基础模型适配到机器人控制，在多个机器人操作基准和真实世界任务中提高了成功率和泛化能力。

TLDR: SPARK is a post-training method that adapts pretrained visual foundation models for robot control by combining temporal abstraction with knowledge preservation, improving success rates and generalization across multiple robot manipulation benchmarks and real-world tasks.

Abstract: Large-scale representation learning has produced public foundation models that provide strong general-purpose visual features. However, their pretraining objectives are not designed for robot representation learning, so the resulting embeddings tend to emphasize global semantics rather than the temporally sensitive representations required for robot control. Training robot models from scratch is also undesirable due to the limited scale and high collection cost of robotics data, as well as the substantial computational burden of pre-training. In this paper, we propose SPARK (Simple Post-training for Adapting pRetrained Knowledge), a post-training method that adapts foundation models to robot control. SPARK is built on two principles: temporal abstraction, which encourages the encoder to derive compact features that preserve information essential for understanding temporal changes and action-relevant scene structure, and knowledge preservation, which aligns patch-level representations with those of the original foundation model to retain useful pretrained semantics. These objectives yield compact visual state representations that remain semantically meaningful while preserving useful prior knowledge. Experiments across multiple robotics benchmarks show that SPARK consistently improves success rates and generalization over vanilla foundation models, and further demonstrate that these gains transfer to real-world robot manipulation.

摘要（中文）：大规模表征学习已催生出诸多公共基础模型，这些模型能够提供强大的通用视觉特征。然而，其预训练目标并非专为机器人表征学习而设计，因此所生成的嵌入往往侧重于全局语义，而非机器人控制所需的时间敏感表征。由于机器人数据规模有限、采集成本高昂，加之预训练计算负担沉重，从头训练机器人模型同样不可取。本文提出SPARK（面向预训练知识适配的简单后训练方法），一种将基础模型适配至机器人控制的后训练方法。SPARK基于两大原则构建：时间抽象，鼓励编码器提取紧凑特征，保留对理解时间变化及动作相关场景结构至关重要的信息；以及知识保持，将块级表征与原始基础模型中的对应表征对齐，以保留有用的预训练语义。上述目标使得最终得到的紧凑视觉状态表征既保持语义意义，又保留有价值的先验知识。在多个机器人基准上的实验表明，SPARK相较于原始基础模型持续提升了成功率与泛化能力，并进一步证明这些改进可迁移至真实世界的机器人操作任务。

Authors: Taekyung Kim, Jeongeun Park, Byeongho Heo, Sungjoon Choi, Sangdoo Yun, Dongyoon Han

Grasp-Taxonomy Conditioning as a Mode Switch for Dexterous Grasping of Climbing Holds Manipulation

dexterous grasping diffusion policy grasp taxonomy point-cloud policy LEAP hand

简要说明：BetaGrasp是一种以抓握类型标签为条件的3D扩散策略，用于攀岩支点的灵巧抓取，通过模式切换在点云歧义时提升滑脱力并减少脱手失败。

TLDR: BetaGrasp is a 3D diffusion policy conditioned on grasp-type labels for dexterous grasping of climbing holds, improving slip force and reducing full-grasp failures on a real Franka/LEAP hand system by acting as a mode switch when point-cloud alone is ambiguous.

Abstract: Dexterous grasping in robotics relies on distinct hand configurations depending on object geometry. We introduce BetaGrasp, a 3D diffusion policy that conditions a DP3-style point-cloud policy on a four-class grasp label (crimp, sloper, pinch, and jug), running on a Franka arm with a 16-DoF LEAP hand. We also introduce a climbing-hold benchmark: a spring testbed whose ratchet gives a slip-force reading in newtons. In our analysis the policy's point-cloud encoder did not separate the four holds, so the scan alone gave it little to choose a grasp from. Without the label (a DP3-style baseline), simulated rollouts from the robot's reset pose all end in a jug grasp, whatever the hold (25% correct grasp type, versus 94% for BetaGrasp). The label works as a switch for which grasp the policy performs. On 80 paired hardware trials, BetaGrasp raises average slip force from 9.6 N to 14.3 N, and grasps slipping fully off the hold drop from 44% of trials to 10%.

摘要（中文）：灵巧抓取在机器人技术中依赖于根据物体几何形状的不同手部构型。我们提出了BetaGrasp，一种3D扩散策略，该策略将DP3风格的点云策略条件化为四类抓取标签（握捏、斜板、捏取和抛掷），运行在配备16自由度LEAP手的Franka机械臂上。我们还引入了一个攀岩支点基准：一个弹簧测试平台，其棘轮以牛顿为单位提供滑脱力读数。在我们的分析中，该策略的点云编码器未能区分四种支点类型，因此仅凭扫描数据几乎无法为策略提供选择抓取方式的依据。在没有标签的情况下（即DP3风格的基线），从机器人复位姿态出发的模拟展开无论面对何种支点都以抛掷抓取告终（正确抓取类型仅为25%，而BetaGrasp达到94%）。标签起到了切换策略所执行抓取方式的作用。在80次配对硬件试验中，BetaGrasp将平均滑脱力从9.6牛顿提升至14.3牛顿，且完全从支点上滑脱的抓取比例从试验次数的44%降至10%。

Authors: Rumi Loghmani, Abraham George, Amir Barati Farimani

OASIS: Optimization-Aware Subgoal Inference with Safety Constraints for Autonomous Mobile Robot Navigation RLRobot

hierarchical navigation model predictive control reinforcement learning subgoal inference control barrier functions

简要说明：OASIS 是一个分层导航框架，它将非线性 MPC 控制器的优化结果反馈给基于强化学习的子目标策略，从而提升自主移动机器人在动态环境中的导航成功率。

TLDR: OASIS is a hierarchical navigation framework that feeds optimization outcomes from a nonlinear MPC controller back into a reinforcement learning-based subgoal policy, improving autonomous mobile robot navigation success in dynamic environments.

Abstract: Navigation in dynamic environments requires mobile robots to make progress toward their goals while respecting motion limits and avoiding surrounding obstacles. Learned subgoal policies can guide model predictive control beyond its local prediction horizon, but a geometrically suitable subgoal does not necessarily lead to a successfully solved control problem. This paper proposes OASIS, a hierarchical navigation framework that incorporates recent optimization outcomes into reinforcement learning-based subgoal generation. A high-level policy trained using Soft Actor--Critic generates local subgoals, while a nonlinear model predictive controller tracks them subject to motion limits, geometric collision-avoidance constraints, and embedded high-order control barrier function constraints. The outcomes of controller optimizations over each subgoal interval are summarized and provided to the policy at its next decision, without requiring additional optimization calls. The framework is evaluated in five navigation scenarios with static and moving obstacles, including dense interactions and sensing uncertainty. Comparisons with hierarchical and direct-goal control variants show that OASIS achieves the highest aggregate navigation success. Matched comparisons across three training seeds further show a consistent success advantage over the otherwise identical hierarchy without optimization-status input. The selected-policy comparison also shows fewer primary optimization failures with similar mean controller time.

摘要（中文）：在动态环境中导航要求移动机器人在朝目标前进的同时，遵守运动限制并避开周围障碍物。学习到的子目标策略可以引导模型预测控制超越其局部预测视界，但一个几何上合适的子目标并不一定能导致控制问题被成功求解。本文提出OASIS，一种分层导航框架，将最近的优化结果纳入基于强化学习的子目标生成中。使用软演员-评论家算法训练的高层策略生成局部子目标，而非线性模型预测控制器在运动限制、几何避碰约束以及内嵌高阶控制障碍函数约束下跟踪这些子目标。控制器在每个子目标区间内的优化结果被汇总并在下一次决策时提供给策略，无需额外调用优化。该框架在五个包含静态和移动障碍物的导航场景中进行了评估，包括密集交互和传感不确定性。与分层和直接目标控制变体的比较表明，OASIS在总体导航成功率上达到最高。跨三个训练种子的匹配比较进一步显示，相较于不具备优化状态输入的相同分层结构，OASIS在成功率上具有一致的优势。选定策略的比较还显示，在相似的平均控制器耗时下，主要优化失败次数更少。

Authors: Arian Hajizadeh, Javad Pourrafi Arabani, Negar Shenavar, Sana Bashiri, Seyed Majid Esmailzadeh

Thermo-VLA: A Thermal-Aware Vision-Language-Action Model with Gated Residual Modulation for Robotic Manipulation VLA

Thermal sensing Vision-Language-Action model Residual modulation Robotic manipulation Gated mechanism

简要说明：Thermo-VLA 提出了一种热感知 VLA 模型，通过 ThermoRes 编码器将热图像分解为冷/热属性，并利用语言条件残差调制将其注入 RGB 标记，从而提升双机械臂 G1 机器人的温度驱动操作能力。

TLDR: Thermo-VLA introduces a thermal-aware VLA model with a ThermoRes Encoder that decomposes thermal images into cold/hot attributes and injects them into RGB tokens via language-conditioned residual modulation, improving temperature-driven manipulation on a dual-arm G1 robot.

Abstract: Recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have begun incorporating thermal sensing, but existing approaches typically treat thermal images as ordinary visual inputs, providing limited support for temperature-aware relational reasoning in manipulation. To address this limitation, we propose Thermo-VLA with a ThermoRes Encoder, which decomposes thermal images into cold and hot attribute representations and injects them into the RGB token through language-conditioned residual modulation, enabling temperature-driven target selection and continuous manipulation. We further construct six real-world robotic tasks on a dual-arm Unitree G1 platform, spanning basic grounding to relational reasoning. Experiments show that Thermo-VLA achieves an average success rate of 0.86 across four thermal-dependent tasks, outperforming a pi_0.5 baseline that directly incorporates RGB-thermal observations by 18 percentage points. Under unseen-object and scene variations, Thermo-VLA maintains an average success rate of 0.78, achieving the best generalisation performance among the compared methods. Beyond thermal sensing, we transfer the same residual modulation mechanism to colour attributes and observe consistent improvements in both simulation and real-robot experiments, indicating its potential to generalise beyond thermal attributes. Project website: https://j-x-chen.github.io/Thermo-VLA-web/

摘要（中文）：近期，视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已开始融入热成像感知能力，但现有方法通常将热图像视为普通视觉输入，在操作任务中对温度感知的关系推理支持有限。为解决这一局限，我们提出Thermo-VLA，并配备ThermoRes编码器，该编码器将热图像分解为冷、热两个属性表征，并通过语言条件残差调制将其注入RGB令牌中，从而实现温度驱动的目标选择与连续操作。我们进一步在双臂Unitree G1平台上构建了六项真实机器人任务，涵盖从基础定位到关系推理的多个层次。实验表明，Thermo-VLA在四项温度依赖任务上的平均成功率达0.86，比直接融合RGB-热观测的pi_0.5基线高出18个百分点。在未见物体与场景变化条件下，Thermo-VLA仍保持0.78的平均成功率，在对比方法中取得了最优泛化性能。除热感知外，我们将相同的残差调制机制迁移至颜色属性，并在仿真与真机实验中均观察到一致的性能提升，表明该方法具备超越温度属性进行推广的潜力。项目网站：https://j-x-chen.github.io/Thermo-VLA-web/

Authors: Jingxuan Chen, Junshi Luo, Chencheng Dong, Xiaojian Nie, Tongge Huang, Qiang Huang

Flip Anything with Agentic Robotics Self-Learning Manipulation

agentic learning bimanual manipulation flipping sim-to-real progressive skill acquisition

简要说明：该论文提出了一种代理式机器人自学习方法，通过编码代理在仿真中自主开发和改进物体翻转策略，逐步获得技能，在多样化物体上实现高成功率，并迁移到物理机器人上。

TLDR: This paper presents an agentic robotics self-learning approach where a coding agent autonomously develops and refines object-flipping strategies in simulation, progressively acquiring skills to achieve high success on diverse objects and transferring to physical robots.

Abstract: Flipping is a fundamental robotic manipulation skill that requires reorienting a target object in a stable pose on a planar support surface by rotating it 180$^\circ$ about an axis parallel to the support surface -- think of flipping a coin from heads to tails. Although flipping is a common objective in industrial tasks such as parts inspection, mechanical assembly, and tool use, coding a bimanual robot with grippers to flip diverse objects is a significant challenge. In this paper, we show that a coding agent can autonomously develop and refine object-flipping strategies through iterative learning in physics simulations across diverse object geometries. Progressive skill acquisition, from basic handover to toppling and pushing, robust grasping and sensing, and thin-object manipulation with recovery, improves task success from 24.7% to 95.0%. The resulting graph-based code integrates high-level strategy selection with reactive control, enabling multi-stage flipping on physical robots.

摘要（中文）：翻转是一种基础性的机器人操作技能，要求将目标物体在与支撑面平行的轴上旋转180°（可类比于将硬币从正面翻到反面），从而使其在平面上稳定地重新定向。尽管翻转在零件检测、机械装配和工具使用等工业任务中是一个常见目标，但为配备夹爪的双臂机器人编程以翻转多种物体仍是一项重大挑战。在本文中，我们展示了一个编程智能体能够通过在不同物体几何形状的物理仿真中迭代学习，自主开发并优化物体翻转策略。从基本的交接逐渐扩展到倾倒与推动、稳健的抓取与感知，以及带恢复机制的薄物体操作，一系列渐进的技能习得将任务成功率从24.7%提升至95.0%。最终生成的基于图的代码将高层策略选择与反应式控制相结合，使得多阶段翻转能够在实体机器人上实现。

Authors: Shuangyu Xie, Kaiyuan Chen, Ken Goldberg

Distilling Instructions into Weights: Closed-Form Edits Fix a Robot Policy's Misreading VLA

weight editing instruction distillation vision-language-action model robot policy repair zero-shot

简要说明：论文提出一种闭式指令蒸馏方法，通过直接编辑VLA机器人策略的权重来修复特定失败，无需训练数据即可在保留种子上提升任务成功率。

TLDR: The paper proposes a closed-form instruction distillation method that edits the weights of a vision-language-action (VLA) robot policy to fix a specific failure mode, improving task success on held-out seeds without additional training data.

Abstract: Generalist robot policies often fail at one step of a task they can otherwise perform. We ask whether such a failure can be repaired by editing the policy's weights directly, without gradients, training data, or a change to the instruction. Told to put the cube then the banana in the bowl, a zero-shot $π_{0.5}$ vision-language-action policy in RoboLab releases the cube before it reaches the bowl. Replaying 21 of these decisions under rewordings shows that it binds "in the bowl" to the wrong object. Closed-form instruction distillation copies the per-layer effect of an explicit rewording into the language model's MLP weights. On 128 held-out seeds, success rises from 27 to 106 episodes, with 81 fixed and 2 broken ($p=7\times10^{-22}$), while an update of the same size in random directions leaves success unchanged. The edit also lifts two other tasks without detectable harm on the remaining 13, and a variant that stores 0.16% of the parameter count keeps most of its effect. Placed in the action expert or action head instead, the same distillation helps less or not at all. Our released tool reproduced the fix end to end on new held-out seeds, from 8/64 to 36/64. Edits aimed at perception, a missing grasp, contact physics, or the gripper threshold did not help, and of seven blind Claude Opus editors, only the one given the misread instruction produced an edit that passed held-out scoring. These results suggest that weight edits work best when a known-good input already exists to distil. Because reruns with unchanged weights flip about a third of paired outcomes, evaluations should pair seeds, rerun the unedited policy, and confirm gains on held-out seeds.

摘要（中文）：通用型机器人策略在执行任务时，往往会在某一环节失败，而它们本可以完成整项任务。我们探究的是，能否直接通过编辑策略的权重来修复此类失败，而无需梯度、训练数据或修改指令。在RoboLab环境中，当零样本的$π_{0.5}$视觉-语言-动作策略被要求“先将立方体放入碗中，再将香蕉放入碗中”时，它在立方体还未到达碗边时就提前松手了。在变换措辞后重放这21次决策，发现该策略将“放入碗中”错误地绑定到了错误的对象上。闭式指令蒸馏法将显式改写后的逐层效应复制到语言模型的MLP权重中。在128个保留的测试种子上，成功率从27集提升至106集，其中81集被修复、2集被破坏（$p=7\times10^{-22}$），而相同规模的随机方向更新则未改变成功率。这一编辑还提升了另外两项任务的表现，且对其余13项任务无明显损害；一种仅存储参数总量0.16%的变体保留了大部分效果。若将该蒸馏分别应用于动作专家或动作头，则帮助较小或完全没有帮助。我们发布的工具在全新的保留测试种子上端到端复现了修复效果，成功率从8/64提升至36/64。针对感知、抓取缺失、接触物理或夹爪阈值等问题的编辑均未奏效；在七位盲测的Claude Opus编辑者中，只有一位获得了错误读取指令的编辑者所生成的编辑通过了保留测试评分。这些结果表明，当存在已知正确的输入可供蒸馏时，权重编辑的效果最佳。由于在权重不变的情况下重跑会翻转约三分之一的配对结果，评估时应将种子配对、重跑未经编辑的策略，并在保留测试种子上确认增益。

Authors: Ali-Adeeb Abbas, Esmaeil Seraj

Fade to... Red? Scheduling Coloured Noise Exploration Supports Efficient Robot Learning with Reduced Movement Jerk RLRobot

colored noise exploration scheduling deep reinforcement learning manipulation movement jerk

简要说明：本文研究了深度强化学习中对彩色噪声探索进行调度的效果，发现向红噪声衰减可将运动抖动减半且不牺牲学习效率和性能，并建议将其作为离策略机器人学习的默认选择。

TLDR: This paper studies scheduling colored noise exploration in deep RL for robotics, showing that fading toward red noise reduces movement jerk by half without sacrificing learning efficiency or performance, and recommends it as the default for off-policy robot learning.

Abstract: Exploration in deep reinforcement learning (RL) for continuous control is commonly driven by temporally uncorrelated Gaussian (white) action noise, which leads to jerky motions with locally constrained exploration. In contrast, temporally correlated coloured noise, particularly pink noise, has been shown to support more efficient exploration in RL. Motivated by these findings, we inquire whether scheduling changes to the noise colour over the course of training can outperform white noise for continuous control robotics. We perform a systematic study of 49 linear schedules between white and red noise, together with generalised state-dependent exploration (gSDE), on four sparse-reward manipulation tasks with a Fetch arm and a Shadow Dexterous Hand. We find that the noise colour at the end of training does not affect learning efficiency or end performance, whereas fading towards red noise halves the jerk of exploration in every task. Balancing learning efficiency, end performance and smoothness, red noise emerges as the preferred strategy: it learns as efficiently as pink noise with almost 2-fold less movement jerk. We therefore recommend exploration schedulers that fade towards red noise as the default for off-policy robot learning.

摘要（中文）：在深度强化学习（RL）的连续控制中，探索通常由时间上不相关的高斯（白）动作噪声驱动，这会导致运动急促且探索局限于局部范围。相比之下，时间上相关的有色噪声，尤其是粉红噪声，已被证明能在强化学习中支持更高效的探索。受这些发现的启发，我们探讨了在训练过程中对噪声颜色进行调度变化是否能超越白噪声，从而提升连续控制机器人的表现。我们对白噪声到红噪声之间的49种线性调度方案，以及广义状态依赖探索（gSDE），在四个使用Fetch机械臂和Shadow灵巧手的稀疏奖励操作任务中进行了系统性研究。我们发现，训练结束时的噪声颜色并不影响学习效率或最终性能，而向红噪声衰减则在每个任务中将探索的急促程度减半。综合学习效率、最终性能和运动平滑性，红噪声成为优选策略：其学习效率与粉红噪声相当，但运动急促程度降低了近两倍。因此，我们建议将以向红噪声衰减为默认策略的探索调度器，用于离策略机器人学习。

Authors: Francisco M. López, Francisco Cruz

Decoupled Asynchronous System for Humanoids (DASH): Latency-Agnostic Scaling of Vision-Language-Action Models for Humanoid Manipulation VLA

asynchronous control vision-language-action model humanoid manipulation flow-matching action head latency-agnostic

简要说明：DASH通过异步并发进程将视觉-语言骨干网络与动作头解耦，使控制速率不受骨干网络规模影响，并提升人形机器人操作成功率。

TLDR: DASH decouples the vision-language backbone from the action head in a VLA policy using asynchronous concurrent processes, making control rate independent of backbone size and improving humanoid manipulation success.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models pair a vision-language backbone with an action head, but in closed-loop control the backbone sits on the control-critical path: while it computes, the robot keeps moving, so each executed action is conditioned on an increasingly stale observation. A larger backbone therefore directly blocks reactivity, especially in humanoid dexterous manipulation. We present DASH, a Decoupled Asynchronous System for Humanoids that removes this coupling. DASH splits the policy into a slow vision-language model (System 2) and a fast flow-matching action head (System 1) that run as concurrent processes over the LCM communication protocol, so the control rate is set by the action head alone, independent of backbone size. The action head fuses stale semantics from a frozen backbone with fresh vision from its own ResNet encoder, desynchronized training exposes it to the staleness it meets at deployment, and an adaptive temporal aggregator aligns overlapping action chunks under variable inference latency. On an asynchronous RoboTwin benchmark that charges inference latency in simulated time, DASH holds 20 Hz control rate from 0.8B to 8B backbones while the synchronous rate falls from 9.7 to 4.1 Hz, with higher success at every size. On a real humanoid with dexterous hands, DASH achieves clearly higher pick-and-place success than the synchronous pipeline.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型将视觉-语言骨干网络与动作头配对，但在闭环控制中，骨干网络位于控制关键路径上：在其计算期间，机器人持续运动，因此每个执行的动作都基于日益过时的观测。因此，更大的骨干网络直接阻碍了响应能力，尤其是在人形灵巧操作任务中。我们提出DASH——一种用于人形机器人的解耦异步系统，以消除这种耦合。DASH将策略拆分为一个慢速视觉-语言模型（系统2）和一个快速流匹配动作头（系统1），两者通过LCM通信协议作为并发进程运行，因此控制速率仅由动作头决定，与骨干网络大小无关。动作头将冻结骨干网络提供的过时语义与其自身ResNet编码器提供的新鲜视觉信息融合，去同步训练使其暴露于部署时遇到的延迟失配，而自适应时序聚合器则在可变推理延迟下对齐重叠动作块。在异步RoboTwin基准测试中——该基准以模拟时间计算推理延迟——DASH在0.8B至8B骨干网络下均保持20 Hz控制速率，而同步方案的控制速率从9.7 Hz降至4.1 Hz，且在每个规模下成功率均更高。在配备灵巧手的真实人形机器人上，DASH的抓取-放置成功率明显高于同步流水线。

Authors: Bingzhang Wang, Nathan Zhao, Jialeng Ni, Jiajin Zheng, Yin Zhang, Kehua Chen, Jian Yao

PAIR: Proprioception-Aligned Image-Ray Representations for Viewpoint-Robust Manipulation Manipulation

contrastive learning camera-ray conditioning proprioception viewpoint robustness imitation learning

简要说明：PAIR 提出了一种利用机器人本体感觉对齐图像-射线联合表示的对比学习框架，以增强视觉运动策略的视角鲁棒性，并在仿真和真实操作中持续优于基线。

TLDR: PAIR proposes a contrastive learning framework that aligns joint image-ray representations using robot proprioception to improve viewpoint robustness of visuomotor policies, demonstrating consistent gains over baselines in simulation and real-world manipulation.

Abstract: While imitation learning has made substantial progress toward generalizable robot manipulation through scaling, viewpoint robustness remains a major bottleneck. Visuomotor policies rely heavily on visual inputs, yet images provide an inherently ambiguous signal under viewpoint change: similar scenes may appear markedly different across viewpoints, while distinct states may share certain visual overlaps. A policy must therefore infer not only the task-relevant state, but also how it is visually projected under a particular camera configuration. This entanglement of viewpoint-dependent appearance and task-relevant state can make learning inefficient and limit generalization to unseen viewpoints. Recent work has begun to address this challenge through camera-ray conditioning and representation learning using geometric cues to induce invariance. However, providing camera information as additional context does not by itself ground visual representations in how the task scene is visually projected, while geometric alignment without camera context can introduce spurious correspondences by ignoring viewpoint-dependent projection. We propose PAIR, a contrastive learning framework that aligns joint image-ray representations using robot proprioception. PAIR encourages observations with similar robot states to remain close in representation space across viewpoints, providing a structured grounding signal for learning viewpoint-robust features. PAIR is a highly adaptable framework: it can be used to train Diffusion Policy (DP) or post-train vision-language-action (VLA) models. In simulated and real-world manipulation benchmarks with camera variation, PAIR consistently outperforms the behavior cloning baseline without ray conditioning by 12.7% and 26.7% points, respectively, demonstrating stronger generalization to unseen viewpoints. Project website: PAIRrobot.github.io.

摘要（中文）：虽然模仿学习在通过规模化实现机器人操作的泛化方面已取得显著进展，但视角鲁棒性仍是一个主要瓶颈。视觉运动策略高度依赖视觉输入，然而在视角变化下，图像本质上提供了模糊的信号：相似的场景在不同视角下可能表现出显著差异，而不同的状态在视觉上又可能存在部分重叠。因此，策略不仅要推断与任务相关的状态，还要推断该状态在特定相机配置下是如何被视觉投影的。这种视角相关外观与任务相关状态的纠缠可能导致学习效率低下，并限制对未见视角的泛化能力。近年来的研究已开始通过相机射线条件化和利用几何线索进行表示学习来引入不变性，以应对这一挑战。然而，仅将相机信息作为额外上下文提供，并不能从根本上将视觉表示锚定在任务场景的视觉投影方式上；而在缺乏相机上下文的情况下进行几何对齐，又可能因忽略视角相关的投影而产生虚假对应。我们提出PAIR，一个利用机器人本体感觉对齐图像—射线联合表示的对比学习框架。PAIR鼓励具有相似机器人状态的观测在不同视角下于表示空间中保持接近，从而为学习视角鲁棒的特征提供结构化的锚定信号。PAIR是一个高度自适应的框架：既可用于训练扩散策略（DP），也可用于对视觉—语言—动作（VLA）模型进行后训练。在包含相机变化的仿真及真实世界操作基准测试中，PAIR相较于未使用射线条件化的行为克隆基线分别一致性地提升了12.7和26.7个百分点，展现出对未见视角更强的泛化能力。项目网站：PAIRrobot.github.io。

Authors: Sung-Wook Lee, Xuhui Kang, Dylan Losey, Yen-Ling Kuo

HolidayFactory 1.0: Simulating, Generating, and Evaluating Industrial Robot Tasks Manipulation

industrial robot simulation persistent evaluation world construction contact simulation benchmark

简要说明：HolidayFactory 1.0 是一个用于模拟、生成和评估工业机器人任务的框架，包含用于持久场景状态的物理模拟器、智能体世界构建以及七个连续作业任务的基准测试。

TLDR: HolidayFactory 1.0 is a framework for simulating, generating, and evaluating industrial robot tasks, featuring a physics simulator for persistent scene state, agentic world construction, and a benchmark of seven tasks evaluated over continuous job cycles.

Abstract: Robots are typically evaluated in episodes that begin from a reset, while industrial work consists of repeated jobs whose outcomes affect subsequent operations. Evaluating such work at scale requires simulation of task-critical physical interactions, construction of industrial environments, and measurements of performance as scene state persists. We present HOLIDAYFACTORY 1.0, a framework for simulating, generating, and evaluating industrial robot work. Given a human-specified workplace and task, the framework defines a world pairing a scenario of scene variants and process logic with an evaluation defining a job, metrics, and a rubric. HOLIDAYFACTORY 1.0 comprises three components. HOLIDAY-SIM extends Newton's SDF-based hydroelastic contact with additional constitutive laws and a semi-implicit primal-dual solver, couples stateful actuator dynamics to articulated motion, and derives tactile and joint observations from simulated states. Agentic world construction generates simulation-ready assets and scene variants using geometric and interaction checks, and proposes task-conditioned evaluations for human confirmation and executable checks. 24/7-BENCH introduces seven industrial tasks in which jobs are evaluated without resetting the scene, measuring completed, failed, and unfinished jobs, throughput, latency, and motor energy. Controlled studies characterize the proposed contact, actuator, and tactile models and examine the effectiveness of verification-guided world construction. Experiments on scene and evaluation generation further reveal the limitations of model critics and the difficulty of ensuring that generated evaluations faithfully capture task requirements. We examine job-level evaluations with scripted trajectories (e.g., code-as-policy) but have not yet compared policies over persistent runs.

摘要（中文）：机器人通常在从重置状态开始的回合中进行评估，而工业工作则由重复性任务构成，这些任务的结果会影响后续操作。要在大规模场景中评估此类工作，需要模拟任务关键性的物理交互、构建工业环境，并在场景状态持续存在的情况下测量性能。我们提出了HOLIDAYFACTORY 1.0，这是一个用于模拟、生成和评估工业机器人工作的框架。给定人工指定的工作场所和任务，该框架定义一个世界，将场景变体与流程逻辑的情境同定义工作、指标和评分标准的评估配对。HOLIDAYFACTORY 1.0包含三个组件。HOLIDAY-SIM扩展了基于牛顿SDF的流体弹性接触，增加了额外的本构定律和半隐式原始-对偶求解器，将有状态执行器动力学与关节运动耦合，并从模拟状态中导出触觉和关节观测。智能体式世界构建利用几何和交互检查生成可模拟资产和场景变体，并提出任务条件化的评估以供人工确认和可执行检查。24/7-BENCH引入了七项工业任务，在这些任务中，工作评估无需重置场景，测量完成、失败和未完成的工作量，以及吞吐量、延迟和电机能量。对照研究表征了所提出的接触、执行器和触觉模型，并检验了验证引导式世界构建的有效性。场景和评估生成的实验进一步揭示了模型评判器的局限性，以及确保生成的评估忠实捕捉任务要求的难度。我们使用脚本化轨迹（例如，代码即策略）进行了工作级评估，但尚未对持续运行中的策略进行比较。

Authors: Holiday Robotics, :, Jeongmin Lee, Taehyeon Kim, Dohyun Jang, Minji Lee, Seonghun Oh, Dongwoo Park, Geonhyup Lee, Jaehyung Kim, Jaemin Yoon, Jinseop Bok, Jungwoo Kim, Minseok Yang, Philsik Chang, Soomin Lee

Accelerated Reinforcement Learning for Soft Robotics: Hours Instead of Years Other

reinforcement learning soft robotics adiabatic spectral submanifolds reduced-order model policy training

简要说明：该论文提出使用绝热谱子流形（aSSM）降阶模型作为软体机器人强化学习的快速训练环境，展示了3小时的策略训练时间，而硬件上需要3年。

TLDR: This paper proposes using adiabatic spectral submanifold (aSSM)-reduced models as fast and efficient training environments for reinforcement learning on soft robots, demonstrating a 3-hour policy training time that would extrapolate to 3 years on hardware.

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) requires large amounts of interaction data or a reliable simulator, both hard to obtain for nonlinear soft robotic hardware. Recent work shows that a time-scale separation inherent to soft robot dynamics justifies their reduction to low-dimensional invariant manifolds, known as adiabatic spectral submanifolds (aSSMs). We demonstrate that an aSSM-reduced model, a simple polynomial ordinary differential equation learned purely from pre-collected data, can serve as an RL training environment. On a pneumatically actuated soft arm, we train a trajectory-tracking policy in 3 hours on a six-dimensional aSSM-reduced model and deploy it without fine-tuning, whereas reproducing this policy training extrapolates to 3 years of hardware interaction. Our policy tracks dynamic targets with 40% lower error than otherwise identical policies trained on a 4.8-million-parameter recurrent neural network (RNN) or a 1.7-million-parameter transformer, which take 13 and 100 hours to identify, against 5 minutes for our mathematically justified 6,924-parameter model.

摘要（中文）：强化学习（RL）需要大量的交互数据或可靠的模拟器，而对于非线性软体机器人硬件而言，这两者都难以获取。近期研究表明，软体机器人动力学中固有的时间尺度分离可证明其可约简为低维不变流形，即绝热谱子流形（aSSMs）。我们证明，一个完全从预采集数据中学习得到的简单多项式常微分方程形式的aSSM约简模型，能够作为RL训练环境。在气动驱动的软体机械臂上，我们利用六维aSSM约简模型在3小时内训练出轨迹跟踪策略，并无需微调即可直接部署，而重现该策略训练过程则等效于需3年的硬件交互时间。与在参数量达480万的循环神经网络（RNN）或参数量达170万的Transformer上训练的相同策略相比，我们的策略在跟踪动态目标时误差降低了40%，且上述两种网络的识别时间分别为13小时和100小时，而我们基于数学推导的仅含6,924个参数的模型仅需5分钟。

Authors: Roshan S. Kaundinya, Hehui Zheng, Robert K. Katzschmann, George Haller

Streaming Failure Forecasting: VLA Failure Monitors That Keep Learning After Deployment VLA

failure monitoring online adaptation vision-language-action models continual learning robot learning

简要说明：本文提出了流式失败预测（SFF），在部署后仅更新冻结的VLA失败监视器的最后一层线性层，从而在真实机器人任务或策略漂移下提高失败排序性能。

TLDR: The paper introduces Streaming Failure Forecasting (SFF), a method that continuously updates the last linear layer of a frozen VLA failure monitor after deployment, improving failure ranking under task or policy drift on real robots.

Abstract: Failure monitors for vision-language-action (VLA) policies are trained offline and then frozen. After deployment, lighting, objects and cameras drift, and the policy itself is updated or moved to new tasks. On recorded real-robot runs, after a switch of task or policy version, a frozen monitor fit on the old task ranks failures little better than chance. We present Streaming Failure Forecasting (SFF), a monitor that keeps learning from the one label every episode provides: whether it succeeded. SFF keeps the offline monitor's network fixed and refits only its last linear layer after each episode, at 2.18 ms per policy call on a Jetson CPU core. Its alarm threshold moves only after successes, which in simulation kept false alarms near target except when two drifts came at once. With every setting locked before testing, SFF ranks failures better than the same monitor kept frozen on 4 of 5 simulated test suites under unannounced drift, and above resetting on detected drift on every suite. Carried with its locked learner settings to 434 recorded runs of four VLAs on real SO-101 arms, replayed across unannounced switches of task or policy version, it ranks failures better than the frozen monitor for every VLA and, in an exploratory comparison, above a full reset at the true switch. A deployed failure monitor need not stay frozen: refitting its readout from outcomes is cheap and helps after the changes we tested.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-行动（VLA）策略的失败监测器先经过离线训练，随后被冻结。部署后，光照、物体和摄像头会发生变化，策略本身也会更新或被迁移至新任务。在记录的真实机器人运行中，当任务或策略版本切换后，针对旧任务拟合的冻结监测器对失败的排序能力仅略优于随机水平。我们提出了流式失败预测（Streaming Failure Forecasting, SFF），这是一种监测器，它持续从每个回合仅有的一个标签——即该回合是否成功——中学习。SFF保持离线监测器的网络结构固定不变，仅在每回合结束后重新拟合其最后一层线性层，在Jetson CPU核心上每次策略调用的耗时仅为2.18毫秒。其报警阈值仅在成功之后移动，在仿真中，除非两种漂移同时发生，否则这一机制能将误报率保持在目标值附近。在测试前锁定所有设置的情况下，面对未宣布的漂移，SFF在5个仿真测试套件中的4个上，其失败排序能力优于保持冻结的同一监测器；面对已检测到的漂移，SFF在所有套件上均优于重置方法。将锁定的学习器设置应用于真实SO-101机械臂上四种VLA策略的434次记录运行中，在未宣布的任务或策略版本切换下进行回放，SFF对所有VLA的失败排序能力均优于冻结监测器，并且在一项探索性比较中，在真实切换时优于完全重置方法。部署后的失败监测器不必保持冻结：基于结果重新拟合其读出层成本低廉，并且在我们测试的各种变化之后均有帮助。

Authors: Amit Jadhav, Shaurya Beriwala, David Q. Liu, Yanfei Liu

HINT-VLM: Humanoid Interactive Navigation over Rough Terrain with Embodiment-Grounded Vision-Language Model HumanoidEmbodied

navigation among movable obstacles terrain traversability Gaussian process residual model hierarchical uncertainty-aware planning humanoid robots

简要说明：本文提出了一种人形机器人混合规划框架，结合视觉语言模型语义先验和高斯过程残差模型来预测物体可移动性和地形可通过性，实现在杂乱户外崎岖地形中的可移动障碍物导航。

TLDR: This paper introduces a hybrid planning framework for humanoid robots that combines VLM semantic priors with Gaussian process residual models to predict object movability and terrain traversability, enabling navigation among movable obstacles in cluttered outdoor rough terrain.

Abstract: Humanoid robots have achieved significant progress in locomotion and manipulation, enabling traversal over rough terrain and richer interaction with the environment, such as moving obstacles. However, most traditional navigation methods assume non-interactive environments and focus only on traversal. While Navigation Among Movable Obstacles (NAMO) approaches relax this assumption, prior efforts have largely focused on flat environments and reactive interaction, rather than predicting object movability and planning ahead. These limitations become critical in outdoor rough-terrain scenarios, where robots must jointly reason about terrain traversability and object movability. In this work, we address NAMO for humanoid robots in cluttered outdoor rough terrain by proposing a hybrid planning framework that combines semantic priors from a Vision-Language Model (VLM) with embodied robot interaction data through a Gaussian process (GP) residual model. The GP corrects the VLM-derived movability prior to produce embodiment-grounded probabilistic movability estimates, which are then incorporated into hierarchical uncertainty-aware planning. The proposed approach allows humanoids to jointly leverage locomotion and manipulation for efficient and safe navigation, representing the first solution to NAMO in rough terrain through predictive movability reasoning and probabilistic VLM integration.

摘要（中文）：人形机器人在 locomotion（运动）与 manipulation（操作）方面已取得显著进展，使其能够穿越崎岖地形并与环境进行更丰富的交互，例如推动障碍物。然而，大多数传统导航方法假设环境为静态非交互式，仅关注穿越任务。尽管可移动障碍物间导航（NAMO）方法放宽了这一假设，但以往的研究多集中于平坦环境中的反应式交互，缺乏对物体可移动性的预测及前瞻性规划。这些局限在户外崎岖地形场景中尤为突出，因为机器人必须同时推理地形可穿越性与物体可移动性。在本工作中，我们针对户外杂乱崎岖地形下人形机器人的 NAMO 问题提出了一种混合规划框架，该框架将视觉语言模型（VLM）的语义先验与基于高斯过程（GP）残差模型的具身机器人交互数据相结合。GP 对 VLM 导出的可移动性先验进行修正，生成基于具身的概率性可移动性估计，进而将这一估计纳入分层不确定性感知规划中。该方法使人形机器人能够联合利用运动与操作能力实现高效安全的导航，代表了首次基于预测性可移动性推理与概率性 VLM 集成解决崎岖地形 NAMO 问题的方案。
