Authors: Ziwon Yoon, Seok Hwan Kim, Yiyu Chen, Quan Nguyen, Lu Gan, Ye Zhao

ScanDreamer: A Map-Grounded World Model for Quadrotor Navigation WorldModel

world model quadrotor navigation scan-memory map map-grounded imagination forward-cone penalty

简要说明：ScanDreamer 是一种基于地图的无人机导航世界模型，通过深度图像和位姿构建在线二维扫描记忆地图，并以此为条件训练世界模型、演员和评论家，从而在未知环境中显著提升导航成功率和数据效率。

TLDR: ScanDreamer is a map-grounded world model for quadrotor navigation that builds an online 2D scan-memory map from depth images and pose, conditioning its world model, actor, and critic on this map to improve navigation success and data efficiency in unseen environments.

Abstract: Quadrotors inspecting buildings and tunnels must navigate unknown clutter with a forward-facing depth camera whose limited field of view constrains scene understanding and collision-avoiding navigation. Recent world-model agents learn navigation through imagined experience (e.g., AirDreamer), but remain data-intensive and often lack explicit geometric memory and awareness of what the camera can observe. We propose ScanDreamer, a map-grounded world model that constructs an online 2D scan-memory map from depth images and vehicle pose. Our world model, actor, and critic are conditioned on this map, which also defines a geodesic progress reward. Moreover, a forward-cone penalty discourages horizontal motion outside the camera's viewing direction. During imagination, ScanDreamer propagates the quadrotor pose over a frozen map and derives progress and wall-contact signals from the mapped geometry. We train ScanDreamer for 0.8 million environment steps (5.5 h on one GPU) and evaluate it in NVIDIA Isaac Sim over 1560 episodes spanning unseen layouts and parameter ranges. Across three seeds (mean $\pm$ SD), ScanDreamer achieves 96.3 $\pm$ 0.3% success with 3.6 $\pm$ 0.3% collision, compared with 59.6 $\pm$ 3.0% success and 28.8 $\pm$ 2.8% collision for AirDreamer at the same online-interaction budget. Removing the forward-cone penalty increases collisions to 9.9 $\pm$ 3.1%. These results show that combining explicit map memory, map-grounded imagination, and perception-aware motion substantially improves navigation performance and data efficiency. The source code is available at https://github.com/WANGSHUAIzzzz/ScanDreamer.

摘要（中文）：四旋翼无人机在检测建筑和隧道时，必须依靠前视深度摄像头在未知杂乱环境中导航，而该摄像头的有限视场制约了场景理解与避障导航能力。近期基于世界模型的方法（如AirDreamer）通过想象经验进行导航学习，但数据需求大，且往往缺乏显式几何记忆以及对摄像头可视范围的感知。我们提出ScanDreamer，一种地图接地世界模型，利用深度图像与飞行器位姿构建在线二维扫描记忆地图。我们的世界模型、执行器与评判器均以此地图为条件，该地图还定义了测地线进度奖励。此外，前向锥形惩罚用于抑制摄像头视场方向之外的水平运动。在想象过程中，ScanDreamer在冻结地图上传播四旋翼位姿，并从地图几何中获取进度与墙体碰撞信号。我们在NVIDIA Isaac Sim中训练ScanDreamer 80万环境步（单GPU耗时5.5小时），并在跨越未知布局与参数范围的1560个场景中进行评估。在三种随机种子下（均值±标准差），ScanDreamer实现了96.3±0.3%的成功率与3.6±0.3%的碰撞率，而AirDreamer在相同在线交互预算下的成功率为59.6±3.0%，碰撞率为28.8±2.8%。移除前向锥形惩罚后碰撞率增至9.9±3.1%。结果表明，结合显式地图记忆、地图接地想象与感知感知运动可显著提升导航性能与数据效率。源代码可在https://github.com/WANGSHUAIzzzz/ScanDreamer获取。

Authors: Yunyi Gao, Yixing Shi, Yize Liu, Hai-Duong Tran, Nhat-Hoang P. Nguyen, Shuai Wang, Yi Deng, Shengming Liu, Sim Kuan Goh, Duc-Thinh Pham, Sameer Alam

Kimodo-Policy: Learning Kinematic Action Models for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation HumanoidEmbodied

Kinematic Action Models humanoid loco-manipulation text-to-motion ControlNet action-chunk prediction

简要说明：Kimodo-Policy 提出了运动学动作模型（KAM），利用预训练的文生动作生成器作为人形机器人移动操作的动作主干，在仿真和真实世界任务中取得了优异表现，且仅需 9200 万可训练参数。

TLDR: Kimodo-Policy introduces Kinematic Action Models (KAMs), using a pretrained text-to-motion generator as the action backbone for humanoid loco-manipulation, achieving strong performance in simulation and real-world tasks with only 92M trainable parameters.

Abstract: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires continuous coordination of high-dimensional whole-body motion to realize task objectives. While vision-language-action models and world action models transfer semantic and visual-dynamics priors to robot control, these priors do not necessarily capture the structure of robot motion. We introduce Kinematic Action Models (KAMs), a paradigm that treats whole-body motion as a direct pretraining target and uses a pretrained motion generator as the primary action-generation backbone. KAMs ground learned temporal and cross-body coordination priors through task conditioning, visual observations, and execution feedback. We present Kimodo-Policy as an initial instantiation, combining a frozen Kimodo text-to-motion backbone with lightweight ControlNet-based visual conditioning. A root-body-hand hierarchy coordinates locomotion and manipulation, while motion-history conditioning and repeated action-chunk prediction bridge motion synthesis and closed-loop control. Following large-scale loco-manipulation pretraining, the policy achieves the highest overall success among compared policies on multi-task HumanoidArena (72.14%), competitive performance on SIMPLE, and 60% mean success across eight real-world tasks, with 678M parameters (92M trainable). Ablations support the contribution of the pretrained motion backbone. Together, these results provide initial evidence for motion generation as a complementary foundation for humanoid action learning.

摘要（中文）：类人形机器人全身操作需要高维全身运动的连续协调以实现任务目标。尽管视觉-语言-动作模型和世界动作模型将语义先验与视觉动力学先验迁移至机器人控制，但这些先验未必能够捕捉机器人运动的结构特征。我们提出运动学动作模型（Kinematic Action Models, KAMs），该范式将全身运动视为直接的预训练目标，并以预训练的运动生成器作为主要的动作生成主干。KAMs通过任务条件、视觉观测和执行反馈来锚定所学到的时间维度与跨身体协调先验。我们以Kimodo-Policy作为初步实现，将冻结的Kimodo文本到运动主干与基于ControlNet的轻量级视觉条件相结合。根-身体-手层级结构协调运动与操作，而运动历史条件与重复动作块预测则衔接运动合成与闭环控制。经过大规模全身操作预训练后，该策略在多任务HumanoidArena上取得了所有对比策略中最高的综合成功率（72.14%），在SIMPLE上表现具有竞争力，并在八个真实世界任务中实现了60%的平均成功率，参数量为6.78亿（其中可训练参数为9200万）。消融实验验证了预训练运动主干的贡献。综合而言，这些结果为运动生成作为人形机器人动作学习的互补基础提供了初步证据。

Authors: Yunheng Wang, Jiaxi Zhang, Wei Lu, Yuetong Fang, Taowen Wang, Yixiao Feng, Shuning Zhang, Junzhe Xu, Yichi Wang, Zizhao Yuan, Kailun Huang, Lusong Li, Mingqian Zhou, Zecui Zeng, Renjing Xu

$Σ$-LeWM: Learning World Models via S-Information for Robot Control WorldModel

world models robot control latent losses backward dynamics inverse dynamics

简要说明：本文通过向LeWorldModel添加反向动力学和逆动力学动作预测损失，增强了潜在嵌入结构，提高了机器人控制的性能和规划效率。

TLDR: This paper enhances LeWorldModel by adding backward dynamics and inverse dynamics action prediction losses, which improves latent embedding structure, performance, and planning efficiency for robot control.

Abstract: World models have increasingly been applied as a model-based control method for robotics tasks such as manipulation and locomotion. While early world model architectures relied on decoders to prevent mode collapse and learn a predictable latent space, recent works on world models, such as Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture or LeWorldModel, increasingly aim to learn embeddings without a grounding decoder, utilising only a latent forward dynamics predictor and a stabilising entropy term. In this paper, we set out to demonstrate that the further introduction of two additional latent losses to LeWorldModel, a backward dynamics predictor and an inverse dynamics action predictor, enforces further structure on the latent embedding, leading to further gains in both performance and planning efficiency. These are critical properties for improving the applicability of such methods to real-time model-based control of real-world robots. We demonstrate these gains on standard world model benchmarks and two simulated robot manipulation tasks.

摘要（中文）：世界模型已被越来越多地用作机器人操作和运动等任务中的基于模型的控制方法。尽管早期的世界模型架构依赖于解码器来防止模式坍缩并学习可预测的潜在空间，但近期关于世界模型的研究，如联合嵌入预测架构或LeWorldModel，越来越多地旨在无需接地解码器的情况下学习嵌入，仅利用潜在前向动力学预测器和一个稳定熵项。在本文中，我们旨在证明，向LeWorldModel进一步引入两个额外的潜在损失——一个后向动力学预测器和一个逆动力学动作预测器——能够加强潜在嵌入的结构，从而在性能和规划效率方面带来进一步的提升。这些特性对于提高此类方法在真实机器人实时基于模型控制中的适用性至关重要。我们在标准世界模型基准测试和两个模拟机器人操作任务中展示了这些提升。

Authors: Xinrui Zu, Michael Przystupa, Zhao Yang, Shujian Yu, Kevin Sebastian Luck

Library of Hands: Fix the Hands, Not the World Model WorldModel

world model closed-loop control action mapping training-free adaptation command-action discrepancy

简要说明：本文提出手部库（LoH），一种无需训练的方法，保持世界模型冻结，仅通过相机图像读取并修正动作应用映射（“手”），从而提高闭环任务成功率，同时在不改变环境时保持性能。

TLDR: This paper proposes Library of Hands (LoH), a training-free method that keeps the world model frozen and corrects the action-application map (the 'hand') by reading the hand through the world model with camera images, improving closed-loop task success rates while maintaining performance when the setup is unchanged.

Abstract: A world model predicts how a scene changes after an action, and a planner uses it to search for actions that reach a goal. If the camera moves or the controller changes, the same command moves the robot differently: when its commands are turned by 90 degrees, a frozen planner with the LeWM world model that succeeds in 77.5% of episodes succeeds in only 7.8%. Current fixes retrain the model, need training data, or forget a set-up when it returns. We propose Library of Hands (LoH), a training-free method that keeps the world model frozen and corrects only the map from commands to applied actions, which we call the hand. LoH reads the hand through the frozen model, with no extra sensor: it finds the action that best explains the change between two camera images (a reading). It stores every hand it identifies, so a returning set-up is recognised rather than re-learnt. In closed-loop tests, LoH more than doubles success on three simulated tasks, from 28.6% to 62.3%, and loses only 0.6 percentage points when nothing changes. It also works, unchanged, with two other world models and on two of three models pretrained on real robot data, and its gain grows with the quality of its readings.

摘要（中文）：世界模型能够预测场景在动作发生后如何变化，而规划器则利用这一模型搜索达成目标的动作序列。然而，当摄像头移动或控制器变更时，相同的指令会使机器人产生不同的动作效果：例如，当指令方向旋转90度时，使用LeWM世界模型的冻结规划器原本在77.5%的回合中能够成功，此时成功率骤降至仅7.8%。现有的修复方法需要重训模型、依赖训练数据，或在环境设置恢复时遗忘已学内容。我们提出“手部库”（LoH）方法，这是一种无需训练的方案，保持世界模型冻结不变，仅修正从指令到实际执行动作的映射，即我们所说的“手”。LoH通过冻结模型直接读取“手”的信息，无需额外传感器：它通过寻找最能解释两幅摄像头图像之间差异的动作来完成“读取”。系统会存储识别出的每一个“手”，从而在环境设置再次出现时能够直接识别，而非重新学习。在闭环测试中，LoH在三个模拟任务上的成功率从28.6%提升至62.3%，提升超过一倍，而在环境无变化时仅损失0.6个百分点。该方法无需改动即可适用于另外两种世界模型，并且在三个基于真实机器人数据预训练的模型中，有两个模型上表现良好，且其性能提升随读取质量的提高而增强。

Authors: Hasaan Ahmad, Qizhen Ying, Yuxuan Sun, Tianjin Huang, Guangming Wang

LawKAN: Group-Law Layers for Composition -- When Imposing a Known Law Pays Off Other

group laws robot kinematics neural architecture calibration SU(2)

简要说明：本文提出LawKAN，一种将已知群定律（如旋转复合）嵌入神经网络层的方法，仅学习残差修正，在SU(2)复合和真实机械臂运动学校准中，以更少参数达到高于经典或稠密基线的精度。

TLDR: This paper introduces LawKAN, a neural network layer that incorporates known group laws (e.g., rotation composition) for robotic tasks, learning only the residual corrections and achieving high accuracy with fewer parameters than classical or dense baselines in SU(2) composition and real robot arm kinematics calibration.

Abstract: Many tasks compose transformations by a known rule: chained rotations in robotics and navigation. Learned models relearn it, compounding error; classical estimators hardcode it and miss hardware deviations. We impose the known structure and learn only the remainder: an exact non-commutative group law sits in the node of a self-contained layer, its edges learn local increments, and a zero-initialized correction psi learns unknown deviations of the law. A pre-training criterion predicts exact representability. On fixed-angle SU(2) composition, a 54-parameter dense edge is the most accurate dense model, at 27x fewer parameters than the strongest fixed-matrix baseline, and lies 0.05 deg above the Bayes floor. On real robot arms, an isolated 306-parameter psi reaches 1.12-1.14 mm versus 1.29-1.33 mm for Gauss-Newton at N >= 60, and the recipe transfers across three vendors and two protocols. The recipe matches classical fits where the data obey the law and loses where the imposed law is not the task's.

摘要（中文）：许多任务通过已知规则组合变换：例如机器人学和导航中的链式旋转。学习模型会重新学习这一规则，从而累积误差；经典估计器则硬编码该规则，却无法适应硬件偏差。我们施加已知结构，仅学习剩余部分：一个精确的非交换群律位于自包含层内的节点上，其边学习局部增量，而零初始化的修正项ψ学习该群律的未知偏差。预训练准则预测精确可表示性。在固定角度SU(2)组合中，一个54参数的稠密边是最精确的稠密模型，其参数数量比最强的固定矩阵基线少27倍，且误差仅高出贝叶斯下限0.05度。在真实机器人臂上，一个独立的306参数ψ在N≥60时达到1.12–1.14毫米的精度，而高斯-牛顿法为1.29–1.33毫米；该方案可迁移至三个厂商和两种协议。当数据服从所施加的群律时，该方案与经典拟合效果相当；当所施加的群律并非任务本身时，其性能则有所下降。

Authors: Anna Mishchenko, Nikolai Gavrilin

RAIL: Representation-Aligned Imitation Learning for Student-Compatible Teacher Policies RLRobot

representation-aligned imitation learning teacher-student policy distillation contrastive learning privileged state information zero-shot transfer

简要说明：RAIL 提出了一种表示对齐的模仿学习方法，通过对比学习在共享潜在空间中训练教师策略，该空间与学生观察对齐，从而减少模仿差距并实现零样本迁移，无需奖励塑造或学生微调。

TLDR: RAIL introduces a representation-aligned imitation learning method that trains a teacher policy in a shared latent space aligned with student observations via contrastive learning, reducing the imitation gap and enabling zero-shot transfer without reward shaping or student fine-tuning.

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) from raw sensory inputs such as images or onboard sensors can be challenging due to high-dimensional observations and sparse rewards. A common strategy is to train a teacher policy with access to privileged state information and then distill it into a student policy that acts from raw inputs alone. However, when the teacher relies on information unavailable to the student, exact imitation may be impossible, creating an irreducible imitation gap. Existing approaches typically mitigate this mismatch through careful reward shaping or additional reinforcement learning on the student policy after the teacher has been trained. Instead, we introduce Representation-Aligned Imitation Learning (RAIL), which addresses the mismatch during teacher training itself. RAIL learns a latent representation shared across teacher and student observations using contrastive learning, and trains the teacher policy directly in this space. Because the teacher policy is constrained to operate on this shared space, it learns behaviors that are reproducible from student observations. This substantially reduces the imitation gap while preserving task performance. Across multiple environments, RAIL outperforms strong baselines without reward modification or post-hoc student fine-tuning, and surpasses direct reinforcement learning from raw observations. The learned representations further enable zero-shot transfer to new tasks through teacher-only training. Project site: https://merajmammadov.com/rail/.

摘要（中文）：从原始感官输入（如图像或机载传感器）进行强化学习（RL）可能因高维观测和稀疏奖励而颇具挑战。一种常见策略是训练一个能够访问特权状态信息的教师策略，然后将其蒸馏为仅基于原始输入行动的学生策略。然而，当教师依赖学生无法获取的信息时，精确模仿可能无法实现，从而产生不可约的模仿差距。现有方法通常通过精心设计的奖励塑形或在教师策略训练完成后对学生策略进行额外的强化学习来缓解这一不匹配问题。与此不同，我们提出了表示对齐模仿学习（RAIL），在教师训练过程中直接解决该不匹配问题。RAIL利用对比学习学习一个教师和学生观测共享的潜在表示，并直接在该空间中训练教师策略。由于教师策略被约束在此共享空间上运行，它能够学习到可从学生观测中复现的行为。这大幅缩小了模仿差距，同时保持了任务性能。在多个环境中，RAIL无需奖励修改或事后学生微调即可超越强基线方法，并且优于直接从原始观测进行的强化学习。所学习的表示还支持仅通过教师训练即可实现对新任务的零样本迁移。项目网站：https://merajmammadov.com/rail/。

Authors: Meraj Mammadov, Pedro Zuidberg Dos Martires, Johannes Andreas Stork

Compact and Wide-Force-Range Magnetorheological Hand Exoskeleton for Kinesthetic Feedback in Teleoperation Manipulation

kinesthetic feedback teleoperation hand exoskeleton magnetorheological brakes

简要说明：本文提出了一种使用磁流变制动器的紧凑型手部外骨骼，在遥操作中提供宽范围的动觉力反馈，改善刚度区分并降低物体接触力。

TLDR: This paper presents a compact hand exoskeleton using magnetorheological brakes to provide a wide range of kinesthetic force feedback for teleoperation, improving stiffness discrimination and reducing object contact forces.

Abstract: Hand kinesthetic feedback is crucial for restoring and enhancing human perception of force and displacement in robotic hand teleoperation. Wide perception range of force feedback is vital in rendering objects of different stiffness, especially for high-stiffness rendering. However, existing approaches struggle to achieve wide range of force feedback while maintaining compact and wearable design. This paper presents a hand exoskeleton system employing magnetorheological (MR) brakes to provide a wide range kinesthetic feedback during teleoperation. The MR brake provides a braking torque ranging from 0.01 to 0.918 Nm, while maintaining a compact structure with a total mass of only 39.8 g. The proposed exoskeleton can render fingertip forces up to 21 N while maintaining back-driving force of 1.01 N. Experimental results show that the system allows users to discriminate object stiffness using kinesthetic feedback alone. In a tele-grasping task, when both conditions achieved a 100% success rate, kinesthetic feedback led to a 28.2% reduction in object contact force compared to visual feedback only, enhancing object safety and operator immersion. Questionnaire results further indicate that kinesthetic feedback improves reliability, realism, and user confidence during teleoperation.

摘要（中文）：手部运动觉反馈对于在机械手遥操作中恢复和增强操作者对力与位移的感知至关重要。宽范围的力反馈感知能力对于呈现不同刚度的物体尤为关键，尤其是在高刚度渲染场景中。然而，现有方法在实现宽范围力反馈的同时，难以兼顾结构的紧凑性与可穿戴性。本文提出一种采用磁流变（MR）制动器的手部外骨骼系统，可在遥操作过程中提供宽范围的运动觉反馈。该MR制动器可提供的制动力矩范围为0.01至0.918 N·m，同时保持紧凑结构，总质量仅39.8 g。所提出的外骨骼系统能够渲染高达21 N的指尖力，同时保持1.01 N的反驱动力。实验结果表明，该系统允许用户仅依靠运动觉反馈即可区分物体刚度。在遥抓取任务中，当两种条件下均达到100%成功率时，与仅依赖视觉反馈相比，运动觉反馈使物体接触力降低了28.2%，从而增强了物体安全性并提升了操作者的沉浸感。问卷结果进一步表明，运动觉反馈在遥操作过程中增强了操作的可靠性、真实感和用户信心。

Authors: Xianlong Mai, Rui Yu, Rui Chen, Daniele Leonardis, Wenbo Li, Domenico Chiaradia, Antonio Frisoli, Shuaishuai Sun

Motion Belief Action: From a Visual Scene Map to Physical Decisions Manipulation

Motion Belief Action scene map physical decisions force limits risk setting

简要说明：本文提出运动信念动作（MBA），一种基于场景地图的决策层，利用运动和力信念帮助机器人在力限制下决定是否重新观察、轻推、打开、支撑或拒绝动作，并在真实厨房和门/抽屉数据及模拟VLA策略中展示了优于现有方法的效率。

TLDR: This paper introduces Motion Belief Action (MBA), a decision layer on scene maps that uses motion and force beliefs to help robots decide whether to look again, nudge, open, brace, or decline actions under force limits, demonstrating improved efficiency over existing methods on real kitchen and door/drawer data and in simulation with VLA policies.

Abstract: A robot that works among people must judge what it cannot see: whether an object is still where it was last seen, and whether a pull on a door or drawer is worth its risk. Maps that track object change hold nothing about force, maps of physical properties answer a risk question at a fixed risk level, and vision-language-action models keep no explicit estimate of hidden physics. We propose Motion Belief Action (MBA), a decision layer on the scene map. From how often people move an object and how much force it needs, how much load it holds and whether it is blocked, MBA chooses under a force limit to look again, nudge, open, brace or decline, with its risk set by the task's costs. On real activity in 9 kitchens, it predicts whether an object is still in place better than FreMEn and Perpetua, and decides when to look again at lower cost than these and the persistence filter, because about a quarter of placements end in a pick-up within 30 s. On real pulls of doors and drawers in 17 locations, made by a person with a force-sensing gripper, the map's force estimates decide better than a part-type average. Setting the risk from the costs also beats a published risk rule at its fixed level. In simulation, with the force limit at the training parts' median force, MBA raises SmolVLA's and Octo's scores by declining pulls; most declined door pulls would fail, but on drawers more would have opened, and a part-type average gets about half of this gain. In both, a published risk rule set to the risk these costs imply is MBA's rule for a single pull and decides as well in the main settings. A link between opening and holding force, a probing nudge and an action prior for camera tracking do not help in the main settings, and over the real-pull sweep the nudge costs a little.

摘要（中文）：在人群中工作的机器人必须判断其无法看见的事物：物体是否仍停留在上次所见的位置，以及拉动门或抽屉是否值得冒险。追踪物体变化的图谱不包含力的信息，物理属性图谱在固定风险水平下回答风险问题，而视觉-语言-动作模型则没有对隐藏物理状态的显式估计。我们提出运动信念动作（MBA）——一种基于场景地图的决策层。通过人们移动物体的频率及其所需的力、物体承载的负荷以及是否被阻挡，MBA在力限制下选择重新查看、轻推、打开、支撑或拒绝，其风险由任务的成本决定。在9个厨房的真实活动中，它预测物体是否仍在原位的能力优于FreMEn和Perpetua，并以低于这些方法及持久性滤波器的成本决定何时重新查看，因为约四分之一的放置会在30秒内以被取走告终。在17个位置由配备力感应夹爪的人对门和抽屉进行的真实拉动中，该地图的力估计比部件类型平均值做出更好的决策。根据成本设定风险也优于已发表的固定水平风险规则。在仿真中，当力限制设定为训练部件的中位力时，MBA通过拒绝拉动提升了SmolVLA和Octo的得分；大多数被拒绝的门拉动力会失败，但对抽屉而言更多本可打开，而部件类型平均值能获得约一半的收益。在两种情况下，已发表的以这些成本所蕴含风险设定的风险规则等价于MBA的单一拉动规则，并在主要设置中做出同样好的决策。打开力与保持力之间的联系、试探性轻推以及用于相机跟踪的动作先验在主要设置中没有帮助，而在真实拉动扫描中，轻推会带来少量成本。

Authors: Dibyendu Ghosh

SAM-VTP: Video Memory and Measured Geometry for Continuous Traversability Segmentation Locomotion

traversability prediction SAM2 video memory depth geometry autonomous navigation

简要说明：SAM-VTP 利用 SAM2 的视频记忆和从深度图测量的几何信息，实现无需提示的连续可通行性分割，减少帧间闪烁并提升闭环规划可行性。

TLDR: SAM-VTP enhances SAM2 with video memory and measured geometry from depth for temporally consistent, prompt-free traversability segmentation in autonomous ground navigation, reducing frame-to-frame flicker and improving closed-loop planner feasibility.

Abstract: Traversability prediction is a core component of autonomous navigation, yet most vision-based methods operate frame-wise and produce temporally inconsistent predictions. We present SAM-VTP (Video Traversability Prediction), which fine-tunes SAM2's video memory pathway for dense, prompt-free traversability segmentation, conditioning each frame on a persistent memory of prior observations. Rather than inferring terrain geometry from appearance, we measure it: slope, roughness and height are computed from depth and fused into the image features. We also introduce an offline continuous supervision pipeline that generates dense per-pixel traversability targets in [0,1] from depth-derived geometry and semantic priors, requiring no robot deployment and no per-pixel annotation, capturing conditional feasibility that binary labels cannot represent. On TartanGround, a large-scale synthetic ground-robot dataset, SAM-VTP improves fuzzy Jaccard from 0.908 to 0.924 and binary IoU from 0.854 to 0.886 over SAM-TP, a frame-wise SAM2 baseline, against a seed-to-seed spread below 0.001, and cuts frame-to-frame flicker by 31%. In closed-loop trials at two field sites, driving the same planner and controller, the baseline's dropouts leave the planner without a feasible path 3.3x more often on a paved course and 6.9x on rough ground, while SAM-VTP runs at 21.4 FPS on the Orin Nano the robot carries.

摘要（中文）：可通行性预测是自主导航的核心组成部分，然而大多数基于视觉的方法逐帧运行，产生时间上不一致的预测结果。我们提出了SAM-VTP（视频可通行性预测），该方法对SAM2的视频记忆通路进行微调，以实现密集、无需提示的可通行性分割，将每一帧与先前观测的持久记忆进行条件关联。我们并非从外观推断地形几何，而是直接测量：坡度、粗糙度和高度由深度计算得出，并融合到图像特征中。我们还引入了一条离线连续监督流程，从深度推导的几何信息和语义先验中生成[0,1]范围内的密集逐像素可通行性目标，无需机器人部署和逐像素标注，能够捕捉二值标签无法表示的条件可行性。在Tartanground（大规模合成地面机器人数据集）上，与逐帧SAM2基线SAM-TP相比，SAM-VTP将模糊Jaccard指数从0.908提升至0.924，二值IoU从0.854提升至0.886，而随机种子间的差异低于0.001，并将帧间闪烁减少了31%。在两个场地的闭环试验中，使用相同的规划器和控制器，基线的丢失导致规划器无法获得可行路径的频率在铺装路面上高出3.3倍，在崎岖地面上高出6.9倍，而SAM-VTP在机器人搭载的Orin Nano上以21.4 FPS的速度运行。

Authors: Lucas Hoefs, Hui Xie, Senjian An, Fangyi Zhang

Learning Contextual Motion Constraints for Object Rearrangement Exploration Manipulation

two-stream neural network motion constraint prediction obstacle heatmap articulated objects rearrangement planning

简要说明：MoCo-Net 是一种双流神经网络，从部分视角点云中联合预测铰接对象的可行运动范围和障碍物热图，从而在杂乱场景中实现高效的重排规划。

TLDR: MoCo-Net is a two-stream neural network that jointly predicts feasible motion ranges and obstacle heatmaps for articulated objects from partial-view point clouds, enabling efficient rearrangement planning in cluttered scenes.

Abstract: The motion of an articulated part in cluttered surroundings is constrained not only by an object's intrinsic joint limits but also by extrinsic obstacles. However, existing approaches primarily consider object articulation properties alone. Here we present Motion Constraint Prediction Network (MoCo-Net), a two-stream neural network that jointly predicts the continuous motion ranges of articulated parts and obstacle heatmaps highlighting potential collision regions from partial-view point cloud observation. By capturing both internal and external motion constraints, MoCo-Net produces more accurate feasible motion range prediction and obstacles recognition, improves generalization for novel objects in new scenes, and enables robots to construct a scene configuration space for efficient exploration of rearrangement actions. Our experiments show that MoCo-Net's two-stream design enhances each other to deliver more accurate predictions, which subsequently form a compact configuration space for a customized planner to efficiently rearrange the scene.

摘要（中文）：在杂乱环境中，铰接部件的运动不仅受物体自身关节限位约束，还受外部障碍物的制约。然而，现有方法主要仅考虑物体的铰接属性。本文提出运动约束预测网络（MoCo-Net），一种双流神经网络，可从部分视角点云观测中联合预测铰接部件的连续运动范围及突出潜在碰撞区域的障碍物热力图。通过同时捕捉内部与外部运动约束，MoCo-Net能够更准确地预测可行运动范围并识别障碍物，提升对新场景中新型物体的泛化能力，并使机器人能够构建场景构型空间，以高效探索重排操作。实验表明，MoCo-Net的双流设计相互增强，提供更精确的预测，并据此形成紧凑的构型空间，供定制化规划器高效完成场景重排。

Authors: Lexing Zhang, Zeyu Zhang, Gang Zeng, Hangxin Liu

CSG-Nav: Confidence-Aware Semantic-Geometric Fusion for Robust Exploration and Accurate Zero-Shot Object-Goal Navigation VLN

object-goal navigation semantic-geometric fusion confidence-aware zero-shot navigation open-vocabulary detection

简要说明：CSG-Nav 是一个零样本目标导航框架，通过置信度加权的语义、空间和几何信息融合，提升不确定感知下的探索与目标停止决策，在多个基准和真实环境中取得有竞争力的成功率。

TLDR: CSG-Nav is a zero-shot object-goal navigation framework that fuses semantic, spatial, and geometric information with confidence weighting to improve exploration and goal termination under uncertain perception, achieving competitive success rates on multiple benchmarks and in real-world tests.

Abstract: Zero-shot object-goal navigation requires autonomous agents to explore unseen environments and locate target objects without task-specific training, posing challenges in perceptual reliability under observation uncertainty and physically grounded goal termination. Although foundation-model-based approaches improve generalization, they remain vulnerable to unreliable long-range perception, hallucination-induced directional bias, and semantically plausible but geometrically incorrect stopping decisions. To address these limitations, we propose CSG-Nav, a zero-shot navigation framework centered on confidence-aware multimodal information fusion. CSG-Nav integrates three complementary fusion mechanisms. First, semantic-source fusion integrates open-vocabulary detection results, detection confidence, scene observations, and relational reasoning to produce more reliable direction-level semantic scores and suppress hallucination-induced directional bias. Second, spatial-confidence fusion weights multi-view semantic evidence using a Gaussian decay function, suppressing unreliable distant observations while accumulating spatially consistent exploration preferences. Third, semantic-geometric decision fusion combines semantic target detection with depth-based 3D localization to support physically grounded stopping decisions. Experiments on HM3Dv1, HM3Dv2, and MP3D demonstrate competitive zero-shot performance, achieving success rates of 58.9%, 71.6%, and 44.3%. Fusion-level ablations and real-world deployments in indoor and outdoor environments further verify the effectiveness and practicality of CSG-Nav for robust navigation under uncertain perception. Code is available at https://xr-ui.github.io/CSGNav.github.io/

摘要（中文）：零样本目标导向导航要求自主体在未见过的环境中探索并定位目标物体，且无需任务特定训练，这在观测不确定性下感知可靠性及物理合理的目标终止判定方面带来了挑战。尽管基于基础模型的方法提升了泛化能力，但其仍易受不可靠的远距离感知、幻觉诱发的方向偏差，以及语义上合理但几何上错误的停止决策影响。为解决上述局限性，我们提出CSG-Nav，一种以置信度感知的多模态信息融合为核心的零样本导航框架。CSG-Nav整合了三种互补的融合机制。其一，语义源融合将开放词汇检测结果、检测置信度、场景观测与关系推理相结合，以生成更可靠的方向级语义分数，并抑制幻觉引起的方向偏差。其二，空间置信度融合利用高斯衰减函数对多视角语义证据进行加权，在抑制不可靠远距离观测的同时累积空间一致的探索偏好。其三，语义-几何决策融合将语义目标检测与基于深度的三维定位相结合，以支持物理合理的停止决策。在HM3Dv1、HM3Dv2和MP3D上的实验展示了竞争性的零样本性能，成功率分别达到58.9%、71.6%和44.3%。融合级消融实验及在室内外环境中的实际部署进一步验证了CSG-Nav在不确定感知条件下实现鲁棒导航的有效性与实用性。代码已发布于 https://xr-ui.github.io/CSGNav.github.io/

Authors: Shoubin Chen, Rui Xu, Zehao Wu, Kai Zhang, Tao Huang, Zhou Liu, Qingquan Li

Reliability-Adaptive Multimodal Relative Pose Tracking for Underwater Leader-Follower Robots RLRobot

multimodal fusion relative pose estimation underwater robots formation control reliability adaptation

简要说明：提出一种可靠性自适应的多模态感知框架，融合视觉、声学测距和水动力测量实现水下领航-跟随机器人的六自由度相对位姿跟踪，并在自建AUV平台上通过648次水池实验和闭环编队实验验证。

TLDR: A reliability-adaptive multimodal perception framework fuses visual, acoustic-ranging, and hydrodynamic measurements for efficient 6-DOF relative-pose tracking between leader-follower underwater robots, validated on a custom AUV platform with 648 pool trials and closed-loop formation experiments.

Abstract: Underwater leader-follower formation control requires continuous relative-pose estimation despite degraded sensing conditions and limited onboard computation. This paper presents a reliability-adaptive multimodal perception framework for six-degree-of-freedom relative-pose tracking between two moving underwater robots. The framework integrates complementary visual, acoustic-ranging, and hydrodynamic measurements while accounting for their distinct physical characteristics and time-varying reliability. It adaptively weights modality contributions and models temporal dependencies with linear computational complexity, enabling efficient pose estimation on embedded hardware. Extensive experiments were conducted using a custom-built AUV platform, with 648 pool trials spanning two leader vehicle types, three illumination conditions, and nine trajectory patterns. Evaluation yields an average translational error of 3.8 cm and an average orientation error of 2.4°. On an onboard NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin, the fusion network achieves an inference latency of 17.62 ms, providing a 2.69-fold speedup over the evaluated Transformer-based fusion baseline. Closed-loop experiments further demonstrate stable formation maintenance with a moving leader under onboard computational constraints. A multimodal dataset containing measurements from all 648 trials will be made publicly available.

摘要（中文）：水下领航者-跟随者编队控制要求即使在传感条件退化且机载计算资源有限的情况下，仍能持续进行相对位姿估计。本文提出了一种面向两艘运动水下机器人之间六自由度相对位姿跟踪的可靠性自适应多模态感知框架。该框架融合了互补的视觉、声学测距和水动力测量信息，同时考虑了它们各自不同的物理特性及随时间变化的可靠性。它自适应地为各模态贡献分配权重，并以线性计算复杂度对时间依赖性进行建模，从而能够在嵌入式硬件上实现高效的位姿估计。我们使用自主搭建的AUV平台开展了大量实验，共进行了648次水池试验，涵盖了两种领航者艇型、三种光照条件和九种轨迹模式。评估结果显示，平均平移误差为3.8厘米，平均姿态误差为2.4°。在机载NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin上，融合网络的推理延迟为17.62毫秒，相比所评估的基于Transformer的融合基线实现了2.69倍的加速。闭环实验进一步证明了在机载计算约束下，系统能够与运动中的领航者保持稳定的编队。包含全部648次试验测量数据的一个多模态数据集将公开提供。

Authors: Mingyang Yang, Zeyu Sha, Xiaorui Wang, Jun Wang, David Chen Wang, Feitian Zhang

Design of a hybrid tendon-linkage finger with coupled and adaptive motion Manipulation

hybrid tendon-linkage coupled and adaptive motion dexterous robotic finger underactuated mechanism fingertip force

简要说明：本文设计了一种混合腱-连杆机器人手指，由三个驱动器驱动四个机械自由度，实现了耦合并自适应运动，无需额外的DIP关节驱动器。

TLDR: This paper designs a hybrid tendon-linkage robotic finger with four degrees of freedom driven by three actuators, achieving coupled and adaptive motion for dexterous grasping without an extra DIP actuator.

Abstract: Dexterous robotic fingers require coordinated joint motion and adaptability to object contact, while independently actuating multiple joints increases the complexity of the transmission mechanism. This paper presents a hybrid tendon--linkage robotic finger with four mechanical degrees of freedom driven by three actuators. The MCP abduction/adduction joint is driven through a bevel gear, while MCP and PIP flexion/extension are driven by separate bidirectional tendon transmissions. The DIP joint is not independently actuated but is coupled to the PIP joint through a four-bar linkage with a torsional spring and mechanical stopper. The tendon routing also introduces mechanical coupling between the MCP and PIP joints. Kinematic analysis was conducted to describe the coupled and adaptive motions, and experiments were performed to evaluate the joint motion characteristics. ArUco-based measurements showed that the coupled motion closely matched the theoretical prediction, whereas the adaptive motion was partially limited by interference between linkage components. The fabricated finger demonstrated different contact postures with cylindrical, cuboid, and irregularly shaped objects, and the mean peak fingertip force was 4.56 N. The proposed mechanism provides both coupled motion and contact-dependent adaptation without requiring an additional actuator for the DIP joint.

摘要（中文）：灵巧机器人手指需要关节协同运动与物体接触适应性，而多关节独立驱动则会增加传动机构的复杂性。本文提出了一种由三个驱动器驱动、具有四个机械自由度的混合腱—连杆机器人手指。MCP外展/内收关节通过锥齿轮驱动，而MCP和PIP关节的屈曲/伸展则由独立的双向腱传动驱动。DIP关节不独立驱动，而是通过带有扭簧和机械限位挡块的四杆机构与PIP关节耦合。腱的走线还在MCP与PIP关节之间引入了机械耦合。本文进行了运动学分析以描述耦合运动和自适应运动，并通过实验评估了关节运动特性。基于ArUco的测量结果表明，耦合运动与理论预测高度吻合，而自适应运动则在一定程度上受到连杆组件间干涉的限制。所制作的手指在与圆柱体、长方体及不规则形状物体接触时表现出不同的接触姿态，平均指尖峰值力为4.56 N。所提出的机构在不增加DIP关节驱动器的前提下，同时实现了耦合运动与基于接触的自适应能力。

Authors: Hyojae Kang, Giup Seo, Jae-Young Lee, Yeong Jae Park, Jongwoo Park, Hyunmin Do, So-Hee Park, Dongil Park, Jeongdo Ahn

Action Representation for Spatial Generalization in Robot World Models WorldModel

action representation spatial generalization world models coordinate frames robotic peeling

简要说明：本文通过机器人剥离基准，研究了不同坐标框架下的动作表示如何影响机器人世界模型的空间泛化，表明保留物理关系比最小化坐标变化更为重要。

TLDR: This paper investigates how action representations in different coordinate frames affect spatial generalization in robot world models, using a robotic peeling benchmark to show that preserving physical relationships is more important than minimizing coordinate variation.

Abstract: Spatial generalization in robot world models depends on whether action representations capture the physical relationships that remain valid across changing spatial configurations. Yet different coordinates can describe the same interaction, whereas similar motions can produce different outcomes when local physical conditions change. How these distinctions affect learned prediction remains insufficiently understood. This study evaluates matched action representations defined in world, object, and surface coordinate frames using a controlled robotic peeling benchmark. Global pose and contact relocation experiments reveal a cost associated with limited training data when equivalent interactions receive different spatial descriptions. Removing information about peel thickness creates an irreducible ambiguity because identical predictive inputs can correspond to different material removal outcomes. Coordinates defined relative to the surface improve consequence prediction and counterfactual action selection under accurate local observations, but learned predictors remain vulnerable to uncertainty in the coordinate frame. Joint centering of the surface and tool removes sensitivity to translation of their common origin, whereas incorrect contact geometry and actual execution deviations introduce different failure mechanisms. These results show that effective spatial generalization depends on preserving the relationships between actions and states that determine physical consequences, rather than simply minimizing coordinate variation. This perspective provides a principled basis for designing robot world models that reuse physical knowledge across spatial configurations while retaining the distinctions essential to prediction and planning.

摘要（中文）：机器人世界模型中的空间泛化能力取决于动作表征是否捕捉了在空间配置变化时仍然有效的物理关系。然而，不同的坐标系可以描述相同的交互作用，而当局部物理条件发生变化时，相似的运动可能产生不同的结果。这些差异如何影响学习到的预测仍未得到充分理解。本研究使用受控的机器人剥离基准任务，评估了在世界坐标系、物体坐标系和表面坐标系中定义的匹配动作表征。全局位姿和接触重定位实验表明，当等效交互获得不同的空间描述时，有限训练数据会带来相应的代价。去除剥离厚度信息会产生不可约的模糊性，因为相同的预测输入可能对应不同的材料去除结果。相对于表面定义的坐标在准确的局部观测下能够改进后果预测和反事实动作选择，但学习到的预测器仍然容易受到坐标系不确定性的影响。表面与工具的共同居中消除了对其共同原点平移的敏感性，而错误的接触几何和实际的执行偏差则引入了不同的失效机制。这些结果表明，有效的空间泛化依赖于保持决定物理后果的动作与状态之间的关系，而非简单地最小化坐标变化。这一视角为设计机器人世界模型提供了原理性基础，使其能够在不同空间配置间复用物理知识，同时保留对预测和规划至关重要的区分信息。

Authors: Yuhang Sun

ROS2MR: Connecting ROS 2 Motion Planning to Mixed-Reality Trajectory Visualization Manipulation

mixed reality ROS 2 motion planning trajectory visualization cubic Hermite interpolation MoveIt

简要说明：ROS2MR 扩展了 MR-Robotics LAB 平台，将 ROS 2 关节轨迹（包括 MoveIt 计划）转换为 JSON 格式，以在 Meta Quest 3 和 Apple Vision Pro 上进行混合现实回放，并评估了插值精度和夹爪时序。

TLDR: ROS2MR extends the MR-Robotics LAB platform to convert ROS 2 joint trajectories, including MoveIt plans, into JSON for mixed-reality playback on Meta Quest 3 and Apple Vision Pro, with a technical evaluation of interpolation accuracy and gripper timing.

Abstract: Mixed reality (MR) allows users to inspect planned robot motion within their physical surroundings, but displaying trajectories from robotics software requires converting their joint configurations and timing into a format the MR application can play back. This paper presents ROS2MR, an extension of the MR-Robotics LAB platform that converts YAML-serialized ROS 2 joint trajectories, including MoveIt motion plans, into the platform's existing JSON playback format. The converter validates the input, maps arm joints by name, and resamples the trajectory at a nominal rate of 30 Hz, using cubic Hermite interpolation when joint velocities are supplied and linear interpolation otherwise, while binary gripper commands are sampled separately using a zero-order hold. A Python export helper combines sequences of motion plans and gripper states into a single trajectory and checks positional agreement at segment boundaries. The MR application was also adapted for Apple Vision Pro in addition to Meta Quest 3. A technical evaluation showed that the converter preserved the normalized duration and endpoint configurations for dense, sparse, and irregularly timed inputs. With supplied velocities, the position RMSE was approximately 2.91x10^-5 degrees for all sampling patterns; without them, sparse input increased it to 0.85 degrees, and close positional agreement did not guarantee accurate velocity profiles. A pick-and-place sequence retained its open--closed--open gripper order, although off-grid transitions were shifted to the output sampling grid. The resulting file-based pathway enables inspection of ROS-generated trajectories in MR without a live ROS connection.

摘要（中文）：混合现实（MR）技术允许用户在物理环境中查看规划中的机器人运动，但显示来自机器人软件的运动轨迹需要将其关节配置和时间信息转换为MR应用可回放的格式。本文介绍了ROS2MR，这是MR-Robotics LAB平台的一个扩展，可将YAML序列化的ROS 2关节轨迹（包括MoveIt运动规划）转换为该平台现有的JSON回放格式。该转换器对输入进行验证，按名称映射机械臂关节，并以30 Hz的标称速率对轨迹进行重采样，当提供关节速度时使用三次Hermite插值，否则使用线性插值，而二值夹爪指令则使用零阶保持器单独采样。一个Python导出辅助工具可将运动规划序列和夹爪状态组合为单一轨迹，并检查段边界处的位置一致性。MR应用也已适配Apple Vision Pro，而不仅仅是Meta Quest 3。技术评估表明，该转换器对密集、稀疏和不规则时间输入的归一化持续时间和终点配置均能保持。在提供速度的情况下，所有采样模式的位置RMSE约为2.91×10⁻⁵度；未提供速度时，稀疏输入将该误差增大至0.85度，且位置上的高度一致并不能保证速度剖面的准确性。一个拾放序列保持了开—闭—开夹爪顺序，尽管网格外的转换被移至输出采样网格上。所得到的基于文件的路径使得无需实时ROS连接即可在MR中查看ROS生成的轨迹。

Authors: Santiago Berrezueta-Guzman, Habiba-Loai Khalil, Andrei Koshelev, Stefan Wagner

Planners Exploit Deterministic Error: Dithered Low-Bit World Models WorldModel

low-bit quantization world models sampling-based planning dithering TD-MPC2

简要说明：本文发现低比特量化世界模型中的确定性舍入误差会导致基于采样的规划器崩溃，而共享抖动无需训练即可缓解该问题，并在GPU上实现更快的规划。

TLDR: This paper identifies that deterministic rounding errors in low-bit quantized world models cause sampling-based planners to collapse, while shared dithering mitigates the issue without training, enabling faster planning on GPU.

Abstract: Sampling-based planners such as MPPI and CEM query a learned world model thousands of times per control step, so low-bit world models are an obvious way to make model-based control cheaper on a robot. With round-to-nearest activation quantization and no calibration, we find that planning can collapse, by up to 100 points of success, while the world model's latent one-step prediction error stays no larger than that of a stochastic rounding scheme that plans well. At the same bit width, what decides the outcome is not the size of the rounding error but whether it persists across planner iterations and is shared across candidates. Round-to-nearest leaves an error that persists, and an iterating planner drifts toward the candidates that this error favors; in TD-MPC2, holding the same dither fixed within a step or an episode brings the drift back. Dither shared by all candidates and redrawn at every iteration removes most of the damage at the same bit width and without training: at least half of it in all 19 affected Meta-World cells (task $\times$ bit width) of TD-MPC2 (median 95%), in 4 of 5 DINO-WM cells, and in all 8 affected tasks of a 317M-parameter multi-task TD-MPC2. Captured as CUDA graphs on an Ampere GPU, a W8A4 integer TD-MPC2 world model runs its planning rollouts 1.9-3.3$\times$ and the whole planning step 1.3-1.5$\times$ faster than FP32, though not faster than BF16 with pre-converted weights; shared dither adds at most 2.3% latency. In TD-MPC2, block-scaled NVFP4 removes most of the damage and MXFP4 part of it, which ties the failure to coarse grids with a shared scale. Hypotheses, thresholds and analysis code were fixed before the data that test them, and the hypotheses that failed are reported.

摘要（中文）：基于采样的规划器（如MPPI和CEM）在每个控制步中会查询学习到的世界模型数千次，因此低位宽世界模型是降低机器人上基于模型控制成本的一种直接方式。采用四舍五入到最近值的激活量化且不进行校准，我们发现规划可能崩溃，成功率下降高达100个百分点，而世界模型的潜在单步预测误差并不大于一种随机舍入方案（该方案规划良好）的误差。在相同位宽下，决定结果的关键并非舍入误差的大小，而是该误差是否在规划迭代间持续存在，以及是否在候选样本间共享。四舍五入到最近值留下的误差持续存在，迭代规划器会向该误差所偏好的候选样本漂移；在TD-MPC2中，若在单步或单个回合内保持相同的抖动固定不变，则可以消除这种漂移。在所有候选样本间共享并在每次迭代重新采样的抖动，能够在相同位宽下且无需训练即可消除大部分损害：在TD-MPC2受影响的全部19个Meta-World单元（任务$\times$位宽）中，至少消除一半以上的损害（中位数为95%），在DINO-WM的5个单元中有4个如此，以及在具有3.17亿参数的多任务TD-MPC2所有8个受影响任务中均如此。在Ampere GPU上以CUDA图方式捕获时，W8A4整数TD-MPC2世界模型的规划展开速度比FP32快1.9-3.3倍，整个规划步骤快1.3-1.5倍，但仍逊于使用预转换权重的BF16；共享抖动增加的延迟最多为2.3%。在TD-MPC2中，块缩放NVFP4消除了大部分损害，而MXFP4仅消除部分损害，这表明失效与具有共享尺度的粗网格相关。假设、阈值和分析代码均在测试数据之前确定，且失败的假设也已如实报告。

Authors: Yong Hwi Song, Keon Myung Lee

Particle Filtering with Generative Trajectory Models for State Estimation and Control WorldModel

particle filtering generative trajectory models state estimation control diffusion model

简要说明：本文提出在预训练生成轨迹模型上使用粒子滤波来改进机器人状态估计和控制，并在导航和操作仿真中验证了无需修改模型的性能提升。

TLDR: This paper proposes using particle filtering with a pretrained generative trajectory model to improve state estimation and control in robotics, demonstrating gains in navigation and manipulation simulations without modifying the model.

Abstract: Generative models can support both state estimation and control in robotics. For control, a common approach is to use the model as a policy that directly samples actions conditioned on observation histories. However, models that jointly represent states, actions, and observations can also predict how the robot state and its environment evolve. We investigate whether these predictions can improve state estimation and control through a change in inference procedure, without modifying the pretrained model. To this end, we use particle filtering to maintain competing hypotheses about state histories. A single pretrained diffusion model generates these hypotheses along with their predicted observations and associated action proposals. As new measurements arrive, particles are reweighted according to how well their predicted observations match the measurements. While particle filtering conventionally uses these weights only for state estimation, we also use them to guide action selection, favoring proposals associated with hypotheses that better explain the observations. Simulation experiments in partially observed navigation and vision-based manipulation demonstrate improvements in both state estimation and task performance compared to action generation without filtering, using the same pretrained model and no additional test-time information.

摘要（中文）：生成模型能够同时支持机器人领域中的状态估计与控制。在控制方面，常见做法是将模型用作策略，直接基于观测历史采样动作。然而，联合表示状态、动作和观测的模型也能预测机器人状态及其环境的演变过程。我们探究能否通过改变推理流程，在不修改预训练模型的前提下，利用这些预测来改进状态估计与控制。为此，我们采用粒子滤波来维持关于状态历史的竞争性假设。一个预训练的扩散模型生成这些假设及其对应的预测观测和关联的动作提议。当新的测量数据到达时，粒子根据其预测观测与测量数据的匹配程度被重新加权。尽管粒子滤波传统上仅将这些权重用于状态估计，我们也将其用于引导动作选择，优先选择与更能解释观测结果的假设相关联的提议。在部分可观测导航和基于视觉的操作任务的仿真实验中，与无滤波的动作生成方法相比，使用相同的预训练模型且不依赖额外的测试时信息，我们的方法在状态估计和任务性能方面均表现出改进。

Authors: Lukas Lao Beyer, Samvit Das, Sertac Karaman

Brain-Aligned Latent Actions: Imposing Premotor Cortex Geometry on a Robot's Action Vocabulary Manipulation

latent actions tokenizer premotor cortex representational similarity straight-through loss

简要说明：本文提出将机器人策略的潜在动作分词器与猕猴前运动皮层的表征几何对齐，以稳定并语义化动作代码，在未见形状类别上提高了与PMv的表征相似性。

TLDR: This paper proposes aligning the latent action tokenizer of a robot policy with the representational geometry of macaque premotor cortex to stabilize and semantically ground action codes, showing improved representational similarity to PMv on unseen shape categories.

Abstract: Robot policies increasingly act through a small vocabulary of discrete latent actions learned from unlabeled video, yet training leaves open which motion receives which code. We find this choice highly unstable: two independently trained runs of Moto's latent motion tokenizer assign the same robot clips to nearly unrelated codes (adjusted Rand index 0.001), and evaluating one tokenizer in bf16 instead of fp32 reassigns 74% of its tokens. We use this freedom to impose the representational geometry of macaque ventral premotor cortex (PMv), recorded while a monkey drew shapes, on the tokenizer's code assignment, with a straight-through similarity loss trained alongside its reconstruction objective on robot video. In one training run per target, on five shape categories the loss never saw, the PMv-trained tokenizer reaches a representational similarity of 0.52 with PMv, against 0.20-0.26 for released and no-prior tokenizers and 0.42 for the 95th percentile of random kinematic encoders. Kinematic, language, and random targets do not transfer (-0.17 to -0.03). Two results limit the claim: a hand-picked kinematic descriptor, the stroke's initial direction, matches PMv better (0.65), and a label-shuffled PMv control scores 0.41. We specify the downstream manipulation test, on a CALVIN pipeline that reproduces Moto's published results, before running it.

摘要（中文）：机器人策略日益通过从无标注视频中学习到的少量离散潜在动作词汇来运作，然而训练过程中并未明确规定哪种动作对应哪个编码。我们发现这一选择高度不稳定：Moto潜动作分词器的两次独立训练运行将相同的机器人片段分配到了几乎不相关的编码中（调整兰德指数为0.001），并且以bf16而非fp32评估同一个分词器时，其74%的标记被重新分配。我们利用这一自由度，将猕猴腹侧前运动皮层（PMv）的表征几何结构施加到分词器的编码分配上，该皮层数据是在猴子绘制形状时记录的，并通过一个与重建目标共同训练的直通相似性损失作用于机器人视频。在每种目标各一次训练运行中，对于损失函数从未见过的五种形状类别，经PMv训练的分词器与PMv的表征相似度达到0.52，而发布版分词器和无先验分词器为0.20-0.26，随机运动学编码器的第95百分位为0.42。运动学、语言和随机目标均未迁移（-0.17至-0.03）。有两个结果限制了这一论断：一个精心挑选的运动学描述符——笔画的初始方向——与PMv的匹配度更高（0.65），以及标签打乱的PMv对照评分为0.41。我们在运行下游操作测试之前，先在一个复现Moto已发表结果的CALVIN流程上明确了该测试的规范。

Authors: Amit Jadhav

Enhancing Balance and Posture in Material Handling Tasks with a Wearable Robotic Tail HumanoidEmbodied

wearable robotic tail balance posture material handling muscle activity

简要说明：本文介绍了一种可穿戴机器人尾巴作为物料搬运中的动态配重，通过人体实验证明其能减少压力中心位移、躯干运动及肌肉活动，支持其用于改善平衡。

TLDR: This paper introduces a wearable robotic tail as a dynamic counterbalance for material handling, demonstrating reduced center of pressure displacement, trunk motion, and muscle activity in a human study, supporting its use for improving balance.

Abstract: Frequent heavy lifting is linked to musculoskeletal strain, with lower back pain affecting up to 40% of manual labourers. Inspired by animals using tails for balance, we developed a wearable robotic tail as a dynamic counterbalance. Ten participants performed an imitated shelf loading/unloading task across three conditions: active tail, passive tail, and no tail. Kinematics, centre of pressure, and muscle activation (gastrocnemius, erector spinae, tibialis anterior, biceps brachii) were measured. Compared with no tail, the active tail achieved >20 mm reduction in centre of pressure peak displacement, 4.3 degree reduction in trunk motion, and >9% and >20% reductions in erector spinae and gastrocnemius activity, respectively. The passive tail produced smaller reductions, suggesting passive counterbalancing helps while active movement augments it further. Biceps brachii activation increased with the active versus passive tail. The ankle kinematics and tibialis anterior activation were unchanged. These findings support wearable robotic tails for improving balance during material handling.

摘要（中文）：频繁的重物搬运与肌肉骨骼劳损密切相关，其中下背痛影响了高达40%的体力劳动者。受动物利用尾巴维持平衡的启发，我们开发了一种可穿戴的机器人尾巴，作为动态平衡配重。十名参与者在三种条件下完成模拟货架装载/卸载任务：主动尾巴、被动尾巴和无尾巴。测量了运动学数据、压力中心及肌肉激活情况（腓肠肌、竖脊肌、胫骨前肌、肱二头肌）。与无尾巴条件相比，主动尾巴使压力中心峰值位移减少超过20毫米，躯干运动减少4.3度，竖脊肌和腓肠肌的活动分别降低超过9%和20%。被动尾巴产生的减少幅度较小，表明被动配重有助于平衡，而主动运动则进一步增强效果。与被动尾巴相比，主动尾巴条件下肱二头肌的激活增加。踝关节运动学和胫骨前肌激活未见显著变化。这些发现支持可穿戴机器人尾巴在物料搬运过程中改善平衡的可行性。

Authors: Eisa Anwar, Sajeeva Abeywardena, Stuart C. Miller, Ildar Farkhatdinov

FlowEval: How Much Adaptation Does an Embodied Foundation Model Need at Deployment? VLA

embodied foundation models flow-matching objective deployment adaptation Pi-0.5 GR00T

简要说明：该论文提出了FlowEval，一种无需训练的评估方法，利用流匹配目标探测具身基础模型，通过少量成功演示来估计部署所需的适应程度。

TLDR: This paper introduces FlowEval, a training-free diagnostic that uses the flow-matching objective to probe embodied foundation models with a small set of successful target-domain demonstrations, estimating how much adaptation is needed for deployment.

Abstract: Large-scale pretraining is reducing the amount of adaptation required to deploy embodied foundation models, but it is not guaranteed that a pretrained model already provide the level of performance required in every deployment. Practitioners therefore need to understand how well a pretrained model matches a target deployment and how much adaptation data is left to be collected. We study whether a small set of successful target-domain demonstrations can reveal whether and how much target-domain data will be required before any adaptation. We introduce FlowEval, a set of training-free metrics that use the flow-matching objective to probe an embodied foundation model with a set of demonstrations. FlowEval quantifies predictive disagreement on successful target demonstrations to assess how well a pretrained model fits a target deployment. Across four embodied foundation model families: Pi-0.5, MolmoAct2, GR00T, and DreamZero, FlowEval distinguishes seen from unseen deployments across real-world and simulated manipulation. Further, by finetuning Pi-0.5 and GR00T on 17 RoboCasa365 manipulation tasks, we showed that FlowEval correlates with how success rate improves as additional adaptation data is provided. Together, these results suggest that FlowEval can serve as a lightweight, training-free diagnostic of how much model--deployment adaptation may be required.

摘要（中文）：大规模预训练正在减少部署具身基础模型所需的适配工作量，但并不能保证预训练模型在每次部署中都已具备所需的性能水平。因此，实践者需要了解预训练模型与目标部署的匹配程度，以及还需收集多少适配数据。我们研究了一小组成功的目标域演示是否能在任何适配之前揭示目标域数据的必要性及其所需规模。我们提出了FlowEval，一组无需训练的度量标准，利用流匹配目标来探测具身基础模型对一组演示的响应。FlowEval量化了模型对成功目标演示的预测不一致性，以评估预训练模型与目标部署的拟合程度。在四个具身基础模型系列——Pi-0.5、MolmoAct2、GR00T和DreamZero上，FlowEval能够区分真实世界和模拟操作中的已见与未见部署。此外，通过在17个RoboCasa365操作任务上对Pi-0.5和GR00T进行微调，我们证明了FlowEval与成功率随额外适配数据增加而提升的趋势具有相关性。综合来看，这些结果表明FlowEval可以作为一种轻量级、无需训练的诊断工具，用于评估模型与部署之间可能需要的适配程度。

Authors: Zhang Xi-Jia, Roman Yakunin, Shivang Chopra, Chengyue Huang, Che Chen, Siddharth Karamcheti, Zsolt Kira

ColNav: Uncertainty-Aware Spacetime Collision Checking with Bounding Volume Hierarchies Other

collision checking uncertainty-aware spacetime tubes bounding volume hierarchies mobile robot navigation

简要说明：ColNav 提出了一种鲁棒的移动机器人导航碰撞检测方法，将位置/速度不确定性编码为时空管并组织成包围体层次结构，在动态环境中实现了高成功率和更大间隙，并在实体机器人上验证了实时运行。

TLDR: ColNav introduces a robust collision-checking method for mobile robot navigation that encodes position/velocity uncertainty into spacetime tubes organized in bounding volume hierarchies, achieving high success rates and clearance in dynamic environments, validated on a physical robot.

Abstract: Safe navigation for mobile robots in dynamic and uncertain environments requires planning paths that avoid collisions with other moving targets. Typically this involves forward propagating the robot motion and checking for collisions at sampled points in space and time. Such methods can miss collisions between sampled points and are not robust to uncertainty in the state estimates. We propose ColNav, a robust collision check formulation with geometric volumes. The key aspect of our approach is encoding the uncertainty in the targets' and the ego robot's positions and velocities into spacetime tubes, in two variants that consume bounded-set and Gaussian uncertainty descriptions, respectively. The tubes are organised in bounding volume hierarchies, so that a single tree traversal covers the entire horizon, rather than testing sampled time instants, and returns a robust geometric certificate together with an estimate of the time to collision. Static and dynamic obstacles share the same representation. Our approach reaches the goal with a 100% success rate under prediction model mismatch, where the best baseline reaches 65%, and maintains up to three times the clearance in dense traffic. We also validate real-time operation on a physical robot.

摘要（中文）：在动态且不确定的环境中，移动机器人的安全导航需要规划能够避免与其他移动目标碰撞的路径。通常，这涉及前向传播机器人运动，并在空间和时间上的采样点处进行碰撞检查。然而，这类方法可能遗漏采样点之间的碰撞，并且对状态估计中的不确定性缺乏鲁棒性。我们提出了一种名为ColNav的鲁棒碰撞检查方法，该方法基于几何体进行建模。我们方法的核心在于，将目标以及自身机器人的位置和速度的不确定性编码为时空管状体，并提供两种变体，分别处理有界集合型与高斯型不确定性描述。这些管状体被组织为包围体层次结构，使得单次树遍历即可覆盖整个时间跨度，而无需对采样时刻逐一测试，同时返回鲁棒的几何验证结果以及碰撞时间的估计值。静态障碍物与动态障碍物共用同一种表示方式。在预测模型失配的情况下，我们的方法实现了100%的成功率到达目标，而最优基线方法的成功率仅为65%，并且在密集交通场景中，其安全距离保持了至多三倍的裕量。我们还在一台实体机器人上验证了该方法的实时运行能力。

Authors: Sanjeev Ramkumar Sudha, Lars Ivar Hatledal, Erlend M. Coates

How Many Exposures Does a World Model Need? Learning Unseen Game Mechanics at Test Time WorldModel

world model test-time training game mechanics ARC-AGI-3 closed-loop exploration

简要说明：本文提出了 MechEval 基准，用于评估世界模型需要多少次交互（“暴露”）才能学习未见过的游戏机制，并构建了 WARC——一个 35M 参数的视觉 Transformer 世界模型，通过测试时训练学习新机制，在 ARC-AGI-3 游戏中取得高精度，并提升了闭环探索效率。

TLDR: This paper introduces MechEval, a benchmark to evaluate how many interactions ('exposures') a world model needs to learn unseen game mechanics, and WARC, a 35M-parameter vision transformer world model that learns new mechanics via test-time training, achieving high accuracy on ARC-AGI-3 games and improving closed-loop exploration efficiency.

Abstract: World models enable agents to plan and learn from imagined experience, but in an unfamiliar environment they must learn its mechanics from limited interaction. A mechanic is a rule for how an action or an interaction changes part of the environment. Each occurrence of a mechanic that the model observes is one exposure. We ask how many exposures a world model needs to predict the effects of a new environment's mechanics. We address this question on ARC-AGI-3, a benchmark of interactive games defined by their programs. We introduce MechEval, which labels 69 recurring mechanics across 20 games from these programs. It scores each prediction on the cells the mechanic changes at each exposure. As a test bed, we build WARC (World model for ARC-AGI-3), a 35M-parameter vision transformer that is pretrained on other games and updates all of its parameters after each transition. On held-out games, WARC learns to predict four in five mechanics with at least 80% accuracy on the cells they change and keeps that accuracy to the end of the recordings. Half of them reach that accuracy within about 80 exposures, in a single play of the game, and without updates only one in seven does at all. In closed-loop play on the public games, WARC-Agent, which pairs WARC with a fixed graph explorer, triples the explorer's official efficiency score from 0.15 to 0.46, mostly through test-time training. On the hidden games of the Kaggle leaderboard, our entry scores 0.20.

摘要（中文）：世界模型使智能体能够基于想象的经验进行规划和学习，但在陌生环境中，它们必须通过有限的交互来掌握其运行机制。机制是指一个动作或交互如何改变环境某一部分的规则。模型观察到的每一次机制发生即为一次暴露。我们探讨的问题是：世界模型需要多少次暴露才能预测新环境机制的影响。我们在ARC-AGI-3（一个由其程序定义的交互式游戏基准测试）上研究这一问题。我们引入了MechEval，该工具为这些程序中的20个游戏标注了69种反复出现的机制，并根据机制每次暴露时改变的区域对每个预测进行评分。作为测试平台，我们构建了WARC（用于ARC-AGI-3的世界模型），这是一个3500万参数的视觉变换器，在其他游戏上进行预训练，并在每次转换后更新其所有参数。在保留游戏中，WARC学会预测的机制中，有五分之四在改变区域的预测准确率达到至少80%，并将该准确率保持到记录结束。其中一半机制在约80次暴露内达到该准确率，且仅凭一次游戏经历即可实现；若不进行更新，只有七分之一的机制能达到该水平。在公开游戏的闭环节中，WARC-Agent（将WARC与固定图探索器配对）将该探索器的官方效率评分从0.15提升至0.46，提升主要归功于测试时训练。在Kaggle排行榜的隐藏游戏上，我们的参赛方案得分为0.20。

Authors: Ku Onoda, Haruto Kawano, Shota Takashiro, Kohei Hayashi

Learning to Act with World Models by Valuing What Comes Next WorldModel

world model PPO auxiliary advantages ALFWorld ScienceWorld

简要说明：WM-PPO 将 PPO 与学习到的世界模型相结合，为策略和价值网络提供辅助优势与目标，在 ALFWorld 和 ScienceWorld 上以相同步数显著提升成功率。

TLDR: WM-PPO augments PPO with a learned world model that provides auxiliary advantages and critic targets, improving success rates on ALFWorld and ScienceWorld without extra real environment steps.

Abstract: A sparse terminal reward tells an agent little about its steps. Much of the missing information is implicit in the environment's dynamics, because each state transition can change the conditions for success long before the reward arrives. A world model trained on real transitions can learn to predict what each action changes, but a predicted observation does not by itself show whether success has become more likely. With a binary terminal reward, PPO's critic makes this judgment by estimating the current policy's probability of success, but only for states the agent reaches. Our method, WM-PPO, elegantly brings the two together. For each action the policy samples, executed or not, the world model predicts the next observation and the critic values the predicted successor. In the policy channel, comparisons among these values give the policy auxiliary advantages; in the value channel, their mean gives the critic an auxiliary target. A shared gate weights both channels according to how reliably comparisons with similar margins predicted real outcomes earlier in training. The policy, critic and world model all learn from the agent's own interaction, with no teacher or privileged information, and only the policy is used at inference. With a comparable number of real environment steps, WM-PPO raises success from PPO's 63.5% to 87.5% on ALFWorld and from 39.3% to 52.9% on ScienceWorld. It matches the strongest PPO refinements we tested on ALFWorld and exceeds the best of them by 6.5 points on ScienceWorld. The trained policy more often completes prerequisite steps before placing an object or committing to an answer.

摘要（中文）：稀疏的终局奖励几乎无法为智能体提供关于其每一步的指导信息。大量缺失的信息其实隐含在环境的动态变化之中，因为每一次状态转移都可能在奖励到来之前很久就改变成功的条件。一个基于真实转移训练出的世界模型可以学会预测每个动作改变了什么，但预测得到的观测本身并不能说明成功是否变得更有可能发生。面对二元的终局奖励，PPO的评论家通过估计当前策略在当前状态下的成功概率来做出判断，但这仅限于智能体实际到达的状态。我们的方法WM-PPO巧妙地将两者结合起来。对于策略采样的每个动作，无论是否实际执行，世界模型都会预测下一个观测，评论家则对该预测后继状态进行价值评估。在策略通道中，这些价值之间的比较为策略提供辅助优势；在价值通道中，它们的均值则为评论家提供辅助目标。共享门控机制根据训练早期具有相似边际的比较在预测真实结果时的可靠性，对两个通道进行加权。策略、评论家和世界模型全部从智能体自身的交互中学习，无需教师信号或特权信息，推理时仅使用策略网络。在相近的真实环境步数下，WM-PPO在ALFWorld上将成功率从PPO的63.5%提升至87.5%，在ScienceWorld上从39.3%提升至52.9%。在ALFWorld上，它与我们测试过的最强的PPO改进方法持平，并在ScienceWorld上比其中最好的方法高出6.5个百分点。训练后的策略更倾向于在放置物体或提交答案之前先完成前置步骤。

Authors: Chenghao Gao, Zhi Zhang, Dian Jin, Yihe Pan, Doudou Zhou

LO-World: Unified BEV Latent Modeling for Joint 4D Occupancy and LiDAR Forecasting WorldModel

BEV latent modeling 4D occupancy forecasting LiDAR forecasting flow-matching world model

简要说明：LO-World 提出了一个统一的 BEV 潜在空间世界模型，联合预测 LiDAR 点云和 3D 语义占用，实现了最先进的精度和实时性能。

TLDR: LO-World introduces a unified BEV latent space world model that jointly forecasts LiDAR point clouds and 3D semantic occupancy, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy and real-time performance.

Abstract: LiDAR point clouds and 3D semantic occupancy represent two distinct modalities capturing fine-grained metric geometry and dense volumetric semantics, respectively, holding natural potential for mutual complementarity. However, existing world models typically forecast these modalities independently or cascade them heuristically, missing the opportunity for reciprocal cross-modal regularization. To address this, we propose \textbf{LO-World}, a unified 4D world model that forecasts both modalities within a shared BEV latent space. This single-stream formulation enables dense semantics and metric geometry to mutually reinforce each other, while eliminating multi-pipeline redundancy. Specifically, LO-World couples an efficient hybrid range-voxel autoencoder with a flow-matching generator that caches historical context to reduce iterative sampling latency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LO-World outperforms prior state-of-the-art baselines, improving occupancy forecasting IoU by 10.9% and reducing LiDAR Chamfer Distance by 30.1%. Meanwhile, it sustains a real-time throughput exceeding $25$~FPS on a single RTX 4090. Our code is available at https://github.com/lzzzzzm/LO-World.

摘要（中文）：激光雷达点云与三维语义占据分别代表了捕捉细粒度度量几何和稠密体积语义的两种不同模态，天然具备互补潜力。然而，现有世界模型通常独立预测这些模态或以启发式方式级联它们，错失了交叉模态相互正则化的机会。为解决这一问题，我们提出\textbf{LO-World}，一种统一的4D世界模型，在共享的BEV潜空间内同时预测两种模态。这种单流设计使稠密语义与度量几何能够相互强化，同时消除了多流水线冗余。具体而言，LO-World将高效混合范围体素自编码器与流匹配生成器耦合，后者缓存历史上下文以减少迭代采样延迟。大量实验表明，LO-World优于先前的最先进基线，将占据预测IoU提高10.9%，并将激光雷达Chamfer距离降低30.1%。同时，它维持了在单个RTX 4090上超过$25$~FPS的实时吞吐量。我们的代码可在https://github.com/lzzzzzm/LO-World获取。

Authors: Zhimin Liao, Ping Wei, Kai Mao, Shuaijia Chen

QCC-WM: Linking Macro-State Dynamics and Visual Generation via Quotient Causal Construction WorldModel

world model action-conditioned prediction visual generation causal abstraction macro-state

简要说明：QCC-WM 提出了一种基于商因果构建的视觉世界模型，通过宏观动态指导递归动作条件预测和视觉生成，在 US-VLA 数据集上验证了效果。

TLDR: QCC-WM proposes a quotient-based causal construction for visual world models, using macro-state dynamics to guide recursive action-conditioned prediction and visual generation on the US-VLA dataset.

Abstract: A key challenge in action-conditioned world modeling is to construct macro-states from high-dimensional observations that support recursive prediction under actions, while keeping their predicted evolution consistent with visual changes in generated observations. We propose QCC-WM, a visual world model based on Quotient-based Causal Construction. QCC-WM uses action responses to guide macro-variable construction for recursive action-conditioned prediction. A shared reference quotient measurement constrains the consistency between predicted states and observed changes, allowing macro-level predictions to provide structured constraints for future visual generation. Using translational and rotational actions and their predicted responses, the model aggregates local visual features into macro-nodes with spatial correspondence through causal abstraction, and recursively predicts node content and motion under a shared reference measurement. Macro-level predictions guide future observation generation, while predicted motion transports historical appearance information. Node-level errors between generated observations and macro-level targets are then mapped back to the corresponding spatial regions for correction, improving consistency between visual generation and macro-level predictions. On the US-VLA dataset, QCC-WM achieves an ROI-MSE of 0.01861 for four-step prediction. Compared with the best baseline at each prediction horizon, it reduces LPIPS by 48.59%, 41.68%, and 30.23% for four-step prediction and eight- and sixteen-step recursive extrapolation, respectively. Ablation studies and mechanism analyses show that motion-guided reference transport mainly improves pixel reconstruction, while node-level error feedback further improves perceptual quality and consistency between generated observations and macro-level predictions.

摘要（中文）：在行动条件下的世界建模中，一个关键挑战是从高维观测中构建宏状态，以支持在行动作用下的递归预测，同时保持其预测演化与生成观测中的视觉变化相一致。我们提出了QCC-WM，一种基于商空间因果构建的视觉世界模型。QCC-WM利用行动响应来指导宏变量的构建，以实现行动条件下的递归预测。共享的参考商测度约束了预测状态与观测变化之间的一致性，使得宏层面的预测能够为未来的视觉生成提供结构化约束。 利用平移和旋转行动及其预测响应，模型通过因果抽象将局部视觉特征聚合成具有空间对应关系的宏节点，并在共享参考测度下递归预测节点内容和运动。宏层面的预测引导未来的观测生成，而预测的运动则传递历史外观信息。生成观测与宏层面目标之间的节点级误差随后被映射回对应的空间区域进行修正，从而提高了视觉生成与宏层面预测之间的一致性。 在US-VLA数据集上，QCC-WM在四步预测中实现了0.01861的ROI-MSE。与各预测时域的最佳基线相比，在四步预测以及八步和十六步递归外推中，LPIPS分别降低了48.59%、41.68%和30.23%。消融研究和机制分析表明，运动引导的参考传递主要改善了像素重建，而节点级误差反馈则进一步提升了感知质量以及生成观测与宏层面预测之间的一致性。

Simulation-aided Reinforcement Learning with Control Variates RLRobot

简要说明：该论文提出了一种基于控制变量的仿真辅助强化学习方法，通过仅利用仿真数据降低方差而不直接塑造学习目标，在MuJoCo基准任务上改进了策略评估和actor-critic性能。

TLDR: This paper proposes a simulation-aided reinforcement learning method using control variates to reduce variance without biasing the learning target, improving policy evaluation and actor-critic performance on MuJoCo benchmarks.

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithms often rely on data collected from a target environment, which can be expensive and noisy. Although simulators can generate large amounts of additional data, standard simulation mixing approaches, which directly combine simulated and real experience, can degrade performance due to simulator inaccuracies, especially when they bias the solution away from the optimal policy. We propose a conservative simulation-aided learning method based on control variates, where simulated data is used solely to reduce variance in the learning process rather than directly shaping the learning target. We develop our approach for Policy-Evaluation, which is a fundamental building block of RL algorithms. Then we combine it within the actor-critic framework towards policy improvement, as well as extend it towards offline RL scenarios. Experiments on multiple MuJoCo benchmark tasks demonstrate improvements over standard simulation mixing approaches, highlighting control variates as an effective tool for simulation-aided reinforcement learning.

摘要（中文）：强化学习算法通常依赖于从目标环境中收集的数据，而这些数据的获取可能成本高昂且带有噪声。尽管模拟器能够生成大量额外的数据，但标准的模拟混合方法——直接将模拟经验与真实经验相结合——可能因模拟器的不准确性而导致性能下降，尤其是在模拟器将解偏向于偏离最优策略的情况下更是如此。我们提出了一种基于控制变量的保守型模拟辅助学习方法，其中模拟数据仅用于降低学习过程中的方差，而非直接塑造学习目标。我们针对策略评估（Policy Evaluation）这一强化学习算法的基本构建模块开发了该方法，随后将其整合到演员-评论家框架中以实现策略改进，并将其扩展至离线强化学习场景。在多个MuJoCo基准任务上的实验表明，该方法相较于标准模拟混合方法有显著改进，凸显了控制变量作为模拟辅助强化学习有效工具的潜力。

Safety-Constrained Intelligent Control of a 2-DOF Robotic Manipulator Using Control Barrier Functions Manipulation

control barrier functions RBF neural network compensator safety-constrained control robotic manipulator uncertainty

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于2自由度机械臂的安全约束控制方法，利用控制屏障函数与RBF神经网络补偿器来处理模型不确定性。仿真评估表明，在参数不确定性和扰动下，该方法能在保持关节、速度和力矩限制的同时改进跟踪性能。

TLDR: This paper proposes a safety-constrained control method for a 2-DOF robotic manipulator using control barrier functions with an RBF neural network compensator for handling model uncertainty. It demonstrates improved tracking while maintaining joint, velocity, and torque limits under parameter uncertainty and disturbances through simulated evaluations.

Abstract: Control barrier function (CBF) filters depend on dynamic models that can be inaccurate when their parameters and external forces are uncertain. This paper investigates a radial basis function (RBF) neural network compensator whose output is shared by a Cartesian tracking controller and a joint-space CBF filter. An auxiliary state driven by the difference between requested and applied torques corrects the learning signal, reducing the direct influence of filter intervention on adaptation. A two-link manipulator is evaluated through constrained regulation, ablations, matched uncertainty and disturbance trials, and operating-range and timing studies. The results demonstrate that the proposed controller improves tracking while maintaining joint, velocity, and torque limits under parameter uncertainty, and that both the shared compensation and the auxiliary correction contribute to this improvement.

摘要（中文）：控制障碍函数（CBF）滤波器依赖于动态模型，而当模型参数及外部力存在不确定性时，该模型可能不够精确。本文研究了一种径向基函数（RBF）神经网络补偿器，其输出由笛卡尔跟踪控制器和关节空间CBF滤波器共享。由期望力矩与实际施加力矩之差驱动的辅助状态对学习信号进行修正，从而降低滤波器干预对自适应的直接影响。通过约束调节、消融实验、匹配不确定性与扰动试验，以及工作范围和时间特性研究，对两连杆机械臂进行了评估。结果表明，所提出的控制器在参数不确定情况下，能够在保持关节、速度和力矩约束的同时提升跟踪性能，且共享补偿与辅助修正均对该性能提升有所贡献。

Authors: Gabriel da Silva Lima, Made Widhi Surya Atman, Wallace Moreira Bessa

UniOMA: Unified Optimal-Transport Multi-Modal Structural Alignment for Robot Perception Perception3D

optimal transport Gromov-Wasserstein multimodal alignment robot perception contrastive learning

简要说明：本文提出UniOMA，一种基于Gromov-Wasserstein的正则化方法，以增强机器人感知中多模态对比学习的结构对齐，在包括力和触觉模态的五个机器人基准上得到验证。

TLDR: This paper proposes UniOMA, a Gromov-Wasserstein based regularization method to improve structural alignment in multimodal contrastive learning for robot perception, validated on five robotic benchmarks including force and tactile modalities.

Abstract: Achieving generalizable and well-aligned multimodal representations remains a core challenge in robot learning. While recent approaches have attempted to align modalities by modeling conditional or higher-order statistical dependencies, they do not explicitly consider the structural coherence across modalities. In this work, we propose a novel multimodal alignment method that augments existing contrastive losses with a geometry-aware Gromov--Wasserstein (GW) distance-based regularization. To this end, we encode intra-modal geometry for each modality and reduce cross-modal structural discrepancies through a dynamically learned GW barycenter, thereby encouraging structural consistency in addition to instance-level contrastive alignment. We apply this optimal-transport-based alignment strategy to robot perception tasks involving underexplored modalities such as force and tactile signals, where modality data often exhibit varying sample densities. Extensive experiments on five robotic benchmarks show that our method improves structural alignment and downstream performance over state-of-the-art multimodal contrastive baselines across a wide range of downstream tasks, including robot and environment state prediction. Moreover, our GW-based regularization can be seamlessly integrated into most InfoNCE-like objectives.

摘要（中文）：实现泛化性强且对齐良好的多模态表征，仍然是机器人学习中的一个核心挑战。尽管近期一些方法尝试通过建模条件依赖或高阶统计依赖来实现模态间的对齐，但它们并未显式考虑跨模态的结构一致性。在本工作中，我们提出了一种新颖的多模态对齐方法，在现有对比损失的基础上引入基于几何感知的Gromov--Wasserstein（GW）距离正则化项。为此，我们对每种模态编码其模态内几何结构，并通过动态学习的GW重心来减小跨模态结构差异，从而在实例级对比对齐之外进一步促进结构一致性。我们将这种基于最优传输的对齐策略应用于涉及力和触觉信号等尚待深入探索的模态的机器人感知任务中，此类模态数据往往表现出变化的样本密度。在五个机器人基准上的大量实验表明，我们的方法在广泛的下游任务（包括机器人和环境状态预测）中，相较于最先进的多模态对比基线方法，显著提升了结构对齐效果和下游任务性能。此外，我们提出的基于GW的正则化项可以无缝集成到大多数类似InfoNCE的目标函数中。

Authors: Xinrui Zu, Mark Hoogendoorn, Kevin Sebastian Luck, Shujian Yu

Rethinking Radar 3D Perception: Representation Learning from Raw Spectra Perception3D

self-supervised learning masked autoencoder radar spectra 3D perception Leakage-aware Spectral MAE

简要说明：本文认为，只要配以合适的自监督掩码自编码目标，原始雷达频谱就可以有效用于3D感知，并提出了具有多普勒组织表示的泄漏感知频谱MAE，以优于基于雷达的检测器和基于点云的SSL方法。

TLDR: The paper argues that raw radar spectra can be effectively used for 3D perception if paired with a self-supervised masked autoencoding objective, and introduces Leakage-aware Spectral MAE with a Doppler-organized representation to outperform radar-based detectors and point-cloud SSL methods.

Abstract: Raw radar spectra are widely viewed as too cluttered and noisy for direct representation learning, motivating handcrafted reductions, sparse point clouds, or compact Doppler descriptors in radar perception. We challenge this assumption and argue that the main limitation lies not in the raw representation itself, but in the absence of a learning objective that separates structured signal from noise. Handcrafted reductions partially address this problem but impose rigid assumptions about what constitutes signal, discarding weak yet informative structure while retaining artifacts that fit the reduction model. Once removed, such information cannot be recovered by supervised learning. We propose an alternative: structure is the component of a radar spectrum that remains reconstructable under localized corruption, while noise is the component that does not. This perspective motivates self-supervised masked modeling for dense radar spectra without predefined signal-noise separation. We instantiate it with Leakage-aware Spectral MAE, a masked autoencoder for raw radar cubes using a corruption strategy inspired by cross-bin energy spreading caused by spectral leakage. We also demonstrate the importance of Doppler organization: treating Doppler as a primary spatial dimension in an x-y-D representation, with height encoded as features, substantially outperforms naive channel stacking and enables effective learning from dense 4D spectra. Without handcrafted reductions, our approach consistently outperforms state-of-the-art radar-based detectors and point-cloud-based self-supervised learning (SSL) counterparts. These results establish raw radar spectra as an effective representation for 3D perception when paired with an appropriate pretraining objective.

摘要（中文）：原始雷达频谱通常被认为过于杂乱和嘈杂，难以直接用于表征学习，因此雷达感知中往往依赖于手工设计的降维处理、稀疏点云或紧凑的多普勒描述符。我们质疑这一假设，并认为主要瓶颈并非原始表征本身，而在于缺乏一种能够将结构化信号与噪声分离的学习目标。手工降维方法虽部分缓解了该问题，但其对“何为信号”施加了刚性假设，在丢弃微弱但富含信息结构的同时，保留了符合降维模型的伪影。一旦被移除，此类信息便无法通过监督学习恢复。我们提出一种替代方案：结构是雷达频谱中在局部损坏条件下仍可重建的成分，而噪声则是无法重建的成分。这一视角促使我们在无需预设信号-噪声分离的前提下，对密集雷达频谱进行自监督遮蔽建模。我们以泄漏感知频谱掩码自编码器（Leakage-aware Spectral MAE）加以实现，该模型针对原始雷达立方体，采用受频谱泄漏引起的跨频段能量扩散启发的损坏策略。我们还证明了多普勒维度组织方式的重要性：将多普勒作为x-y-D表示中的主空间维度，并将高度编码为特征，显著优于简单的通道堆叠方式，并能有效从密集4D频谱中学习。无需任何手工降维处理，我们的方法在一致性上超越了最先进的基于雷达的检测器及基于点云的自监督学习（SSL）对应方法。上述结果表明，当配备适当的预训练目标时，原始雷达频谱可成为3D感知的有效表征。

简要说明：本文提出一种数据驱动的路由架构，结合闭环概率更新与随机键优化器，用于无人机搜索救援中的路径规划，在动态约束下平衡检测概率最大化和资源最小化。

TLDR: This paper introduces a data-driven routing architecture that combines closed-loop probability updates with Random-Key Optimizers for UAV path planning in search and rescue, balancing detection probability maximization and resource minimization under dynamic constraints.

Abstract: This paper focuses on the stochastic and real-time constraints of Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) path planning in Search and Rescue (SAR) missions. We introduce a configurable data-driven and intelligent routing architecture that combines a closed-loop probability update with the Random-Key Optimizers (RKO). Our problem is mathematically modeled as a dynamic probabilistic variant of the Open Vehicle Routing Problem (OVRP), enabling the solver to switch adaptively between two objectives, thereby balancing probability maximization and resource minimization. The framework degrades elegantly under noisy priors but not under biased ones: a systematically biased map performs about half as well as flying with no prior at all. Computational tests show that the proposed scheme is scalable and competitive with single-path scenarios in terms of solution performance and serves as a strong decision guide for intelligent planning in SAR operations in unstable environments

摘要（中文）：本文重点研究无人机在搜索与救援任务中路径规划所面临的随机性与实时性约束。我们提出了一种可配置的数据驱动型智能路由架构，将闭环概率更新机制与随机密钥优化器相结合。该问题在数学上被建模为开放车辆路径问题的一种动态概率变体，使求解器能够自适应地在两个目标之间切换，从而在概率最大化与资源最小化之间取得平衡。该框架在含噪声的先验条件下能够优雅退化，但在存在系统性偏差的先验条件下则表现不佳：使用系统性偏差地图时的搜索效果约为完全无先验信息情况的一半。计算测试表明，所提出的方案具有良好的可扩展性，在解的性能上与单路径场景具有竞争力，可为不稳定环境中搜索与救援任务的智能规划提供强有力的决策指导。

Authors: Antonio Dantas, Elcio Shiguemori, Antonio Chaves

Hierarchical Multi-Channel Tip-Over Prediction via Isolated Temporal Models for Planetary Rover Safety Other

tip-over prediction planetary rover temporal convolutional network GRU forward dynamics hierarchical fusion

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于行星探测车的分层多通道倾覆预测框架，利用隔离时序模型（TCN和GRU）和决策级融合，在真实IMU数据上实现了高预测覆盖率和提前时间。

TLDR: This paper presents a hierarchical multi-channel tip-over prediction framework for planetary rovers, using isolated temporal models (TCN and GRU) with decision-level fusion, achieving high prediction coverage and lead time on real IMU data.

Abstract: Reliable tip-over prevention is critical for planetary rovers operating in unstructured environments where communication delays prevent real-time human intervention. Existing learning-based approaches typically optimize a single prediction objective, limiting their ability to capture both gradual instability evolution and abrupt terrain disturbances. This work presents a hierarchical multi-channel tip-over prediction framework based on isolated temporal learning. A multi-horizon Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN) learns progressive instability patterns from inertial measurements, while a Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU)-based forward dynamics model predicts nominal rover motion and detects unexpected dynamic deviations through prediction residuals. These complementary signals are integrated through decision-level fusion and priority-based arbitration to generate graded safety actions, including early warning and emergency braking. The proposed system is deployed as an Orocos Real-Time Toolkit (RTT)-based safety component within the Rock robotics framework, operating at 100 Hz on a planetary rover software stack. Experiments on Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) samples collected across heterogeneous terrains demonstrate 97.58% event prediction coverage with a 1.82s median lead time, outperforming individual prediction channels. The results validate that isolated temporal models combined through hierarchical decision fusion provide a robust solution for real-time rover safety in uncertain terrain.

摘要（中文）：可靠的防倾覆保护对于在非结构化环境中运行的行星车至关重要，因为通信延迟使得无法进行实时人工干预。现有的基于学习的方法通常优化单一预测目标，限制了其捕捉渐进式失稳演变和突发地形扰动两方面的能力。本文提出了一种基于隔离时序学习的分层多通道倾覆预测框架。多时域时序卷积网络（TCN）从惯性测量数据中学习渐进失稳模式，而基于门控循环单元（GRU）的前向动力学模型预测名义上的火星车运动，并通过预测残差检测意外动态偏差。这些互补信号通过决策级融合和优先级仲裁进行整合，以生成分级安全动作，包括早期预警和紧急制动。该系统作为基于Orocos实时工具包（RTT）的安全组件部署在Rock机器人框架内，在行星车软件栈上以100 Hz频率运行。在异构地形上采集的惯性测量单元（IMU）样本上进行的实验表明，事件预测覆盖率达到97.58%，中位提前时间为1.82秒，优于单个预测通道。实验结果验证了通过分层决策融合的隔离时序模型为不确定地形下的实时火星车安全提供了稳健的解决方案。

Authors: Siddhant Shete, Raul Dominguez, Frank Kirchner

A Game-Theoretic MPC Planner for Cooperative and Adversarial Drone Coordination RLRobot

game-theoretic MPC drone coordination pursuit-evasion move blocking trajectory tracking

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于博弈论模型预测控制的无人机协同目标到达与对抗追逃规划器，并通过仿真和实物飞行测试进行了验证。

TLDR: This paper presents a game-theoretic model predictive control (MPC) planner for multi-drone cooperative goal reaching and adversarial pursuit-evasion, validated through simulations and a physical flight test.

Abstract: We present and evaluate a game-theoretic model predictive control planner for cooperative goal reaching and adversarial pursuit-evasion with drones. The planner combines 3D prediction, individual objectives, optional shared separation constraints and trajectory-tracking interfaces. A comparison of cooperative game solvers assesses their ability to find feasible trajectories that resolve conflicts. A computational study quantifies how number of drones, prediction horizon and move blocking affect computation time and numerical acceptance. Move blocking holds control inputs constant over groups of prediction steps, reducing the number of independent control variables and lowering computation time. Timing measurements identify the practical limits of real-time planning in the tested configurations. PyBullet simulations demonstrate cooperative goal reaching and pursuit-evasion. A laboratory flight complements the simulations by validating the trajectory-tracking interfaces on physical drones. The planner can serve as a basis for further evaluation and controller development.

摘要（中文）：我们提出并评估了一种基于博弈论模型预测控制的规划器，用于无人机协同到达目标及对抗性追逃任务。该规划器融合了三维预测、个体目标、可选的共享避碰约束以及轨迹跟踪接口。通过对协同博弈求解器的比较，评估了其在解决冲突时寻找可行轨迹的能力。一项计算研究量化了无人机数量、预测时域及移动阻塞对计算时间和数值接受率的影响。移动阻塞将控制输入在若干预测步骤组内保持恒定，从而减少独立控制变量的数量并降低计算时间。计时测量确定了所测试配置下实时规划的实践极限。PyBullet仿真验证了协同目标到达与追逃任务的有效性。实验室飞行实验通过物理无人机上的轨迹跟踪接口进一步补充验证了仿真结果。该规划器可作为后续评估及控制器开发的基础。
