Authors: Zdeněk Bouček, Miroslav Flídr

Graph-Based RL for Sequential Rendezvous Planning with Multiple Patrolling USVs RLRobot

graph-based reinforcement learning rendezvous planning unmanned surface vehicles path planning graph neural network

简要说明：本文提出了一种结合网格路径规划、代理航行时间预测和基于图的强化学习的框架，用于优化多巡逻USV的连续会合规划，显著降低了任务完成时间和延误。

TLDR: This paper presents a framework combining grid-based path planning, surrogate travel-time prediction, and graph-based reinforcement learning to optimize sequential rendezvous planning for multiple patrolling USVs, achieving significant reductions in mission completion time and tardiness.

Abstract: In patrol missions involving multiple unmanned surface vehicles (USVs), a designated command USV can support fleet management by sequentially rendezvousing with each patrolling USV. These operations require motion-feasible route planning and priority-aware rendezvous sequencing, with the objective of minimizing mission completion time and total tardiness relative to priority-dependent due dates. We propose a framework combining grid-based path planning, surrogate travel-time prediction, and graph-based reinforcement learning. The path planner accounts for ocean currents and approximates turn-rate constraints through multi-stage maneuvers, with path feasibility empirically validated through trajectory-tracking simulations. For rendezvous sequencing, a Feasible Transition Graph (FTG) represents candidate rendezvous events and temporally feasible transitions, enabling a graph neural network to exploit spatiotemporal rendezvous relationships for policy learning. A surrogate predicts travel times from compact current and motion features to avoid repeated path searches during FTG construction and policy training. Evaluation using grid-based path planning shows statistically significant average objective reductions of 10.5%, 3.5%, and 1.5% compared with greedy, MLP-RL, and 2-step lookahead greedy, respectively. The policy achieves these improvements while requiring approximately 1/35 of the latter's computation time. It maintains its advantage over MLP-RL under unseen priority-tier settings, with larger gains as fleet size increases.

摘要（中文）：在涉及多艘无人水面艇（USV）的巡逻任务中，指定的一艘指挥USV可通过依次与每艘巡逻USV会合来支持编队管理。这些操作要求运动可行的路径规划以及考虑优先级顺序的会合排序，目标是最小化任务完成时间及相对于依赖优先级的最迟交期的总延误。我们提出了一种将基于网格的路径规划、替代性航行时间预测和图基强化学习相结合的框架。路径规划器考虑海洋洋流，并通过多阶段机动来近似转弯率约束，路径可行性通过轨迹跟踪仿真进行经验验证。对于会合排序，可行转移图（FTG）表示候选会合事件及时间上可行的转移，从而使图神经网络能够利用时空会合关系进行策略学习。替代模型利用紧凑的洋流与运动特征预测航行时间，以避免在FTG构建和策略训练期间重复进行路径搜索。基于网格路径规划的评估表明，与贪婪算法、MLP-RL和两步前瞻贪婪算法相比，平均目标函数分别显著降低了10.5%、3.5%和1.5%。该策略在实现这些改进的同时，其计算时间仅为后者的约1/35。在未见过的优先级层级设置下，该方法仍保持相对于MLP-RL的优势，且随着编队规模增大，其增益更加显著。

Authors: Seung Woo Han, Hyeon Bin Yeo, Seung Heon Oh

The Relative Value of Demonstration Data: Execution Time Limits and Operator Mixtures in Behavior Cloning Manipulation

behavior cloning demonstration data data multiple teleoperator experience robomimic

简要说明：本文通过引入“数据倍数”指标，分析了行为克隆中不同熟练度遥操作员演示数据的相对价值，并表明策略性能差异部分源于执行时间限制，且混合操作员数据集的价值低于预期。

TLDR: This paper analyzes the relative value of demonstration data from teleoperators of varying skill levels in behavior cloning, introducing a 'data multiple' metric and showing that policy performance differences are partly due to execution time limits and that mixed operator datasets are less valuable than predicted.

Abstract: Robot demonstration datasets combine demonstrations from teleoperators of uneven experience, so collection teams need to know how many demonstrations from one group match those from another. We measure this with a data multiple: the ratio of the numbers of demonstrations two groups need for their policies to reach the same success rate. On robomimic's simulated Square and Can tasks, we train behavior-cloning policies on demonstrations from the two teleoperators robomimic labels Better and the two it labels Worse, varying dataset size and the share of Worse demonstrations. On Square, within robomimic's 25-second time limit, an all-Worse training set needs 1.55 times as many demonstrations as an all-Better set. Most of this difference is late completion: policies trained on Worse demonstrations finish later, as the Worse teleoperators do, and with a 100-second limit the multiple falls to 1.11. On Can, most of the difference remains at 100 seconds. If each Worse demonstration were worth 1/1.55 of a Better one, as in an all-Worse set, a half-Better, half-Worse set on Square would need 1.22 times as many demonstrations as an all-Better set. In fact, it needs 13% more than that, and this excess persists at every time limit from 20 to 200 seconds. The excess remains when training draws demonstrations uniformly instead of in proportion to their length. On Square, within the 25-second limit, switching to these Worse teleoperators is cheaper at equal success only if they earn less than a third of the Better teleoperators' hourly pay, because Worse demonstrations also take longer to record.

摘要（中文）：机器人示范数据集汇集了来自经验水平不同的遥操作人员的示范，因此数据收集团队需要知道一组中的多少示范与另一组中的示范相匹配。我们通过数据倍数来衡量这一点：两组各自所需示范数量之比，使得其策略达到相同的成功率。在robomimic模拟的Square和Can任务中，我们使用robomimic标记为Better的两名遥操作人员以及标记为Worse的两名遥操作人员的示范来训练行为克隆策略，并改变数据集大小以及Worse示范所占比例。在Square任务中，在robomimic设定的25秒时间限制内，全Worse训练集所需的示范数量是全Better集的1.55倍。这一差异主要源于完成时间较晚：使用Worse示范训练的策略完成得更晚，这与Worse遥操作人员的表现一致，而当时间限制延长至100秒时，该倍数降至1.11。在Can任务中，大部分差异在100秒时仍然存在。如果每条Worse示范的价值相当于Better示范的1/1.55，如在全Worse集中那样，那么在Square任务中，一半Better一半Worse的混合集所需的示范数量将是全Better集的1.22倍。而实际上，该混合集所需数量比这一预期多出13%，且这一超额在所有20至200秒的时间限制下均持续存在。当训练时均匀抽取示范而非按示范长度比例抽取时，这一超额依然存在。在Square任务中，在25秒时间限制内，仅当Worse遥操作人员的时薪低于Better遥操作人员的三分之一时，改用这些Worse操作员在相同成功率下才更经济，因为Worse示范的录制时间也更长。

Authors: Jiaxuan Guo, Xingyu Ren, Youran Sun, Jingxin Yang, Kejia Zhang, Haizhao Yang

Scale-Consistent Monocular Fisheye Visual Odometry via Spherical Bundle Adjustment-Guided Unsupervised Depth Learning Other

monocular fisheye visual odometry unsupervised depth learning spherical bundle adjustment scale consistency robotic localization

简要说明：本文提出了S²D-FVO，一种单目鱼眼视觉里程计框架，通过球面束调整引导的无监督深度学习，提高了机器人在定位与建图中的尺度一致性和深度估计精度。

TLDR: This paper proposes S²D-FVO, a monocular fisheye visual odometry framework that integrates spherical bundle adjustment-guided unsupervised depth learning to improve scale consistency and depth estimation accuracy for robotic localization and mapping.

Abstract: The wide field of view of fisheye cameras and the simplicity of a monocular setup make monocular fisheye visual odometry (VO) attractive for robotic localization and mapping. Nevertheless, scale drift remains a major challenge over long trajectories. Unsupervised depth learning can help to mitigate this issue, but the pronounced distortion of fisheye images poses challenges for accurate depth estimation. This article presents S$^2$D-FVO, a monocular fisheye VO framework integrating spherical bundle adjustment (SBA)-guided unsupervised depth learning to improve scale consistency and depth estimation accuracy. Given that pixel reprojection residuals do not uniformly reflect angular deviations between viewing rays and that the first-order linearization of a scalar angular reprojection residual is insensitive to perturbations along one tangent direction, SBA employs tangent-space angular reprojection residuals derived from the spherical logarithmic map. These residuals retain sensitivity along both tangent directions, with their norms equal to the corresponding scalar angular residuals. A median depth-based scale regularization term is further integrated into SBA to constrain the reconstruction scale. Building on these formulations, SBA replaces the pose estimation network during unsupervised depth learning, providing more reliable relative poses for view synthesis. In turn, depth estimates from the well-trained depth estimation network provide scale references for SBA, improving scale consistency while allowing individual 3-D landmark positions to be refined. Extensive experiments conducted on multiple public datasets, as well as two newly collected large-scale datasets, demonstrate that the proposed framework outperforms representative existing approaches in both depth and trajectory estimation accuracy and is applicable to different camera models.

摘要（中文）：鱼眼相机的宽视场以及单目设置的简洁性，使得单目鱼眼视觉里程计（VO）在机器人定位与建图中颇具吸引力。然而，在长轨迹运行中，尺度漂移仍是一项重大挑战。无监督深度学习有助于缓解该问题，但鱼眼图像显著的畸变给精确深度估计带来了困难。本文提出S$^2$D-FVO，一种集成球面光束法平差（SBA）引导的无监督深度学习的单目鱼眼VO框架，旨在提升尺度一致性与深度估计精度。鉴于像素重投影残差并不能均匀反映视线之间的角度偏差，且标量角度重投影残差的一阶线性化对沿一个切向方向的扰动不敏感，SBA采用源自球面对数映射的切空间角度重投影残差。这些残差在两个切向方向上均保持敏感性，且其范数等于对应的标量角度残差。进一步在SBA中引入基于中值深度的尺度正则化项，以约束重建尺度。基于上述公式，SBA在无监督深度学习过程中取代位姿估计网络，为视图合成提供更可靠的相对位姿。反过来，训练良好的深度估计网络所提供的深度估计为SBA提供尺度参考，在提升尺度一致性的同时允许对单个三维地标位置进行精细化。在多个公开数据集以及两个新采集的大规模数据集上进行的大量实验表明，所提出的框架在深度和轨迹估计精度上均优于现有的代表性方法，并适用于不同的相机模型。

Authors: Wanhui Luo, Hongbo Zhao, Yi Zhou, Qijun Chen, Yiming Nie, Rui Fan

How Many Candidates Does a One-Step World Model Need? A Random-Codebook Account of Nearest-of-m Training on Frozen DINO Tokens WorldModel

one-step world model nearest-of-m matching stochastic prediction DINO tokens generative video prediction

简要说明：本文研究了在冻结DINO令牌上的一步随机世界模型的最近m匹配，表明m=16在覆盖率和延迟上优于流匹配，但受限于真实机器人视频上的欠离散性。

TLDR: This paper investigates nearest-of-m matching for one-step stochastic world models on frozen DINO tokens, showing that with m=16 it outperforms flow matching in coverage and latency, but is bounded by under-dispersion on real robot video.

Abstract: One-step stochastic world models avoid the mode averaging of deterministic feature predictors without the tens of network evaluations per step that diffusion and flow matching require. The simplest such objective is nearest-of-m matching (conditional implicit maximum likelihood estimation, IMLE): draw m candidate futures and pull only the one closest to the observed outcome. Recent work conjectures that a small m suffices for feature-space world models and that a strictly proper energy score should replace the hard minimum. We test both claims with one-step world models on frozen DINOv2/v3 patch tokens, using benchmarks whose futures can be enumerated. Under mode-like uncertainty, nearest-of-m with m=16 covers the enumerated futures better than 50-step flow matching (at about 1/30 of its latency), one-step flow generators and an energy-score generator at matched parameter counts, and its rollouts stay on the token manifold where flow rollouts drift. One quantity governs the choice of m: the nearest-of-m objective is the expected distortion of a random codebook of m draws from the generator. This view yields three predictions, recorded before the corresponding runs: (i) memorization of the realized outcome in contexts that never repeat, whose strength is governed by the codebook's miss distortion I(m) rather than its miss probability, and which an energy-score generator does not escape by raising m; (ii) a flattening of mode probabilities with m, matching a known optimum within 0.01; and (iii) under-dispersion on continuous high-dimensional outcomes, which bounds the method on real robot video. Per-step matching on self-rollouts cuts long-horizon error by a third on a stochastic Push-T variant; an ablation separates its manifold and coverage benefits. Planning success does not improve despite accurate risk estimates, a negative result we report with its diagnosis.

摘要（中文）：一步式随机世界模型避免了确定性特征预测器的模态平均问题，同时无需像扩散模型和流匹配那样每步进行数十次网络评估。此类目标中最简单的是最近邻m匹配（条件隐式最大似然估计，IMLE）：抽取m个候选未来，仅保留与观测结果最接近的那个。近期研究推测，对于特征空间世界模型，较小的m值即可满足需求，并认为严格适当的能量分数应取代硬最小值。我们在冻结的DINOv2/v3块标记上，使用未来结果可枚举的基准测试，对这两种说法进行了验证。在模态类不确定性下，m=16的最近邻m匹配在覆盖枚举未来方面优于50步流匹配（延迟约为其1/30）、一步式流生成器以及参数量匹配的能量分数生成器，且其 rollout 保持在标记流形上，而流 rollout 则发生漂移。一个量决定了m的选择：最近邻m目标是从生成器中抽取m个样本的随机码本的期望失真。这一视角产生了三个预测，均在相应运行之前记录：（i）在从不重复的情境中对已实现结果的记忆，其强度由码本的遗漏失真I(m)而非遗漏概率决定，且能量分数生成器无法通过增大m来避免；（ii）模态概率随m增大而趋于平坦，与已知最优值的偏差在0.01以内；（iii）在连续高维结果上存在欠离散性，这限制了该方法在真实机器人视频上的应用。在随机Push-T变体上，自 rollout 上的逐部匹配将长时程误差降低了三分之一；消融实验分离了其在流形保持和覆盖方面的收益。尽管风险估计准确，规划成功率并未提升，我们报告了这一负面结果并附上诊断分析。

Authors: Yong Hwi Song, Keon Myung Lee

Budget-aware Correspondence-driven View Selection for Real-time 3D Perception of Mobile Robots Perception3D

view selection 3D perception mobile robots budget-aware correspondence-based

简要说明：BCVS 是一种预算感知、基于对应关系的视图选择算法，可在 CPU 上实现实时（22+ FPS）过滤冗余图像序列，用于移动机器人 3D 感知，在航空和海洋机器人现场试验中优于 CPU 友好的基线并减少冗余。

TLDR: BCVS is a budget-aware, correspondence-driven view selection algorithm that enables real-time (22+ FPS on CPU) filtering of redundant image sequences for mobile robot 3D perception, outperforming CPU-friendly baselines and reducing redundancy in aerial and marine robotics field trials.

Abstract: 3D visual perception and scene reconstruction are critical for autonomous robots and intelligent transportation, yet real-world deployments often generate long, redundant image sequences that hinder downstream processing. This report investigates BCVS (budget-aware correspondence-driven view sampling), a pose-free view selection algorithm that offers 22+ FPS on a CPU, enabling online filtering for efficient 3D perception by mobile robots. Unlike existing approaches that rely on full structure-from-motion (SfM) pipelines or camera pose estimation, BCVS employs a purely correspondence-based scoring strategy that prioritizes view novelty while maintaining sufficient overlap for geometric stability. Given a user-specified budget, BCVS iteratively selects the most distinct frames and suppresses near-duplicates, producing compact subsets that preserve connectivity and minimize reconstruction loss. Extensive experiments on benchmark show that BCVS outperforms CPU-friendly baselines at tight budgets and remains competitive as budgets scale. Field trials with large aerial and marine robotics data further validate its practicality and scalability: BCVS reduces redundancy up to 16% while sustaining robust SfM registration and high-quality 3D reconstructions.

摘要（中文）：三维视觉感知与场景重建对于自主机器人和智能交通至关重要，然而实际部署中常常产生冗长且重复的图像序列，阻碍了下游处理。本报告研究了BCVS（预算感知的对应关系驱动视图采样），这是一种无需位姿的视图选择算法，在CPU上可实现22+ FPS的帧率，支持移动机器人进行在线过滤以实现高效三维感知。与依赖完整运动恢复结构（SfM）流程或相机位姿估计的现有方法不同，BCVS采用纯基于对应关系的评分策略，在优先考虑视图新颖性的同时保持足够的重叠以确保几何稳定性。在给定用户指定预算的情况下，BCVS迭代选择最具区分度的帧并抑制近重复帧，生成保持连通性并最小化重建损失的紧凑子集。基准上的大量实验表明，BCVS在严格预算下优于CPU友好的基线方法，并在预算增大时保持竞争力。大规模航空和海洋机器人数据的现场试验进一步验证了其实用性和可扩展性：BCVS将冗余度降低了16%，同时保持了稳健的SfM配准和高质量三维重建。

Authors: Vaishnav Ramesh, Jacob Carter, Shivali J. Patel, Sanjeev J. Koppal, Md Jahidul Islam

Data-Driven Precision Control of Soft Helicoid Robots Other

data-driven modeling soft robotics spectral submanifold model predictive control reduced-order model

简要说明：本文提出一种基于谱子流形理论的数据驱动方法，为软螺旋机器人学习五维降阶模型，并在硬件上实现比线性方法和无模型强化学习更精确的轨迹跟踪控制。

TLDR: This paper presents a data-driven method to learn a five-dimensional reduced-order model using spectral submanifold theory for precision trajectory tracking of a soft-helicoid robot, demonstrating superior accuracy over linear methods and model-free RL on hardware.

Abstract: A purely data-driven method grounded in the theory of adiabatic spectral submanifolds (aSSMs) was recently used to model and control nonlinear soft robotic simulators. Here, we extend the methodology to learn aSSM-reduced models from data collected from hardware soft robotic platforms. Specifically, we learn a five dimensional (5D) aSSM-reduced nonlinear ordinary differential equation (ODE) that accurately models the dynamics of a soft-helicoid trunk robot. We then use this ODE in a model predictive control scheme to demonstrate real-time precision control across various challenging closed-loop trajectory-tracking tasks, ranging from 2D to 3D trajectories with static and dynamic constraints. We find that our methodology enhances accuracy and precision across all control tasks compared to available data-driven linear methods and model-free reinforcement learning. While we focus here on a soft-helicoid trunk robot, our methodology relies solely on hardware data and is therefore applicable to a broader class of soft robotic systems.

摘要（中文）：基于绝热谱子流形（aSSMs）理论的一种纯数据驱动方法，近期已被用于对非线性软体机器人模拟器进行建模与控制。本文将该方法进一步扩展，以从硬件软体机器人平台采集的数据中学习aSSM降阶模型。具体而言，我们学习了一个五维（5D）的aSSM降阶非线性常微分方程（ODE），该方程能够精确建模软体螺旋体躯干机器人的动力学特性。随后，我们将该ODE应用于模型预测控制方案中，以展示在多种具有挑战性的闭环轨迹跟踪任务中的实时精准控制能力，这些任务涵盖从二维到三维轨迹，并包含静态与动态约束。我们发现，与现有的数据驱动线性方法及无模型强化学习方法相比，我们的方法在所有控制任务中均提升了准确性与精度。尽管本文聚焦于软体螺旋体躯干机器人，但所提出的方法完全依赖于硬件数据，因此适用于更广泛的软体机器人系统类别。

Authors: Roshan S. Kaundinya, Mark Leone, Roberto Sabella, Hugo Buurmeijer, Luis Pabon, John Irvin Alora, Marco Pavone, George Haller

Compute Regeneration through Re-Productization: Reorganizing Retired Edge AI Silicon into a Delivered Multilingual Service Robot Other

compute regeneration service robot edge AI Jetson AGX Xavier systems design

简要说明：本文介绍了GEdgeBot，一种通过重新利用退役的Jetson AGX Xavier计算模块构建的多语言服务机器人，并详细说明了系统设计、审计和测量，证明了计算再生的可行性。

TLDR: This paper presents GEdgeBot, a multilingual service robot built by repurposing a retired Jetson AGX Xavier compute module, and details the systems design, audits, and measurements showing the viability of compute regeneration for embodied AI.

Abstract: Useful edge hardware can lose product support while retaining substantial computation. We treat this as systems design: compute regeneration here means re-productization, retaining the compute module while redesigning the surrounding product organization. Our case is GEdgeBot, a multilingual service robot built around a retired 32 GB Jetson AGX Xavier. A source-grounded inventory shows the box alone supplies inference, while the combined system exposes five on-device AI services, a seven-language speech chain, three sensing domains, and one deterministic seven-byte control boundary. AI and orchestration stay on the Xavier; finite motor-pulse generation on an STM32F407. Audits cover the six-mode control state machine, readiness barriers and sound orientation. Historical single-prototype measurements report 1,782 MB GPU memory with YOLO, Whisper-small, and NLLB-200 resident, a direct-control p99 deviation rising from 0.24 to 49.93 ms under concurrent AI load, and six of six trigger-to-follow demonstrations at 4.35 s mean latency, with conversational voice unavailable. A November campaign restores an isolated inference stack, re-measures AI workloads, and repeats control-frame runs. Driving two execution organisations with the same 6,000 measured 50 ms frame intervals shows the finite-pulse boundary removes host jitter from the pulse train but not the command start phase; its stopping bound is host-enforced, while the MCU 16-bit pulse field is unclamped. A six-check static audit exposes a host--MCU queue mismatch, and a 14-scenario replay executes the audited main() dispatcher across six modes with zero physical device opens and 54 contract-checked frames. Results support an existence claim and a reproducible architectural hypothesis, not fleet-level reliability. The 208 direct-control ratio remains unreplicated; MCU waveform capture and on-site fault injection remain open.

摘要（中文）：有用的边缘硬件在保留可观算力的同时，可能失去产品支持。我们将其视为系统设计问题：此处“计算再生”意味着重新产品化，即保留计算模块，同时重新设计外围产品组织。我们的案例是GEdgeBot，一个基于已退役的32 GB Jetson AGX Xavier构建的多语言服务机器人。基于来源溯源的清单显示，仅该盒子即可提供推理能力，而整个系统则暴露了五个设备端AI服务、一条七语言语音链、三个感知域以及一个确定性的七字节控制边界。AI与编排运行在Xavier上；有限的电机脉冲生成则由STM32F407承担。审计覆盖六模式控制状态机、就绪屏障和声音定位。历史单原型测量报告显示，在YOLO、Whisper-small和NLLB-200常驻内存的情况下，GPU显存占用为1,782 MB；在并发AI负载下，直接控制的p99偏差从0.24 ms上升至49.93 ms；六次触发到跟随演示全部成功，平均延迟为4.35 s，但会话语音不可用。11月的一次活动恢复了隔离的推理栈，重新测量了AI工作负载，并重复了控制帧运行。以相同的6,000个实测50 ms帧间隔驱动两个执行组织，结果表明有限脉冲边界将主机抖动从脉冲串中移除，但并未影响命令起始相位；其停止界限由主机强制执行，而MCU的16位脉冲字段未做钳位处理。六项静态审计暴露了主机与MCU之间的队列不匹配；14个场景回放则跨六种模式执行了经审计的main()调度器，物理设备打开次数为零，并通过了54个经契约检查的帧。结果支持存在性主张和可复现的架构假设，但并非车队级可靠性。208次直接控制比例仍未复现；MCU波形捕获和现场故障注入仍待开展。

Authors: Hongyu Luo, Sun Tie, John Wang

PA-SaR: Perception-Aware Learning, Control, and Coordination for Multi-Robot Search and Rescue Other

multi-robot search and rescue task allocation exploration victim guidance simulation

简要说明：本文提出了PA-SaR，一个用于多机器人搜索与救援的数学和架构框架，整合了局部控制、基于学习的探索、监督任务分配和自适应受害者引导，并通过仿真研究分析了这些组件之间的权衡和相互作用。

TLDR: This paper presents PA-SaR, a mathematical and architectural framework for multi-robot search and rescue that integrates local control, learning-based exploration, supervisory task allocation, and adaptive victim guidance, and demonstrates the framework in simulation studies to analyze trade-offs and interactions between these components.

Abstract: Autonomous SaR requires robots to explore unknown or partially known environments, avoid hazards, coordinate team activities, and guide discovered victims to safety. Improving individual capabilities of robots does not necessarily improve mission outcomes: safer motion can restrict the exploration behavior, faster discovery can increase the rescue demand, and effective guidance depends on victim responses. We introduce PA-SaR, a mathematical and architectural framework for coordinating heterogeneous local control, learning-based exploration, supervisory task allocation, and adaptive approach-lead victim guidance around mission-level objectives. PA- SaR distinguishes environmental ground-truth, robot-specific perceptions, and simulated victim behavior. This provides a common basis for integrating complementary mechanisms and analyzing their interactions across mission stages. We demonstrate the framework through single- and multi-robot simulation studies incorporating model-predictive and learning-based exploration, perception-based safety shielding, event-driven task allocation, and adaptive victim guidance. The results show trade-offs between collision avoidance and search completion, indicate that supervisory allocation improves search completion beyond information sharing alone, and demonstrate that increased exploration does not necessarily yield more rescues. Adaptive guidance increases rescues relative to continuous leading, without a detected improvement in mean or final victim trust or a reduction in mortality. These findings support evaluating local control, team coordination, and evacuation as related but distinct aspects of autonomous SaR within the considered simulation environments.

摘要（中文）：自主搜索与救援（SaR）要求机器人在未知或部分已知环境中进行探索，规避危险，协调团队活动，并引导发现的受害者到达安全区域。提升机器人的个体能力并不必然改善任务整体成效：更安全的运动可能限制探索行为，更快的发现速度可能增加救援需求，而有效引导则依赖于受害者的响应。我们提出PA-SaR，一个围绕任务级目标协调异构局部控制、基于学习的探索、监督式任务分配以及自适应接近-引导式受害者引导的数学与架构框架。PA-SaR区分环境真实状态、机器人特定感知以及模拟的受害者行为，为整合互补机制并分析其在任务各阶段中的交互提供了共同基础。我们通过单机器人和多机器人仿真研究对该框架进行验证，涵盖模型预测与基于学习的探索、基于感知的安全屏蔽、事件驱动的任务分配以及自适应受害者引导。结果表明，避障与搜索完成之间存在权衡；监督式分配在仅信息共享之外进一步提升了搜索完成度；同时，增强探索并不必然带来更多救援成功。相较于持续引导方式，自适应引导提高了救援成功次数，但未检测到受害者平均或最终信任度的显著提升，也未显著降低死亡率。这些发现支持将局部控制、团队协调与疏散视为自主SaR中相互关联但各具独立性的方面，并在所考虑的仿真环境中加以评估。

Authors: Jokūbas Dimša, Maria Grouev, Filip Keerberg, Nicolas Laplagne, Tigo Schutgens, Sven Schoonebeek, Anahita Jamshidnejad

Kinora: A Versioned Workflow for Text-to-Motion Generation, Robot Retargeting, and Interactive Validation Other

text-to-motion generation robot retargeting versioned workflow interactive validation trajectory refinement

简要说明：Kinora 是一个版本化工作流系统，通过版本化工件连接文本到运动生成、机器人重定向和交互式验证，使用独立指定的 52 关节创作装备和程序化骨骼预览。系统通过回归测试、CUDA 生成/编辑案例和 G1 重定向夹具进行评估，支持选定的集成和保存契约，但未建立语义质量改进或硬件安全性。

TLDR: Kinora is a versioned workflow system connecting text-to-motion generation, robot retargeting, and interactive validation through versioned artifacts, with an independently specified 52-joint authoring rig and procedural skeleton previews. The system is evaluated with regression tests, CUDA generation/editing cases, and a G1 retargeting fixture, supporting selected integration and preservation contracts without establishing semantic-quality improvements or hardware safety.

Abstract: Motion generation tools produce candidate trajectories, but interactive robot authoring also requires recoverable execution, traceable edits, explicit geometry, and model-specific validation. We present Kinora, a system that connects text-to-motion generation, a motion library, local agent tools, robot retargeting, and trajectory refinement through versioned artifacts. The current release uses an independently specified 52-joint authoring rig and procedural skeleton previews, separating the distributed human geometry from externally installed generation models and robot assets. Human-motion edits preserve frames outside a selected interval, while robot edits create immutable candidates whose reports govern acceptance and export. We evaluate server 0.5.1 and Gadget 0.15.2 with 156 core regression test executions, 49 Gadget executions, four CUDA generation/editing cases, a 30-frame G1 retargeting check, and a 3,600-frame synthetic G1 fixture paired with a suspended negative control. All four CUDA cases passed their numerical gates; the turning splice nevertheless retained a 14.3 cm support-foot drift proxy warning. The G1 positive fixture completed bounded simulation replay, whereas the suspended control was quarantined before replay. These results support selected integration and preservation contracts. They do not establish semantic-quality improvements, population-level feasibility, or hardware safety.

摘要（中文）：运动生成工具能够产生候选轨迹，但交互式机器人编排还需要可恢复的执行过程、可追溯的编辑记录、明确的几何结构以及针对具体模型的验证。我们提出了Kinara系统，该系统通过版本化工件将文本到运动的生成、运动库、本地智能体工具、机器人重定向以及轨迹优化连接起来。当前版本采用独立指定的52关节编排骨架和程序化骨骼预览，将分布式人体几何结构与外部安装的生成模型和机器人资源分离开来。人体运动编辑保留选定区间之外的帧，而机器人编辑则生成不可变候选，其报告决定接受与导出。我们使用156次核心回归测试执行、49次Gadget执行、四种CUDA生成/编辑案例、一次30帧G1重定向检查，以及一个3600帧合成G1夹具并配对一个挂起阴性对照，对服务器0.5.1和Gadget 0.15.2进行了评估。所有四个CUDA案例均通过了数值门限；然而，转折拼接仍保留了14.3厘米支撑脚漂移的代理警告。G1阳性夹具完成了有界仿真回放，而挂起对照在回放前被隔离。这些结果支持选定的集成和保存合约，但并未确立语义质量改进、群体层面可行性或硬件安全性。

Authors: Fangcheng Jin

Qubit-to-Motion: Traceable Action Provenance in Hybrid QRL for Robotic Bin-Packing Sequencing RLRobot

hybrid quantum reinforcement learning robotic bin-packing action provenance traceability MuJoCo replay

简要说明：本文提出了Qubit-to-Motion框架，用于混合量子强化学习中的可追溯动作来源，在机器人装箱排序中利用Pauli-Z读出和SHA-256指纹将量子决策与模拟机器人运动联系起来。

TLDR: This paper introduces Qubit-to-Motion, a framework for traceable action provenance in hybrid quantum reinforcement learning for robotic bin-packing sequencing, using Pauli-Z readouts and SHA-256 fingerprints to link quantum decisions to simulated robot motion.

Abstract: Hybrid quantum reinforcement learning has been explored for robotic decision-making, but evaluations often emphasize task success, return, or convergence, leaving unresolved whether quantum circuit outputs influence constrained actions and remain traceable through robot execution. We present \texttt{Qubit-to-Motion}, an evidence-centered framework for support-constrained sequencing and simulated robotic placement. Four Pauli-$Z$ readouts provide the sole learned input to the actor and critic, while a support mask enforces admissible object selection. Each decision is recorded and linked via step indices and SHA-256 fingerprints to a sealed route, deterministic Cartesian and inverse-kinematics waypoints, prescribed joint motion, and MuJoCo contact replay. A frozen checkpoint is evaluated across five deterministic 30-object scene variants. All 150 placements satisfy support, containment, and settling criteria. A fixed-state zero-readout intervention changes $90.0\pm0.0\%$ of decisions, demonstrating dependence on the joint circuit representation. Mean macro travel is $34.537\pm0.206$~m, inference requires $8.60\pm1.27$~ms per route, and replay achieves $8.764\pm0.220~μ$m mean final position error with 0.356~mm maximum interpenetration. These results establish reproducible decision-to-contact traceability. The implementation is available at \href{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Qubit-to-Motion-Quantum-Reinforcement-Learning-F7DC}{\textcolor{linkpink}{the anonymous repository}}.

摘要（中文）：混合量子强化学习已被探索用于机器人决策，但相关评估往往侧重于任务成功率、回报或收敛性，而未阐明量子电路输出是否会影响受约束的动作选择，并能否在机器人执行过程中保持可追溯性。我们提出\texttt{Qubit-to-Motion}，一个以证据为中心、面向支撑约束排序与仿真机器人放置任务的框架。四个Pauli-$Z$读出值作为演员与评论家网络唯一的学习输入，同时一个支撑掩码强制约束合法对象的选择。每一步决策均被记录，并通过步骤索引和SHA-256指纹与密封路径、确定性笛卡尔坐标与逆运动学路径点、指定关节运动及MuJoCo接触回放相链接。基于冻结检查点，在五个确定性30对象场景变体上进行了评估。所有150次放置均满足支撑、包容及稳定条件。固定状态下的零读出干预改变了$90.0\pm0.0\%$的决策，表明决策依赖于联合电路表示。平均宏路径长度为$34.537\pm0.206$~m，每条路径的推断时间为$8.60\pm1.27$~ms，回放的平均最终位置误差为$8.764\pm0.220~μ$m，最大相互穿透深度为0.356~mm。上述结果确立了从决策到接触的可复现可追溯性。实现代码见\texttt{匿名仓库}（\href{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Qubit-to-Motion-Quantum-Reinforcement-Learning-F7DC}{\textcolor{linkpink}{匿名仓库链接}}）。

Authors: Hassen Nigatu, Howard Li

WanderBench: Can World Models Explore Dynamic Worlds from Video? WorldModel

world models video-conditioned generation dynamic scenes benchmark camera control

简要说明：WanderBench 是一个新的基准，用于评估视频世界模型从单个视频进行动态世界探索的能力，发现现有模型在长片段中失去相机控制和动态保真度，且无法保持场景一致性；提出的无训练框架 WanderLand 在五个模型的所有维度上都有提升。

TLDR: WanderBench is a new benchmark for evaluating video world models on dynamic world exploration from a single video, revealing that current models lose camera control and dynamics over long clips and fail at place consistency, while the proposed training-free WanderLand framework improves five models across all dimensions.

Abstract: Video world models conditioned on an input video make it possible to explore real, recorded dynamic scenes, enabling re-shooting of footage, free-viewpoint replay, and real-to-sim environments for embodied agents. Such uses require the generated rollout to stay faithful to the recorded world, yet existing benchmarks start from a single image or a text prompt, and video-conditioned generation is evaluated mainly on perceptual quality and camera following. These evaluations do not directly assess whether exploration preserves subject identity, event progression, and scene consistency upon revisiting a location. We introduce WanderBench, a benchmark for exploring dynamic worlds from video. It comprises 745 single-shot source videos of real and AI-generated content in three difficulty tiers (3-25 s), paired with camera routes given as keyboard actions, and evaluates six dimensions with 24 human-validated sub-metrics. Benchmarking eight models, we find that as clips grow longer, models keep the static scene and visual quality but lose camera control and the source dynamics, and that none keeps revisited places consistent. We further propose WanderLand, a training-free framework that conditions each frame of a frozen model on the same-instant source and, on revisits, on its own earlier static content. WanderLand improves five models on every dimension, by up to 8.3 points in source-dynamics fidelity.

摘要（中文）：视频世界模型能够以输入视频为条件，从而实现对真实、已录制动态场景的探索，支持素材重拍、自由视点回放，以及为具身智能体构建真实到仿真环境。此类应用要求生成的推演序列忠实于所录制的世界，然而现有基准测试通常从单张图像或文本提示出发，且视频条件生成主要依据感知质量和相机跟随效果进行评估。这些评估方法并未直接检验探索过程是否保持主体身份、事件进展以及重访场景时的一致性。为此，我们提出WanderBench，一个用于从视频探索动态世界的基准测试。该基准包含745段单镜头源视频，涵盖真实内容与AI生成内容，分为三个难度等级（3至25秒），并配有以键盘操作形式给出的相机路径，通过24项经人工验证的子指标对六个维度进行评估。对八种模型进行基准测试后，我们发现随着片段长度的增加，模型能够保持静态场景与视觉质量，但会丧失相机控制能力与源动态信息，并且没有模型能保持一致的重访地点。我们进一步提出WanderLand，一种无需训练的框架，该框架将冻结模型的每一帧与同瞬间的源帧进行条件化，并在重访时将模型自身先前的静态内容作为条件。WanderLand在全部维度上提升了五种模型的表现，在源动态保真度方面最高提升达8.3分。

Authors: Yuhang Chen, Jiheng Li, Jiale Wang, Zai Wang, Guangyue Liu

An Evaluation of Tabular Foundation Models as Training-Free World Models WorldModel

tabular foundation model training-free world model in-context regression dynamics prediction robot locomotion

简要说明：本文评估了预训练的表格基础模型能否作为免训练的世界模型用于动力学预测，结果表明它们在数据稀缺时准确，但尚无法与训练模型在规划中匹敌。

TLDR: This paper evaluates whether pretrained tabular foundation models can serve as training-free world models for dynamics prediction, showing they are accurate with scarce data but not yet competitive with trained models for planning.

Abstract: World models are widely considered to be a potential key component of model-based reinforcement learning and robot planning, but typically require task-specific training on substantial interaction data. We investigate whether a pretrained tabular foundation model (TabFM) can serve as a training-free dynamics model for world modeling by framing next-state prediction as in-context regression over transition pairs, and where such a model helps and where it breaks. Across synthetic dynamical systems and robot locomotion benchmarks, TabFM is more accurate than LSTM and MLP models trained from scratch on the same limited transitions in almost all settings, and among regressors fitted to the same data it is the most accurate on locomotion, while a Gaussian process is more accurate on smooth low-dimensional systems. However, models trained on the full dataset remain substantially better on most systems. When rolled out autoregressively over multiple steps, TabFM's accuracy depends strongly on how much context it is given. With a short context, its rollouts quickly degrade to the level of a trivial baseline, whereas with a long context they improve substantially and, on one locomotion task, exceed a trained LSTM. Inference is also about three orders of magnitude slower than an LSTM. Overall, in their current state, we find that training-free priors are useful as predictors when data are scarce and enough context is available, but they are not yet a substitute for trained world models in planning.

摘要（中文）：世界模型被广泛认为是基于模型的强化学习和机器人规划中的潜在关键组成部分，但通常需要在大量交互数据上进行特定任务的训练。我们研究预训练的表格式基础模型（TabFM）是否可以通过将下一状态预测视为转换对上的上下文回归，作为无需训练的世界建模动态模型，并探讨此类模型在哪些场景下有效、在哪些场景下失效。在合成动力系统和机器人运动基准测试中，TabFM在几乎所有设置下都比在相同有限转换上从头训练的LSTM和MLP模型更准确；在与相同数据拟合的回归器中，TabFM在运动任务上最为准确，而高斯过程在平滑低维系统上更为准确。然而，在大多数系统上，使用完整数据集训练的模型仍然明显更优。在多步自回归展开时，TabFM的准确性强烈依赖于其获得的上下文长度。在短上下文情况下，其展开结果迅速退化到与简单基线相当的水平；而在长上下文情况下，其结果显著改善，并在一个运动任务上超过了训练过的LSTM。推理速度也比LSTM慢约三个数量级。总体而言，在当前状态下，我们发现无需训练的先验模型在数据稀缺且上下文充足时作为预测器是有用的，但它们尚不能替代训练过的世界模型用于规划。

Authors: Xian Yeow Lee, Ryoichi Takase, Ahmed Farahat

ReVMap: Vectorized Global Mapping via Connectivity-Aware Local Map Fusion Perception3D

HD map construction uncertainty-guided fusion connectivity-aware local-to-global mapping auto-labeling

简要说明：ReVMap提出了一种不确定性引导、连通性感知的框架，通过局部预测渐进构建矢量全局高清地图，在nuScenes和Argoverse 2上达到最先进性能。

TLDR: ReVMap introduces an uncertainty-guided, connectivity-aware framework for incrementally constructing vectorized global HD maps from local predictions, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy and consistency on nuScenes and Argoverse 2.

Abstract: Large-scale annotation of vectorized high-definition (HD) maps is labor-intensive and costly, motivating local-to-global auto-labeling approaches that incrementally construct global maps from local vectorized predictions. However, existing approaches often overlook prediction uncertainty and rely on heuristic map integration, potentially propagating errors and introducing topological inconsistencies. To address these limitations, we propose ReVMap, a reliable local-to-global framework that iteratively refines local map predictions and global map construction through uncertainty-guided prior utilization and connectivity-guided global map revision. Specifically, ReVMap leverages point-wise localization uncertainty to incorporate global map priors into local map prediction, improving robustness against inaccurate prior information. It then predicts local-to-global connectivity and selectively updates the global map through uncertainty-aware fusion based on the reliability of local predictions. By iteratively coupling local prediction and global revision, ReVMap progressively improves both local map accuracy and global map consistency. Extensive experiments on the nuScenes and Argoverse 2 benchmarks demonstrate that ReVMap achieves state-of-the-art performance in both local map prediction and global map construction.

摘要（中文）：大规模标注矢量化高清（HD）地图既耗费人力又成本高昂，这促使研究者探索从局部到全局的自动标注方法，通过逐步整合局部矢量化预测结果来构建全局地图。然而，现有方法往往忽略预测不确定性，并依赖启发式的地图融合策略，可能导致误差传播并引发拓扑不一致问题。为克服上述局限，我们提出了ReVMap，一种可靠的局部到全局框架，通过不确定性引导的先验利用与连通性引导的全局地图修正，迭代优化局部地图预测与全局地图构建。具体而言，ReVMap利用逐点定位不确定性将全局地图先验信息融入局部地图预测中，从而增强对不准确先验信息的鲁棒性。随后，该框架预测局部到全局的连通性，并基于局部预测的可靠性，通过不确定性感知的融合策略选择性地更新全局地图。通过将局部预测与全局修正迭代耦合，ReVMap逐步提升局部地图精度与全局地图一致性。在nuScenes和Argoverse 2基准上的大量实验表明，ReVMap在局部地图预测与全局地图构建任务中均取得了当前最优的性能。

Authors: Hongjae Shin, Jungho Kim, Donghyuk Kwak, Myeongjun Kim, Seunghoon Yu, Jiyong Oh, Jun Won Choi

FaST: Factored Synthesis of Transitions for Offline Reinforcement Learning RLRobot

Offline Reinforcement Learning Synthetic Data Augmentation Factored Transitions D4RL benchmarks Action Synthesis

简要说明：FaST 将离线强化学习中的转移元组分解为状态、动作、动态、奖励和终止阶段，实现更快的合成数据生成和针对性的动作合成，在 D4RL 基准上提升了策略性能。

TLDR: FaST factors transition tuples in offline RL into state, action, dynamics, reward, and terminal stages, enabling faster synthetic data generation and targeted action synthesis that improves policy performance on D4RL benchmarks.

Abstract: Synthetic data augmentation promises to scale offline reinforcement learning beyond fixed logged datasets, but leading diffusion-based generators model the transition tuple (state, action, next state, reward, terminal) as a monolith: no single factor can be natively redrawn in isolation. We present FaST (Factored Synthesis of Transitions), which factors transitions via the chain rule into state, action, dynamics, reward, and terminal stages, fitting each with an estimator matched to its statistical properties. Across twelve D4RL locomotion and maze benchmarks, TD3+BC and IQL agents trained on FaST transitions match the SynthER diffusion baseline while generating transitions over 90x faster. The explicit action-given-state conditional can also be re-queried for a fixed state, enabling targeted action synthesis: drawing N candidate actions per generated state and keeping the highest-advantage one under a value function fit to the same data, thereby synthesizing improved behavior during generation rather than filtering for it post-hoc. Best-of-10 synthesis beats training on real data on 11 of 12 medium and medium-replay settings (+8.9 D4RL points on average, up to +28.4), and is competitive with advantage-filtered SynthER at a fraction of its generation cost. On expert mixtures both mechanisms degrade identically, tracing the failure to the advantage estimate itself rather than to either targeting mechanism.

摘要（中文）：摘要：合成数据增强有望将离线强化学习扩展到固定的记录数据集之外，但主流的基于扩散模型的生成器将转移元组（状态、动作、下一状态、奖励、终止）视为一个整体：没有任何单一因素可以单独原生重绘。我们提出FaST（转移的因子化合成），通过链式法则将转移分解为状态、动作、动力学、奖励和终止阶段，并为每个阶段拟合与其统计特性相匹配的估计器。在十二个D4RL运动与迷宫基准测试中，基于FaST转移训练的TD3+BC和IQL智能体在匹配SynthER扩散基线的同时，生成转移的速度提高了90倍以上。显式的“给定状态下的动作”条件也可以针对固定状态重新查询，从而实现定向动作合成：为每个生成的状态抽取N个候选动作，并根据拟合同一数据的价值函数保留优势最高的动作，从而在生成过程中合成改进的行为，而非事后进行过滤。在11/12的中等及中等重放设置中，最佳10选1合成优于在真实数据上训练的结果（平均D4RL分数提高8.9分，最高提高28.4分），并且以远低于其生成成本的优势过滤SynthER方法相当。在专家混合数据上，两种机制均出现相同程度的性能退化，表明失败源于优势估计本身，而非任一目标机制。
